title: The Impact of Large-stake Lotteries on Parameters in Prospect Theory via Maximum Likelihood Estimation

detail.title: The Impact of Large-stake Lotteries on Parameters in Prospect Theory via Maximum Likelihood Estimation

publicationDetails.detailsText: The annual report of economic science (Kyushu Keizaigakkai nenpo), No. 63, 2025, Pp.127-136

detail.abstract: This study investigates how the number of large-stake lotteries in a questionnaire affects parameter estimation in Prospect Theory (PT) and Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT). Using binary-choice data from Japanese university students, parameters are estimated via maximum likelihood estimation combined with a genetic algorithm. Twelve models are constructed by combining alternative value functions and probability weighting functions. The results show that exponential value functions yield stable parameter estimates across different questionnaire designs, whereas power value functions are sensitive to the number of large-stake lotteries. Fewer large-stake lotteries lead to higher estimated risk aversion in gains and higher risk seeking in losses. These findings highlight the importance of functional form selection and questionnaire design in empirical applications of prospect theory.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了问卷中高额彩票数量对前景理论和累积前景理论参数估计的影响。使用日本大学生的二元选择数据，通过最大似然估计结合遗传算法估计参数。构建了12个模型，结合了不同的价值函数和概率加权函数。结果显示指数价值函数在不同问卷设计中产生稳定的参数估计，而幂价值函数对高额彩票数量敏感。较少的高额彩票导致更高的收益风险厌恶和损失风险寻求估计。这些发现凸显了功能形式选择和问卷设计在前景理论实证应用中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 问卷中高额彩票的数量如何影响前景理论和累积前景理论的参数估计？
AI.motivation: 在实证应用前景理论时，问卷设计（特别是高额彩票的数量）可能影响参数估计的稳定性，但这一影响尚未得到充分研究。理解问卷设计对参数估计的影响对于确保研究结果的可靠性和可比性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论（Prospect Theory, PT）和累积前景理论（Cumulative Prospect Theory, CPT），包括价值函数（指数函数和幂函数）和概率加权函数的各种形式。
AI.method: 使用日本大学生的二元选择数据，通过最大似然估计结合遗传算法估计参数。构建了12个模型，结合了不同的价值函数（指数和幂函数）和概率加权函数。
AI.findings: 1. 指数价值函数在不同问卷设计中产生稳定的参数估计；2. 幂价值函数对高额彩票数量敏感；3. 较少的高额彩票导致更高的收益风险厌恶和损失风险寻求估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了问卷设计（特别是高额彩票数量）对前景理论参数估计的影响；2. 比较了不同价值函数（指数vs幂函数）在参数稳定性方面的差异；3. 为前景理论实证研究中的功能形式选择提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究者设计前景理论实验问卷提供了指导；2. 建议在实证研究中优先考虑指数价值函数以获得更稳定的参数估计；3. 提醒研究者注意问卷设计对结果解释的影响。

title: Trough Equity Crowdfunding Evolution and Involution: Initial Coin Offering and Initial Exchange Offering

detail.title: Trough Equity Crowdfunding Evolution and Involution: Initial Coin Offering and Initial Exchange Offering
detail.abstract: This article analyses two of the most innovative financing instruments belonging to the crowdfunding family: Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs) and Initial Exchange Offerings (IEOs). Both instruments display a potential financial nature and are therefore examined as technologically advanced developments of equity-based crowdfunding (EBCF). The paper aims to assess whether ICOs and IEOs represent a genuine evolution of EBCF or, at least in part, an involution due to heightened risks. After outlining the economic and legal features of EBCF, the analysis identifies its main advantages—such as easier access to capital and the “wisdom of the crowd”—and its core drawbacks, including moral hazard, fraud, platform gatekeeping, and illiquidity. The study then examines ICOs and IEOs from a technological and functional perspective, focusing on blockchain, tokens, and smart contracts, and evaluates their potential to address EBCF’s shortcomings through programmability, disintermediation, and tokenisation. At the same time, the paper highlights the specific risks associated with ICOs and IEOs, particularly information asymmetry, regulatory uncertainty, and conflicts of interest in exchange-based offerings. The article concludes that, while ICOs and IEOs may mitigate key limitations of traditional equity crowdfunding, their long-term sustainability depends on appropriate regulatory responses capable of balancing innovation and investor protection.

AI.tldr: 本文分析ICO和IEO这两种众筹创新工具，探讨它们是否代表股权众筹的真正进化还是因风险增加而退步，结论认为它们能缓解传统股权众筹的局限，但长期可持续性取决于平衡创新与投资者保护的监管措施。
AI.research_question: ICO和IEO是否代表股权众筹(EBCF)的真正进化，还是因风险增加而退步？
AI.motivation: ICO和IEO作为创新的众筹工具具有潜在金融属性，需要评估它们相对于传统股权众筹的进步性和风险性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股权众筹理论、区块链技术理论、金融创新理论、信息不对称理论、监管理论
AI.method: 比较分析法：从技术和功能角度分析ICO和IEO，评估它们解决股权众筹缺陷的潜力；文献分析法：梳理股权众筹的经济和法律特征
AI.findings: ICO和IEO通过可编程性、去中介化和代币化能够缓解股权众筹的道德风险、欺诈、平台把关和流动性不足等核心缺陷，但也带来信息不对称、监管不确定性和交易所利益冲突等新风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将ICO和IEO概念化为股权众筹的技术先进发展；2) 建立评估金融创新工具进化/退化的分析框架；3) 识别区块链技术在解决传统众筹问题中的理论潜力
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为创业者提供融资工具选择的参考；2) 为投资者识别不同众筹模式的风险收益特征；3) 为监管机构制定平衡创新与保护的监管政策提供依据

title: Out of the Spotlight: A Long Run Approach to College American Football Attendance in Division III
affiliations: Central Michigan University, Central Michigan University and Central Michigan University

detail.title: Out of the Spotlight: A Long Run Approach to College American Football Attendance in Division III
detail.abstract: American college football attendance at the Division III which is the lowest level of NCAAsanctioned play has been ignored. This study takes a long run approach using a balanced panel (208 Division III teams over 20 years) to discover the primary driving forces on average season attendance from among economic, team performance and demographic measures. Fixed-and random-effects models are estimated after all variables are tested for stationarity and cointegration. Contrary to expectations, some economic variables (i.e., state monthly unemployment rate, real travel cost) exert no impact on attendance. Attendance decreases as real incomes rise suggesting that games at this level are inferior goods. Winning games brings more fans to the stadium. More wins in the current season and previous two seasons, and more playoff appearances in the last ten years all increase attendance. Habit persistence is present although its magnitude decreases as the lag increases. The influence of lifetime winning percentage is mixed: insignificant in the fixed effects model while positive in the random effects model. Greater male undergraduate enrollment increases attendance. The county population coefficient is negative in the random effects model while insignificant in the fixed effects model. These findings suggest that building a successful team, as measured by winning games, is the most important determinant of fan attendance in Division III. This relationship holds in the short run (i.e., current season, recent previous seasons) and in the long run (last ten years and lifetime of the program). Even at this lower-level of competition, there is pressure on football coaches to win.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用平衡面板数据（208支NCAA第三级别球队，20年）分析影响平均赛季上座率的主要因素。研究发现：经济变量（失业率、旅行成本）无显著影响；实际收入上升反而降低上座率，表明该级别比赛为劣等品；球队获胜是吸引球迷的最重要因素；习惯持续性存在但随时间减弱；男性本科生人数增加上座率。研究强调即使在低级别比赛中，获胜压力依然存在。
AI.research_question: 影响NCAA第三级别（Division III）大学美式足球平均赛季上座率的主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: NCAA第三级别大学美式足球的上座率研究长期被忽视，需要探究经济因素、球队表现和人口统计变量如何影响这一最低级别NCAA比赛的上座率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于体育经济学理论，研究检验经济因素（收入效应、价格弹性）、球队表现（当前和过往战绩）、人口统计变量（人口规模、学生构成）以及习惯持续性对体育赛事需求的影响。
AI.method: 使用平衡面板数据（208支球队，20年），进行固定效应和随机效应模型估计。所有变量经过平稳性和协整检验，分析经济变量（失业率、实际旅行成本、实际收入）、球队表现变量（胜率、季后赛表现）和人口统计变量（人口、男性本科生人数）的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 经济变量（州月度失业率、实际旅行成本）对上座率无显著影响；2. 实际收入上升降低上座率，表明该级别比赛为劣等品；3. 球队获胜是吸引球迷的最重要因素（当前赛季、前两赛季胜率、过去十年季后赛表现）；4. 习惯持续性存在但随时间减弱；5. 男性本科生人数增加上座率；6. 人口规模影响不一致（随机效应模型为负，固定效应模型不显著）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究NCAA第三级别美式足球上座率；2. 验证低级别体育赛事作为劣等品的特性；3. 揭示即使在非职业化比赛中，获胜压力依然存在；4. 扩展体育经济学理论在业余体育赛事中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为第三级别大学体育管理者提供决策依据：重点应放在提升球队表现而非经济激励；2. 帮助教练理解获胜对维持球迷基础的重要性；3. 为招生策略提供参考（男性本科生人数的影响）；4. 揭示低级别体育赛事独特的市场特性。

title: Rural-Urban Migration and Development
affiliations: Nnamdi Azikiwe University - Department of Economics and Nnamdi Azikiwe University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Rural-Urban Migration and Development
detail.abstract: Migration is seen as the change in place of residence. Migration within the country is called internal migration. Therefore, a very common form of internal migration in most West African countries is the movement of people from the rural areasto urban areas, such as the movement from Urualla (Eastern) to Lagos (Western) part of Nigeria.Usually, mosy of the rural-urban migrants are school leavers and young able-bodied adults. They move in large numbers from rural areas to large urban cities, mostly the state capitals, in search of employment opportunities, better education and bettter standards of living. Hence, we shall discuss the key concepts seperately to reduce the level of ambiguity in their exact meaning and then look at some motivating factors of Rural-Urban Migration, some of the advanced effects of Rural-urban migration to rural-urban development, the chapter concludes with the linking rural-urvan migration with development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了尼日利亚等西非国家农村向城市移民现象，分析了移民动机、对城乡发展的影响，以及移民与发展的关系。
AI.research_question: 农村向城市移民的主要动机是什么？这种移民对城乡发展产生哪些影响？移民如何与整体发展相联系？
AI.motivation: 西非国家普遍存在农村人口向城市大规模迁移的现象，特别是年轻人从农村流向州府等大城市，这种现象对城乡发展产生重要影响，需要系统研究其动因和后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内部迁移理论、农村-城市迁移理论、发展经济学理论，以及推拉理论（农村推力与城市拉力）。
AI.method: 概念分析法和文献综述法，通过分别讨论关键概念来减少歧义，然后分析移民动机、影响和发展联系。
AI.findings: 农村向城市移民主要由就业机会、更好的教育和生活水平驱动；移民对农村和城市发展都有深远影响；移民与整体发展密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了农村-城市移民的关键概念，系统分析了西非国家移民的推拉因素，建立了移民与发展之间的理论联系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于农村-城市移民管理的建议，帮助理解移民对城乡发展的实际影响，为促进均衡发展提供参考。

title: Indigenous land rights and conflict in Darfur: The case of the Fur tribe Unruh JD (2016) Indigenous land rights and conflict in Darfur: The case of the Fur tribe. In: Tidwell, A., and Zellen, B. (eds.) Land, Indigenous Peoples and Conflict

detail.title: Indigenous land rights and conflict in Darfur: The case of the Fur tribe Unruh JD (2016) Indigenous land rights and conflict in Darfur: The case of the Fur tribe. In: Tidwell, A., and Zellen, B. (eds.) Land, Indigenous Peoples and Conflict
detail.abstract: Land rights in Darfur operate as a central feature of the conflict. Widely regarded as being at the heart of the war, land rights for the different indigenous groups involved in the conflict are com- plex, confused, sensitive, and volatile (e.g., Abdhalla 2010; Flint and De Waal 2008; Abdul-Jalil  2007; Suiliman 2011; Concordis 2007). Of the six recognized and agreed upon 'root causes' of  the war mentioned in the 2011 peace accord between the government and one set of the rebel  factions, three dealt explicitly with land rights issues (DDPD 2011). In one of the most acute manifestations of the land rights problem, certain Arab pastoralists of northern Darfur were easily recruited into the Janjaweed for two primary reasons, land and money (Flint 2009).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨达尔富尔冲突中土地权利的核心作用，分析土地问题如何成为战争根源，以及土地权利对阿拉伯牧民加入Janjaweed民兵组织的影响。
AI.research_question: 土地权利在达尔富尔冲突中扮演什么角色？土地问题如何成为战争的根源，并影响不同群体（特别是阿拉伯牧民）参与冲突的动机？
AI.motivation: 达尔富尔冲突中土地权利被广泛认为是战争的核心问题，2011年和平协议中六个公认的战争根源中有三个明确涉及土地权利问题。土地权利问题复杂、敏感且易引发冲突，需要深入理解其在冲突动态中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于冲突理论、土地权利政治经济学、资源冲突理论，以及达尔富尔特定的土地权利历史和社会结构分析框架。
AI.method: 文献分析、政策文件分析（如2011年和平协议DDPD）、历史档案研究，以及现有学术研究和报告的综合分析。
AI.findings: 1. 土地权利是达尔富尔冲突的核心特征和主要根源；2. 2011年和平协议确认六个战争根源中有三个直接涉及土地权利；3. 北部达尔富尔的阿拉伯牧民加入Janjaweed民兵组织的主要动机是土地和经济利益；4. 不同土著群体的土地权利问题复杂、混乱、敏感且易变。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对资源冲突理论的理解，特别是土地权利在复杂冲突中的核心作用；为理解土地权利如何成为战争动员工具提供理论框架；丰富冲突根源分析中土地问题的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为达尔富尔和平进程提供政策建议，强调解决土地权利问题的重要性；帮助国际社会理解冲突的深层根源；为冲突调解和土地权利改革提供实践指导。

title: Linking Economic Planning To Budgeting
affiliations: Nnamdi Azikiwe University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Linking Economic Planning To Budgeting
detail.abstract: The role of macroeconomic management and microeconomic planning is emphasized in formulating and implementing government budgets. Before any effective implementation is taken, budget designers must first of all address macroeconomic needs and then micro-level investment and expenditure plan. They do this by formulating macroeconomic framework, setting medium-and long-term economic performance targets. Every economic sector whether private or public normally want to ascertain its performances over a period of time based on a number of economic decisions such as budgeting which remains the most tactical instrument for both decision making and as well as allocation of limited resources. Omce these annual and medium-term macro strategies are determined, the government can design a budget which will best meet those economic priorities (Premehand, 2000). Hence, our central interest in this chapter is to analyze the capital budgeting in both private and public sector with a view to linking it to economic planning. We shall discuss key terms separately to reduce the level of ambuiguity in its exact meaning and then look at the nexus between economic plannning and budgeting.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨宏观经济管理与微观经济规划在政府预算制定与实施中的作用，分析公私部门资本预算与经济规划之间的联系。
AI.research_question: 如何分析公私部门的资本预算，并将其与经济规划联系起来？
AI.motivation: 预算作为决策和有限资源分配的最重要战术工具，需要在制定前先解决宏观经济需求，再考虑微观层面的投资和支出计划。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济框架理论、中长期经济绩效目标设定理论、资本预算理论、经济规划理论。
AI.method: 概念分析、术语界定、关系分析（通过分别讨论关键术语来减少歧义，然后审视经济规划与预算之间的联系）。
AI.findings: 预算设计需要先确定宏观经济框架和中长期经济绩效目标，然后才能制定符合经济优先事项的预算；公私部门都需要通过预算来评估其在一定时期内的绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了宏观经济管理与微观经济规划在预算制定中的层次关系；建立了资本预算与经济规划之间的理论联系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府预算制定提供了从宏观到微观的系统性方法；帮助公私部门更好地通过预算工具实现经济规划目标。

title: The Economic Cost of Exclusion: How Trump's Second-Term Immigration Policies Threaten California's Economy
affiliations: University of Oklahoma - College of Law

detail.title: The Economic Cost of Exclusion: How Trump's Second-Term Immigration Policies Threaten California's Economy
detail.abstract:
The second Trump administration has pursued an array of immigration enforcement initiatives—from denaturalization and visa scrutiny to termination of humanitarian programs and aggressive workplace raids. Legal scholars have sharply debated these measures, but almost entirely through constitutional, statutory, and rights-based frames. This Article exposes a critical omission in immigration law scholarship: the economics of large-scale noncitizen removal. Drawing on major empirical studies of historic enforcement episodes—including Mexican repatriation between 1929-1934, Japanese internment during World War II, Arizona’s immigration restrictionism from 2007-2012, and federal immigration enforcement efforts of 2008-2015—this Article demonstrates that broad noncitizen removals may reduce the employment and wages of U.S.-born workers.

These consequences are particularly significant for the state of California, which is home to 10.8 million foreign-born residents who comprise nearly 40 percent of the state’s workforce. Using demographic and labor-force data, this Article shows how the administration’s second-term immigration enforcement initiatives threaten California’s economy by constricting business expansion, reducing complementary U.S.-born employment, depressing wages, shrinking tax revenues, and ultimately suppressing state GDP. 

Although focused on California, this analysis has national implications. The economic record makes clear that immigration enforcement on this scale undermines—not advances—the economic interests of the country it purports to protect.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了特朗普第二任期移民执法措施的经济影响，特别是大规模非公民驱逐对美国本土工人就业和工资的负面影响，并以加州为例展示了这些措施对经济的破坏性后果。
AI.research_question: 大规模非公民驱逐措施对美国本土工人的就业和工资有何影响？这些移民执法措施对加州经济会产生怎样的经济后果？
AI.motivation: 现有移民法研究主要关注宪法、法规和权利框架，忽视了大规模非公民驱逐的经济学分析。特朗普第二任期的移民执法措施需要从经济角度评估其实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史大规模驱逐事件的经济学分析框架，包括墨西哥遣返(1929-1934)、日裔美国人拘禁(二战期间)、亚利桑那州移民限制(2007-2012)和联邦移民执法(2008-2015)的经验研究。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，分析历史大规模驱逐事件的经济数据，结合加州的人口和劳动力数据，评估移民执法措施的经济影响。
AI.findings: 大规模非公民驱逐会减少美国本土工人的就业和工资；对加州经济造成负面影响：限制商业扩张、减少互补性本土就业、压低工资、减少税收收入、抑制州GDP。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了移民法研究中的经济学分析空白，提供了大规模移民执法的经济影响理论框架，挑战了"移民执法保护本土经济利益"的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，表明大规模移民执法可能损害而非促进其声称要保护的经济利益；特别为加州政策制定提供具体的经济影响分析。

title: Economic Evaluation of Combination Vaccines: Enabling a More Comprehensive Assessment of Their Benefits and Challenges
affiliations: PATH - Center for Vaccine Innovation and Access (Switzerland), Independent, PATH, PATH, World Health Organization (WHO), New York University (NYU), Boston University, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, The University of Sydney, London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, World Health Organization, World Health Organization (WHO) - Department of Immunization, Vaccines and Biologicals (IVB), University of Groningen - Unit of Global Health, Gates Foundation, World Health Organization and PATH

detail.title: Economic Evaluation of Combination Vaccines: Enabling a More Comprehensive Assessment of Their Benefits and Challenges

declarations.declarationOfInterest: GG, MH, PL, and YS work for the World Health Organization (WHO). The authors alone are responsible for the views expressed in this publication and they do not necessarily represent the decisions, policy or views of the WHO. C.G. works for the Gates Foundation who funded this work. Apart from his involvement, the funder had no role in the design and conduct of the study; collection, management, analysis, and interpretation of the data; preparation, review, or approval of the manuscript; and decision to submit the manuscript for publication.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was fully supported by the Gates Foundation (INV-074429).

detail.abstract: Even though two widely used combination vaccines (measles-rubella- and diphtheria- tetanus-pertussis-containing vaccines) are universally acknowledged as the cornerstones of pediatric immunization programs, the development of new combination vaccines for children has not been a priority for manufacturers, policy bodies, or decision-makers. At the same time, economic evaluations have not assessed the full array of benefits and risks associated with combination vaccines. As part of an effort to identify and prioritize potential new combination vaccines, we aimed to enhance efforts to establish their value, a crucial step toward a more thorough, quantifiable, and realistic assessment of these vaccines.We reviewed the literature on economic evaluations of combination vaccines to more precisely identify and define current gaps in value assessment. We identified a set of (often unvalued) benefits and risks and created a list of value drivers and metrics for potential inclusion in future evaluations. Value drivers were then categorized based on how they resonate with decision-makers’ priorities and their contribution to product value. Metrics were categorized based on their quantifiability and their fit within existing economic evaluation frameworks. We developed a prioritized checklist of value drivers and metrics to assess combination vaccines through a consultative process involving numerous immunization stakeholders (e.g., immunization specialists, regional immunization advisors, policy bodies). The checklist was further refined through a convening of health economics experts and ultimately endorsed by the World Health Organization’s Immunization and Vaccines-related Implementation Research Advisory Committee.This checklist of prioritized value drivers and metrics is meant to serve as a tool for analysts to value combination vaccines and help ensure these vaccines are more comprehensively assessed by decision-makers to inform investment decisions or adoption.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个评估儿童联合疫苗价值的优先清单，旨在弥补当前经济评估中对联合疫苗全面价值评估的不足，为决策者提供更全面的评估工具。
AI.research_question: 如何更全面、量化地评估儿童联合疫苗的价值，以支持决策者的投资和采用决策？
AI.motivation: 尽管麻疹-风疹和白喉-破伤风-百日咳联合疫苗是儿科免疫计划的基石，但新型儿童联合疫苗的开发并未成为制造商、政策机构和决策者的优先事项，同时现有经济评估未能全面评估联合疫苗的效益和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价值评估理论，识别联合疫苗的价值驱动因素和评估指标，构建系统化的评估框架。
AI.method: 文献回顾识别价值评估缺口，识别未评估的效益和风险，创建价值驱动因素和指标清单，通过咨询流程（免疫专家、区域顾问、政策机构）制定优先清单，最终由WHO免疫和疫苗相关实施研究咨询委员会认可。
AI.findings: 开发了一个优先的价值驱动因素和指标清单，用于更全面地评估联合疫苗价值，该清单已获得WHO相关委员会的认可。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统化的联合疫苗价值评估框架，填补了现有经济评估的理论空白，为疫苗价值评估提供了新的理论视角和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析师提供了实用的评估工具，帮助决策者更全面地评估联合疫苗，支持投资决策和采用决策，促进新型联合疫苗的开发和推广。

detail.abstract: The rapidly increasing availability of large amounts of granular financial data, paired with the advances of big data related technologies induces the need of suitable analytics that can represent and extract meaningful information from such data. In this paper we propose a multi-layer network approach to distill the Euro Area (EA) banking system in different distinct layers. Each layer of the network represents a specific type of financial relationship between banks, based on various sources of EA granular data collections. The resulting multi-layer network allows one to describe, analyze and compare the topology and structure of EA banks from different perspectives, eventually yielding a more complete picture of the financial market. This granular information representation has the potential to enable researchers and practitioners to better apprehend financial system dynamics as well as to support financial policies to manage and monitor financial risk from a more holistic point of view.

detail.abstract: Can government agencies in sanctioning countries deter their companies from violating laws that limit business transactions with sanctioned countries? To understand this issue, we study the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), which is the primary enforcer of sanctions in the United States. OFAC announces a company’s violations and penalty only after it has successfully completed its investigation. We document that OFAC’s announcements were unanticipated and imposed reputational losses that could deter non-compliance throughout the industry when the penalties were large enough and when announcements were made at times when OFAC was being searched intensely on the internet. This suggests that a broader market sentiment sympathetic to OFAC’s mission of stopping financial crimes was necessary.

AI.tldr: 美国政府制裁执行机构OFAC通过公布企业违规和处罚信息，当处罚金额足够大且公布时机恰逢公众高度关注时，能够对企业声誉造成损失，从而威慑整个行业的不合规行为。
AI.research_question: 制裁国家的政府机构能否威慑其公司违反与受制裁国家商业交易限制的法律？
AI.motivation: 理解政府制裁执行机构如何有效威慑企业违规行为，特别是通过声誉机制影响整个行业的合规性。

AI.method: 研究美国外国资产控制办公室(OFAC)的执法实践，分析其违规公告的时间、处罚规模与互联网搜索强度的关系

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政府制裁执行机构通过声誉机制威慑企业违规的理论机制，强调了市场情绪在执法有效性中的关键作用

detail.abstract:
We present a framework for text-native visual communication through lossless binary-to-text serialization. By encoding images as Base85 text with adaptive ZLIB compression detection, we enable universal transmission via text-only channels while maintaining pixel-perfect fidelity.

Key contributions: (1) Adaptive compression detection that automatically identifies pre-compressed formats (JPEG, WebP) and bypasses redundant compression, reducing overhead from 33% (Base64) to 25% (Base85); (2) Universal compatibility enabling image transmission through any text channel (JSON APIs, email, chat, SMS) without protocol modification; (3) Experimental demonstration of emergent AI capability where a large language model autonomously recognized and decoded a serialized image format without explicit instruction, reconstructing a 1024×1024 JPEG (366,976 bytes) from 458,720 text characters with 100% byte-perfect fidelity; (4) Transmission latency reduction of 7.6× compared to traditional multipart/form-data protocols.

Furthermore, we demonstrate a critical application for low-bandwidth aerospace environments: by utilizing WebP as the base format within our pipeline, we achieved a 90.3% reduction in payload size (44KB vs 366KB) compared to standard JPEG, enabling high-fidelity satellite imagery transmission via plain text telemetry.

This approach enables novel communication modalities: visual data flows through text-only channels, LLMs process images natively as token sequences, blockchain smart contracts store images as immutable strings, and archival systems achieve format-independent 602-year retention through plain-text durability. Our work challenges the conventional binary/text dichotomy in data transmission and demonstrates that visual communication can be text-native, instantaneous, and universally compatible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个文本原生视觉通信框架，通过无损二进制到文本序列化技术，将图像编码为Base85文本并采用自适应ZLIB压缩检测，实现在纯文本通道中的通用传输，同时保持像素级完美保真度。
AI.research_question: 如何通过文本原生方式实现视觉通信，在保持像素级保真度的同时，通过纯文本通道传输图像数据？
AI.motivation: 传统视觉通信依赖二进制数据传输，存在协议限制和兼容性问题。需要一种能够在任何文本通道（JSON API、电子邮件、聊天、SMS）中传输图像的方法，同时保持高保真度和传输效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 文本原生视觉通信理论；2. 无损二进制到文本序列化；3. 自适应压缩检测机制；4. 通用文本通道传输理论；5. 大语言模型对序列化图像的自主识别能力。
AI.method: 1. 使用Base85文本编码替代传统Base64；2. 自适应ZLIB压缩检测，识别预压缩格式（JPEG、WebP）并绕过冗余压缩；3. 实验验证：通过大语言模型自主解码序列化图像；4. 性能对比：与传统multipart/form-data协议比较传输延迟；5. 航空航天应用案例：低带宽环境下WebP格式优化。
AI.findings: 1. 自适应压缩检测将开销从Base64的33%降低到Base85的25%；2. 大语言模型能够自主识别并解码序列化图像格式，从458,720个文本字符中100%字节完美重建1024×1024 JPEG图像；3. 传输延迟比传统协议减少7.6倍；4. 在航空航天应用中，使用WebP格式实现90.3%的有效载荷减少（44KB vs 366KB）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战传统的二进制/文本二分法数据传输范式；2. 提出文本原生视觉通信理论框架；3. 证明大语言模型对序列化图像的自主处理能力；4. 建立自适应压缩检测的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 实现任何文本通道的通用图像传输；2. 为低带宽航空航天环境提供高效解决方案；3. 支持新颖通信模式：LLM以标记序列原生处理图像、区块链智能合约将图像存储为不可变字符串、归档系统通过纯文本实现602年格式独立保留；4. 显著降低传输延迟和带宽需求。

title: Do local fuel prices affect remote working behaviors and carbon emission savings? Evidence from German panel data
affiliations: and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Do local fuel prices affect remote working behaviors and carbon emission savings? Evidence from German panel data
detail.abstract: Given the importance of the transport sector for greenhouse gas emissions, both behavioral change will be needed to mitigate climate change in addition to technological innovation. We focus on the case of remote working as a less carbon-intensive substitute to commuting and analyze whether employees react to price incentives and work more from home in times of higher local fuel prices. Applying an instrumental variables approach based on panel data from Germany, we find moderate fuel price effects on remote working frequency, which are restricted to occupations with high skill-level and regions with limited alternatives to car commuting. We use these results to predict changes in remote working frequency as a consequence to increasing carbon prices as discussed for climate policy. Results indicate that even with ambitious carbon pricing, individual remote working frequency will increase modestly, causing only limited reductions in German national aggregate fuel and carbon emissions.

AI.tldr: 研究德国远程工作对燃料价格的反应，发现价格激励对远程工作频率影响有限，仅在高技能职业和汽车通勤替代有限的地区有效。碳定价政策下远程工作增加有限，对减排贡献不大。
AI.research_question: 员工是否会因当地燃料价格上涨而增加远程工作频率？碳定价政策能否通过激励远程工作显著减少交通碳排放？
AI.motivation: 交通部门是温室气体排放的重要来源，除了技术创新外，行为改变对减缓气候变化也很重要。远程工作作为通勤的低碳替代方案，研究其价格敏感性有助于评估碳定价政策的减排潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格激励理论，假设燃料价格上涨会增加远程工作的经济吸引力；考虑职业特征和地区交通基础设施的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用德国面板数据，采用工具变量方法分析燃料价格对远程工作频率的影响，控制职业技能水平和地区交通替代性等调节因素。
AI.findings: 燃料价格对远程工作频率的影响有限，仅在高技能职业和汽车通勤替代有限的地区显著；碳定价政策下远程工作增加幅度有限，对德国总体燃料消耗和碳排放的减少作用不大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了价格激励对远程工作行为的影响存在边界条件，强调了职业特征和地区基础设施的调节作用；为理解低碳行为改变的限制因素提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者不应过度依赖碳定价通过远程工作激励实现交通减排；需要结合其他措施如改善公共交通、支持低技能职业远程工作等综合策略。

title: Training Teachers in Child Protection Matters: The Relationship Between Training and Contacting Child Protection Authorities
affiliations: University of Limerick - Mary Immaculate College, University of Limerick - Mary Immaculate College and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Training Teachers in Child Protection Matters: The Relationship Between Training and Contacting Child Protection Authorities
detail.abstract: Background: Research shows that teachers often lack the required knowledge and skills to consistently identify suspected cases of child abuse and neglect, and that teachers receive inadequate training. However, little research exists about the relationship between child protection training and teachers’ subsequent actions in contacting authorities.Objectives: This study examined 1) whether receiving child protection training predicts an increase in the likelihood that teachers will contact authorities and 2) whether in-person training predicts an increase in the likelihood that teachers will contact authorities.Participants and setting: 647 Designated Liaison Persons (DLPs), typically the school principal, from Irish primary schools completed an online questionnaire.Methods: Chi-squares of independence and binomial regression analysis were conducted on variables related to training and to contacting child protection authorities.Results: We detected statistically significant associations between receiving training and three subsequent actions: seeking advice; making a referral; and making a referral without advice. Statistically significant associations were also found between training modality and these actions with the lowest levels of advice seeking and referring amongst those who received online training only. Binomial logistic regression results show that receiving training was a non-significant positive predictor of contacting authorities for all three actions. Attending multiple modes of training was a statistically significant positive predictor of all three actions whilst attending in-person training was a statistically significant positive predictor of making a referral.Conclusion: This research makes unique contributions to literature by expanding knowledge in relation to child protection training for teachers and subsequent contact with authorities.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了儿童保护培训与教师后续联系当局行为之间的关系，发现接受培训（特别是多种模式培训）能显著提高教师寻求建议和转介的可能性。
AI.research_question: 1) 接受儿童保护培训是否预测教师联系当局的可能性增加？2) 面对面培训是否预测教师联系当局的可能性增加？
AI.motivation: 研究表明教师通常缺乏识别儿童虐待和忽视案件所需的知识和技能，且培训不足。但关于儿童保护培训与教师后续联系当局行为之间关系的研究很少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于儿童保护培训效果的理论框架，探讨培训形式（在线、面对面、混合）对教师专业行为的影响。
AI.method: 对647名爱尔兰小学指定联络人（通常是校长）进行在线问卷调查，使用卡方独立性检验和二项回归分析培训变量与联系儿童保护当局行为之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 接受培训与三种后续行为（寻求建议、转介、无建议转介）存在显著关联；2) 培训形式与这些行为显著相关，仅接受在线培训的教师寻求建议和转介水平最低；3) 接受培训对所有三种行为的预测作用为正但不显著；4) 参加多种模式培训对所有三种行为是显著正向预测因子；5) 参加面对面培训对转介行为是显著正向预测因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了关于教师儿童保护培训与后续联系当局行为之间关系的知识，为培训效果理论提供了实证支持，特别是培训形式对专业行为的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构设计有效的儿童保护培训项目提供依据，建议采用多种培训模式（特别是面对面培训）以提高教师识别和报告儿童虐待案件的能力。

title: Unexpected Duet? Constitutions and Investment Treaties as the Backbone of Latin American Extractivist Legality
affiliations: Escuela de Derecho, Universidad de Valparaíso, Universidad Diego Portales and Universidad de Valparaíso - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Unexpected Duet? Constitutions and Investment Treaties as the Backbone of Latin American Extractivist Legality
detail.abstract: Calls to defend sovereignty from international investment treaties are common in Latin America. Many protest that states are often put in the difficult position to choose between their constitution and foreign investment, reducing the spaces for genuine democratic emancipation. This article proposes that we, Latin Americans, have been misguided by this representation. Extractivism, perhaps the major barrier to Latin American emancipation, thrives because of constitutions and international investment treaties. These two legal orders create a legal imagination and enact the legal rules necessary for nature’s exploitation. In this article, we map how constitutions and investment treaties consolidate and reproduce extractivism, recognizing that constitutions provide some means for a paradigm shift, for instance, through environmental activism or constitutional reforms. However, global and domestic extractivist elites can always rely on investment law to counter unwanted environmental measures or resist transformative moments, locking in the present extractivist mode of accumulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了拉美地区关于国际投资条约威胁主权的普遍观点，认为宪法和国际投资条约共同构成了阻碍拉美解放的"采掘主义"法律框架，两者相互强化维持资源开采模式。
AI.research_question: 宪法和国际投资条约如何共同构成并维持拉美地区的"采掘主义"（extractivism）模式，阻碍真正的民主解放？
AI.motivation: 拉美地区普遍认为国际投资条约威胁国家主权，迫使国家在宪法和外国投资之间做出艰难选择，限制了民主解放空间。但作者认为这种观点误导了人们，实际上宪法和投资条约共同构成了采掘主义的法律基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采掘主义理论、法律与政治经济学、宪法与国际投资法交叉分析、法律想象（legal imagination）概念、积累模式锁定理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、制度映射（mapping）、批判性法律分析、拉美案例研究
AI.findings: 1. 宪法和国际投资条约共同创造支持自然资源开采的法律想象和法律规则；2. 两者相互强化，巩固和再生产采掘主义模式；3. 虽然宪法提供了一些范式转变的可能（如环境行动主义或宪法改革），但全球和国内采掘主义精英总能依靠投资法来抵制不受欢迎的环境措施或变革时刻；4. 投资法将当前的采掘主义积累模式"锁定"在现有状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了拉美关于投资条约威胁主权的传统叙事；2. 提出宪法与投资条约共同构成采掘主义法律框架的新理论视角；3. 发展了"法律想象"在维持采掘主义中的作用理论；4. 揭示了法律秩序如何"锁定"特定积累模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拉美社会运动提供更准确的法律斗争策略分析；2. 揭示环境行动主义和宪法改革的局限性；3. 指出需要同时挑战宪法和投资条约才能实现真正的解放；4. 为政策制定者提供理解法律体系如何维持采掘主义的框架。

title: Enforcement Challenges in Withholding Tax Administration in Low-Income Countries

detail.title: Enforcement Challenges in Withholding Tax Administration in Low-Income Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: WHT is a crucial development in revenue mobilisation in the form of a tool to ensure taxpayer compliance and a revenue source in low-income economies. Emerging economies tend to lack the strategies to enforce efficiency in the administrative layers of revenue systems. Consequently, this undermines the effectiveness of revenue systems in low-income regions. This study addresses these concerns through a comparative qualitative and doctrinal study of the design and enforcement of frameworks of WHT in a number of underdeveloped economies. Deficiencies in the systems design, enforcement of compliance, and taxpayer education are the most prominent interrelated features impeding effectiveness in the WHT in the economies. These deficiencies reinforce taxpayer noncompliance with WHT and revenue withdrawal, which is representative of the potential of WHT in revenue mobilisation in the economy. The study offers the conclusion that revenue mobilisation in the economy can be advanced by accomplishing these identified challenges of enforcement of WHT systems by improving strategies of education toward WHT compliance, digital systems in reporting WHT to the respective revenue agencies, and strengthening reporting audits and their follow-up systems. These conclusions are underscored by the provision of practical measures to improve the compliance of the economy of the systems. The study introduces the perspective of advanced systems for the compliance of taxpayer education through long-term assessments of systems to determine WHT effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过比较定性分析发现，欠发达经济体的预扣税系统在制度设计、合规执行和纳税人教育方面存在缺陷，这些缺陷相互关联并削弱了预扣税在财政收入动员中的有效性。研究建议通过改进教育策略、数字化报告系统和加强审计来提升预扣税合规性。
AI.research_question: 欠发达经济体的预扣税（WHT）系统在设计和执行方面存在哪些缺陷，这些缺陷如何影响预扣税在财政收入动员中的有效性？

Unlike quantifiable risk, fear operates as a behavioral and informational externality: it is socially contagious, narrative-dependent, resistant to traditional due diligence, and institutionalized through lending, appraisal, and regulatory practices. This results in severe asset mispricing, prolonged blight, public-sector fiscal burdens, and the loss of socially beneficial redevelopment outcomes. keywords: Chinese stock market JEL Classifications: G14

publicationDetails.detailsText: Review of Pacific Basin Financial Markets and Policies, Forthcoming.

detail.abstract: Although the prices of Chinese H shares dual listed in Hong Kong are more informative for future earnings than their A-share twins, we find that this difference is driven by Hshare investors being better able to incorporate information already disclosed by firms-rather than new information-into stock prices. H shares exhibit higher forecasting price efficiency (FPE)-but not revelatory price efficiency (RPE)-relative to their A-share twins. This result is not due to the inability of Chinese managers to learn from stock prices in general-as non-dual-listed A-share managers do use information from stock prices to improve real efficiency: Not only do Chinese managers pay attention to their share prices when making investment decisions, but the investments they undertake in response to their share prices strongly predict future earnings. Overall, foreign investors have neither incorporated new information into dual-listed Chinese firms' stock prices, nor contributed to the enhancement of their real efficiency.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，虽然香港H股价格对未来盈利的预测能力优于A股，但这种优势主要来自H股投资者能更好地利用公司已披露信息，而非获取新信息。H股在预测价格效率（FPE）上优于A股，但在揭示价格效率（RPE）上没有差异。中国管理者普遍会关注股价信息来改善投资决策，但双重上市公司的外国投资者既未为股价带来新信息，也未提升公司实际效率。
AI.research_question: 外国投资者在双重上市的中国公司中，是否通过股价信息传递机制提升了公司信息效率和实际经营效率？
AI.motivation: 研究双重上市的中国公司中，外国投资者（通过H股）与国内投资者（通过A股）在信息处理和价格发现能力上的差异，以及这种差异是否真正提升了公司的实际经营效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格效率理论，区分预测价格效率（FPE）和揭示价格效率（RPE）；公司治理中的股价信息传递机制；外国投资者与国内投资者的信息处理能力差异。
AI.method: 比较双重上市的中国公司A股和H股的价格效率差异，使用面板数据回归分析，区分FPE和RPE的测量，并检验股价信息对公司投资决策和未来盈利的影响。
AI.findings: 1. H股价格对未来盈利的预测能力优于A股，但这种优势主要来自H股投资者能更好地利用公司已披露信息；2. H股在FPE上优于A股，但在RPE上没有显著差异；3. 中国管理者普遍会利用股价信息改善投资决策，投资反应能预测未来盈利；4. 双重上市公司的外国投资者既未为股价带来新信息，也未提升公司实际效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了价格效率的两种维度（FPE和RPE），揭示了外国投资者在信息处理上的真实能力；2. 挑战了外国投资者必然带来信息优势的传统观点；3. 为双重上市公司的信息效率研究提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者，单纯引入外国投资者不一定能提升公司信息效率和实际经营效率；2. 为投资者提供了更准确评估不同市场股票信息含量的方法；3. 帮助公司管理者理解不同投资者群体的信息处理特点。

detail.abstract: Complying with corporate tax regulations is one of the key challenges of domestic revenue mobilisation in most of the emerging and developing economies due to the weakness in compliance regulations needed to adhere to and the tax audits of the system involved. The purpose of this study is to ascertain the role of audit mechanisms in corporate tax compliance using both empirical and doctrinal mechanisms to measure different types of audit measures. Using the case study approach, legal frameworks, and literature, Modugu and Awyaduba. (2014), and Kotsogiannis and others (2024), this study analysed the interactions of audit frequency, type of audit, enforcement, and the laissez-faire of corporate governance mechanisms, mechanisms of educating taxpayers, and compliance. The findings of this study conclude that compliance has an audit that is further influenced by the governance system of corporate entities, the level of education of the taxpaying public, and the deliberate placement of audit compliance resources. This study suggests that there is transparency of governance, education of taxpayers, and audit mechanisms that yield compliance that is further elevated by the system of governance of corporate entities, which is measured and enhanced. Therefore, this study suggests that there is a need for tax audit mechanisms to focus on the education systems being developed around compliance mechanisms. This study attempts to measure and increase domestic revenue mobilisation by enhancing corporate tax compliance. This has been achieved by using the works of Hauptman and others (2014) and Oduro and others (2024).

title: Identification Challenges in Estimating Returns to Education
affiliations: Delhi Public School, Bangalore East

detail.title: Identification Challenges in Estimating Returns to Education
detail.abstract: This paper examines the central identification challenges involved in estimating the causal returns to education. While a positive association between schooling and earnings is well established, isolating causal effects is complicated by unobserved ability, family background, measurement error, selection into education and employment, and heterogeneity in returns. Using insights from the modern empirical literature, the paper critically evaluates commonly employed econometric strategies including ordinary least squares, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity designs, and longitudinal approaches and assesses the parameters they identify. The analysis highlights that different empirical strategies recover distinct causal effects for different subpopulations, implying that variation in estimated returns across studies often reflects differences in identification rather than conflicting evidence. Recent advances, such as marginal treatment effects and distributional methods, further demonstrate that returns to education are heterogeneous across individuals and over the life cycle. The paper also emphasizes the role of high-quality administrative and panel data in improving identification and interpretation. Overall, the paper argues that credible estimation of returns to education requires careful alignment between research questions, data, and identification strategies. By clarifying what different methods identify and for whom, the paper contributes to a more transparent and policy-relevant interpretation of empirical estimates of educational returns.

title: Problems And Policies Of Development In Nigeria

detail.title: Problems And Policies Of Development In Nigeria
detail.abstract:
This book, Problems and Policies of Development in Nigeria arose as an effort to place a finger on the constant economic problems facing many African countries like Nigeria and to demystify some of these pieces of problems. The book is intended to be concise but provides a comprehensive tour of economic problems in Nigeria. It focuses on the problems that affect jobs, prices, and trade. It also raises voices in boardrooms and bars, among politicians and pundits, about the economic problems that touch our day-to-day lives and more especially our standard of living.It is general knowledge that development is more about improvements in the qualitative dimension of human life, which may not necessarily correspond to the quantitative (amount of goods and services produced that can be exchanged for value over a given period). Therefore, it implies that any developmental stride that is not geared towards creating value for the benefit of the citizens will not be termed economic development. Economic development has witnessed a lot of abuse over the years. Developing countries like Nigeria have unique problems that require local solutions that are different from those offered by conventional developed-world economics. Development has long been a catch-all phrase, and it now seems that everybody has something to say on the subject. It is indeed crucial to know what one is talking about if only to allow for the differentiation of development from economic growth, with which it is equated all too often. It is believed that the apparent failure of some development programs can be attributed to precisely this misunderstanding surrounding the notion of development itself. The book highlights some of the development problems facing Nigeria as well as some policies that can help to ameliorate them. The book is divided into two different sections. The first section discusses the problems of development, while the meaning of development and its objectives are clearly stated. It also discusses some of the problems and challenges confronting many developing countries like Nigeria, such as poverty (the vicious circle of poverty), inequality, low rates of capital formation, social-cultural constraints, agricultural constraints, corruption, foreign exchange constraints, and human resources constraints to development. 

The second section deals with policies that have been employed and will be employed to help these countries, especially Nigeria, out of these problems. It has other chapters that include: SDGS, HDI, eradication of corruption, economic reform and development, policies of urbanization, rural-urban migration, human capital, economic development, and new world industrial policies, etc. The authors of this book are seasoned economists and practical field surveyors with decades of experience. I hope that the readers of this book will find it rewarding and enriching as they traverse through the sections. They also hope that economics and development teachers will find this book a better fit to teach the subject ‘problems and policies of development’ in economics. Future researchers will find this text handy in their quest to explore the dynamics of development and underdevelopment.

title: The Pillar Two Regime in the Post-Implementation Era: Structural Mechanics and Geopolitical Fragmentation (2026)

detail.title: The Pillar Two Regime in the Post-Implementation Era: Structural Mechanics and Geopolitical Fragmentation (2026)
detail.abstract: Pillar Two of the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework establishes a 15% global minimum effective tax through the Global Anti-Base Erosion (GloBE) Model Rules. This paper analyzes the regime’s structural mechanics in the post-implementation era of 2026. It explains the hierarchy of enforcement, from the Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) to the Income Inclusion Rule (IIR) and Undertaxed Profits Rule (UTPR), and evaluates administrative guidance issued in 2024 and the Subject to Tax Rule multilateral instrument. The study contrasts the EU’s transposition via Directive 2022/2523 with Asia‑Pacific adoption of defensive QDMTTs, and highlights how emerging subsidies such as Marketable Transferable Tax Credits and divergent approaches under the UN Tax Convention threaten the regime’s long-term stability.

AI.tldr: 本文分析OECD/G20包容性框架支柱二（全球最低税）在2026年实施后的结构机制，重点研究执行层级、行政指导、地区实施差异，以及新兴补贴和联合国税收公约对制度稳定性的威胁。

AI.findings: 1. 支柱二执行存在层级结构：QDMTT优先于IIR和UTPR；2. 欧盟通过指令统一实施，而亚太地区采用防御性QDMTTs；3. 2024年行政指导和STTR多边文书提供操作指引；4. 新兴补贴（如可交易税收抵免）和联合国税收公约的差异方法威胁制度长期稳定。

detail.title: Dutch Disease and the Resource Curse: The Progression of Views from Exchange Rates to Women's Agency and Well-Being
detail.abstract: This article provides an overview of the history of economic thought on natural resource extraction, which has long been considered an enclave industry with few benefits for areas beyond the local economy. We focus on more recent scholarship examining the social impacts of natural resource extraction, emphasizing gender-related outcomes and determinants. An important lesson from this scholarship is that it is difficult to discuss sustainable development in its contemporary sense without paying due diligence to the gender dimensions of natural resource extraction. A lesson highlighted is that the "resource curse" view of natural capital may not be as pervasive as previously thought.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了自然资源开采经济思想的历史演变，特别关注近期研究中对社会影响（尤其是性别相关结果）的探讨，指出性别维度对可持续发展的重要性，并挑战了"资源诅咒"的普遍性观点。
AI.research_question: 自然资源开采的社会影响（特别是性别维度）如何影响可持续发展？自然资源开采是否必然导致"资源诅咒"？
AI.motivation: 传统上自然资源开采被视为"飞地产业"，对当地经济以外地区益处有限。近期研究开始关注其社会影响，特别是性别相关结果，这对理解可持续发展的性别维度至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 自然资源开采经济思想史；2. 飞地产业理论；3. 资源诅咒理论；4. 性别与发展理论；5. 可持续发展理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统梳理自然资源开采经济思想的历史演变和近期研究，特别关注性别维度的社会影响研究。
AI.findings: 1. 自然资源开采的性别维度对可持续发展至关重要；2. "资源诅咒"观点可能不如先前认为的那么普遍；3. 需要更细致地分析自然资源开采的社会影响，特别是性别相关结果
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将性别维度纳入自然资源开采经济分析框架；2. 挑战"资源诅咒"理论的普遍适用性；3. 拓展可持续发展理论的社会维度
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供考虑性别影响的自然资源管理建议；2. 帮助识别自然资源开采中可能被忽视的社会效益；3. 促进更全面的可持续发展评估框架

detail.title: Private Sector Development and Policy Actions in Timor-Leste: Lessons from a Business Mapping Survey

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 837

detail.abstract: This paper empirically investigates what drives the growth of private businesses in Timor-Leste and the policy actions needed to facilitate growth amid global uncertainty, especially for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). It uses the linear probability model (LPM) to identify the MSME growth structure and the Oaxaca decomposition to reveal detailed growth factors by firm type in determining which policy areas need to be strengthened. Estimation results show that four types of MSMEs—those formalized, digitalized, internationalized, and women-led —exhibit different business characteristics and performance results compared with control groups. Accordingly, policy support areas differ by firm type, with a focused approach critical in designing and delivering policy assistance to MSMEs in Timor-Leste. The study suggests policy implications to consider when designing an evidence-based MSME policy framework that can maximize the benefits from the country’s recent accession to Association of Southeast Asian Nations membership.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究东帝汶私营企业增长驱动因素及政策需求，特别关注微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）。研究发现正规化、数字化、国际化和女性领导四类MSMEs具有不同特征，需要差异化的政策支持。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动东帝汶私营企业增长？在全球不确定性背景下，需要哪些政策行动来促进微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）的增长？
AI.motivation: 东帝汶作为新加入东盟的国家，需要制定基于证据的MSME政策框架以最大化区域一体化利益。全球不确定性环境下，了解MSMEs增长驱动因素对政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业增长理论、MSME发展理论、政策干预理论，结合线性概率模型（LPM）和Oaxaca分解方法分析企业增长结构。
AI.method: 使用线性概率模型（LPM）识别MSME增长结构，采用Oaxaca分解方法按企业类型揭示详细增长因素，确定需要加强的政策领域。
AI.findings: 正规化、数字化、国际化和女性领导的四类MSMEs在商业特征和绩效表现上与对照组存在显著差异。不同企业类型需要不同的政策支持领域，政策设计需要有针对性的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了发展中国家MSME增长理论，特别是针对东帝汶这样的新兴经济体。提供了按企业类型分解增长因素的实证方法，丰富了企业异质性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东帝汶政府设计基于证据的MSME政策框架提供具体建议，帮助政策制定者针对不同企业类型提供差异化支持，最大化东盟成员国身份带来的利益。

title: U.S. Quantitative Easing and Foreign Portfolios: Evidence from Treasury Holdings and Exchange Rates
affiliations: ,  and Independent

detail.title: U.S. Quantitative Easing and Foreign Portfolios: Evidence from Treasury Holdings and Exchange Rates
detail.abstract: This paper documents the international spillovers of U.S. quantitative easing (QE) using publicly available Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) and exchange rate movements from 2008 to 2023. Combining QE intensity measures with foreign holdings of U.S. Treasuries from FRED, we estimate the response of both official and private investors to balance-sheet expansions by the Federal Reserve. A one percentage point increase in QE intensity, measured as the Fed's share of outstanding Treasuries, reduces total foreign Treasury holdings by 0.27 percent, with significant responses from both official (0.23 percent) and private (0.38 percent) investors. QE shocks also generate a depreciation of the U.S. dollar of around 1.0 percent over a six to nine month horizon. These findings provide concise evidence that U.S. QE has sizable cross-border portfolio and exchange rate effects.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2008-2023年美联储经济数据和汇率变动，量化分析了美国量化宽松的国际溢出效应。研究发现，美联储资产负债表扩张会减少外国投资者持有的美国国债，并导致美元贬值。
AI.research_question: 美国量化宽松政策如何影响外国投资者对美国国债的持有以及美元汇率？
AI.motivation: 量化宽松作为非常规货币政策工具，其国际溢出效应尚未得到充分量化，需要实证证据来理解其对全球资本流动和汇率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际资本流动理论和货币政策传导机制，分析量化宽松通过资产组合再平衡渠道对国际投资者的影响。
AI.method: 使用2008-2023年美联储公开经济数据（FRED）和汇率数据，结合量化宽松强度指标（美联储持有国债份额）和外国投资者国债持有数据，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 量化宽松强度每增加1个百分点，外国投资者持有的美国国债总量减少0.27%，其中官方投资者减少0.23%，私人投资者减少0.38%。量化宽松冲击还会在6-9个月内导致美元贬值约1.0%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为量化宽松的国际溢出效应提供了实证证据，丰富了货币政策国际传导的理论框架，特别是对官方和私人投资者反应的差异化分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化宽松跨境影响的量化参考，有助于各国央行更好地协调货币政策，管理资本流动和汇率风险。

title: Multi-Agency Coordination Modeling for Urban Disaster Management Using AI

detail.title: Multi-Agency Coordination Modeling for Urban Disaster Management Using AI
detail.abstract: This research focuses on the implications of fragmented multi-agency coordination during urban disasters on situational awareness and operational efficacy (Steigenberger, Alamdar et al.). This research falls within the primary gaps of the command-and-control frameworks; the inability to cope with the fluidity of the information, cross-jurisdictional actors, and the fast-changing risk configurations of the urban environment (Steigenberger, Alamdar et al.). To meet this gap, the author proposes and attempts to evaluate, on conceptual grounds, an AI-based coordination model framework incorporating NG911 data streams, GIS-based spatial reasoning, and agentic AI (Ocal and Torun; Li et al.). This methodology includes structured literature synthesis, comparative coordination framework analysis, and disaster informatics model construction (Pak and Mostafavi; Alamdar et al.). In complex urban disaster environments, AI coordination models improve synchronisation of cross-agency responses and situational awareness in real time (Pak and Mostafavi; Ocal and Torun). With regard to data interoperability, algorithmic opacity, fragmentation of governance, and unequal institutional capacities, the analyses point to recurring, unresolved issues (Li et al.; Steigenberger). These issues underscore the socio-technical dimension of the disaster coordination infrastructures and the limited effectiveness, in isolation, of particular elements of an AI system (Steigenberger, Pak, and Mostafavi) As AI-powered coordination is an important step in the progression of urban disaster management, the authors argue, it is even more critical to integrate institutions, standardize the governance of data, and establish trust for inter-organizational collaboration (Li et al.; Steigenberger).

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨城市灾害中多机构协调碎片化对态势感知和运营效能的影响，提出并评估基于AI的协调模型框架，整合NG911数据流、GIS空间推理和智能体AI，强调需要解决数据互操作性、算法不透明性和治理碎片化等社会技术问题。
AI.research_question: 城市灾害中多机构协调碎片化如何影响态势感知和运营效能？基于AI的协调模型框架能否改善跨机构响应同步和实时态势感知？
AI.motivation: 现有指挥控制框架无法应对信息流动性、跨辖区参与者和城市环境快速变化的风险配置，需要新的协调方法来应对城市灾害管理的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 指挥控制理论、灾害信息学、多机构协调理论、社会技术系统理论、AI协调模型理论。
AI.method: 结构化文献综述、协调框架比较分析、灾害信息学模型构建、概念性评估。
AI.findings: AI协调模型能改善复杂城市灾害环境中的跨机构响应同步和实时态势感知，但面临数据互操作性、算法不透明性、治理碎片化和机构能力不均等持续未解决的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出整合NG911数据流、GIS空间推理和智能体AI的AI协调模型框架，强调灾害协调基础设施的社会技术维度，指出AI系统孤立元素的有限有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市灾害管理提供AI协调模型实施路径，强调需要整合机构、标准化数据治理、建立跨组织协作信任，以推进AI驱动的协调系统在实际应用中的有效性。

title: Spatial Vulnerability of the U.S. Meatpacking Industry
affiliations: Purdue University, Oklahoma State University and Purdue University

detail.title: Spatial Vulnerability of the U.S. Meatpacking Industry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding to declare.

detail.abstract: The U.S. meatpacking industry is part of a complex supply chain, and understanding its vulnerability requires considering internal and external factors that vary spatially. We present the county-level Meatpacking Risk Index, which identifies the spatial vulnerability of the industry. This index incorporates potential output loss, social vulnerability, and county resilience. Among the counties analyzed, 376 are classified as high-risk and 1,445 as low-risk for meatpacking production. Our validation confirms the index's ability to differentiate between high-and low-risk counties in terms of product losses from shocks. Governments and investors can use the index to reduce meatpacking vulnerabilities and attract investments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了县级肉类加工风险指数，用于识别美国肉类加工行业的空间脆弱性。该指数结合潜在产出损失、社会脆弱性和县域韧性，将376个县分类为高风险，1,445个县为低风险。验证表明指数能有效区分高低风险县的冲击损失，为政府和投资者提供决策工具。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和评估美国肉类加工行业的空间脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 美国肉类加工行业作为复杂供应链的一部分，其脆弱性受内外因素的空间差异影响，需要系统评估工具来识别风险区域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链脆弱性理论、空间风险分析和韧性理论，构建多维度的风险评估框架。
AI.method: 开发县级肉类加工风险指数，整合潜在产出损失、社会脆弱性和县域韧性三个维度，对各县进行风险分类。
AI.findings: 在分析的县中，376个被分类为高风险，1,445个为低风险；指数验证显示能有效区分高低风险县在冲击下的产品损失差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合空间、经济和社会维度的肉类加工行业脆弱性评估理论框架，扩展了供应链风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和投资者提供具体工具，用于识别高风险区域、制定针对性干预措施、吸引投资和增强行业韧性。

title: Tracing the Genetic Footprints of the UK National Health Service
affiliations: , University of Bologna, University of Bologna, Bocconi University, University of Bristol and University of Turin

detail.title: Tracing the Genetic Footprints of the UK National Health Service

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research has been conducted using the UK Biobank Resource under Application Number 74002.
declarations.funderStatement: The project is funded by the Italian Ministry of Universities and Research (MUR) through PRIN 2022 – PNRR (CUP: J53D23015110001, PI: De Cao). De Cao and von Hinke additionally acknowledge support from the ERC under grant agreement No. 101170376 (HARSH) and 851725 (DONNI) respectively. This research is also supported by the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Sklodowska-Curie grant agreement (ES-SGN 101073237).

detail.abstract: The establishment of the UK National Health Service (NHS) in July 1948 was one of the most consequential health policy interventions of the twentieth century, providing universal and free access to medical care and substantially expanding maternal and infant health services. In this paper, we estimate the causal effect of the NHS introduction on early-life mortality and we test whether survival is selective. We adopt a regression discontinuity design under local randomization, comparing individuals born just before and just after July 1948. Leveraging newly digitized weekly death records, we document a significant decline in stillbirths and infant mortality following the introduction of the NHS, the latter driven primarily by reductions in deaths from congenital conditions and diarrhea. We then use polygenic indexes (PGIs), fixed at conception, to track changes in population composition, showing that cohorts born at or after the NHS introduction exhibit higher PGIs associated with contextually-adverse traits (e.g., depression, COPD, and preterm birth) and lower PGIs associated with contextually-valued traits (e.g., educational attainment, self-rated health, and pregnancy length), with effect sizes as large as 7.5% of a standard deviation. These results based on the UK Biobank data are robust to family-based designs and replicate in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing and the UK Household Longitudinal Study. Effects are strongest in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas and among males. This novel evidence on the existence and magnitude of selective survival highlights how large-scale public policies can leave a persistent imprint on population composition and generate long-term survival biases.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用断点回归设计，发现英国国民医疗服务体系(NHS)的建立显著降低了死产率和婴儿死亡率，但导致了选择性生存现象——存活下来的婴儿在基因上更倾向于具有不利特质（如抑郁、COPD）和更低的教育程度等有利特质基因评分。
AI.research_question: NHS的引入对早期生命死亡率有何因果影响？存活是否具有选择性？
AI.motivation: NHS是20世纪最重要的卫生政策干预之一，提供全民免费医疗并大幅扩展母婴健康服务，但其对早期死亡率的因果影响及是否存在选择性生存尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择性生存理论、公共卫生政策评估理论、断点回归设计理论、基因与环境交互作用理论
AI.method: 采用局部随机化下的断点回归设计，比较1948年7月前后出生的个体；利用新数字化的周死亡记录和英国生物银行等数据，结合多基因指数分析种群组成变化
AI.findings: 1. NHS引入后死产率和婴儿死亡率显著下降；2. 婴儿死亡率下降主要由先天性疾病和腹泻死亡减少驱动；3. NHS后出生队列显示出更高的不利特质多基因指数和更低的有利特质多基因指数；4. 效应在社会经济弱势地区和男性中最强
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了大规模公共政策导致选择性生存的实证证据，揭示了政策如何通过改变种群组成产生长期生存偏差，为基因-环境交互研究提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策评估提供了新维度，提示政策制定者需要考虑医疗干预可能带来的种群组成变化和长期遗传后果，对医疗资源分配和健康公平政策有重要启示

title: CAN CORPORATIONS BE TRUSTED? VOLUNTARY COMPLIANCE AND THE LIMITS OF NON-COERCIVE BUSINESS REGULATION
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: CAN CORPORATIONS BE TRUSTED? VOLUNTARY COMPLIANCE AND THE LIMITS OF NON-COERCIVE BUSINESS REGULATION

keywords: A DIFFERENTIATED FRAMEWORK FOR CORPORATE REGULATION A
Algorithmic Regulation and Corporate Trust CONCLUSION

Voluntary Compliance; Corporate Regulation; Behavioral Ethics; Trust-Based Regulation; Corporate Governance; Fiduciary Duties; Reputational Enforcement; Non-Coercive Regulation; Regulatory Design; Organizational Misconduct; Securities Regulation; Environmental Compliance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bar Ilan University Faculty of Law Research Paper No. 6174323
publicationDetails.journalName: Bar-Ilan University Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This Article extends the voluntary compliance framework developed in Can the Public Be Trusted? The Promise and Perils of Voluntary Compliance to the corporate context. While recent scholarship has explored when states can rely on non-coercive regulatory approaches with individual citizens, comparatively little attention has been paid to whether these insights translate to business entities. This Article argues that corporations present both greater challenges and greater opportunities for voluntary compliance regimes. On one hand, the instrumental orientation of corporate decision-making, amplified by fiduciary duties and competitive pressures, may systematically undermine the intrinsic motivations that voluntary compliance frameworks depend upon. Drawing on behavioral ethics research demonstrating that organizational settings can serve as "hotbeds for unethicality," this Article identifies structural features of corporate environments that impede genuine voluntary compliance. On the other hand, corporations possess characteristics that may actually facilitate trust-based regulation: they are repeat players sensitive to reputational consequences, they operate through transparent bureaucratic processes amenable to monitoring, and they cannot claim violations of personal autonomy when past behavior informs regulatory treatment. This Article synthesizes these competing considerations into a differentiated framework for corporate regulation, identifying the conditions under which non-coercive approaches are most likely to succeed across securities regulation, environmental compliance, and corporate governance more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文将自愿合规框架从个人公民扩展到企业环境，探讨了企业在自愿合规制度中既带来更大挑战又提供更大机遇的双重性，并提出了差异化的企业监管框架。
AI.research_question: 在监管企业时，自愿合规框架是否有效？企业在自愿合规制度中面临哪些独特挑战和机遇？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注国家如何对个人公民采用非强制性监管方法，但较少探讨这些见解是否适用于企业实体。企业作为监管对象具有独特性，需要专门分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自愿合规理论、行为伦理学研究、企业决策理论、信任基础监管理论
AI.method: 理论分析、文献综述、概念框架构建、跨领域案例研究（证券监管、环境合规、公司治理）
AI.findings: 企业既对自愿合规构成更大挑战（工具性决策导向、受托责任、竞争压力削弱内在动机），又提供更大机遇（重复参与者、声誉敏感、透明官僚流程、无法主张个人自主权侵犯）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自愿合规理论扩展到企业环境，识别企业特有的结构性障碍和促进因素，构建差异化的企业监管理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供指导，识别在证券监管、环境合规和公司治理中非强制性方法最可能成功的条件，帮助设计更有效的企业监管策略。

title: Should Charitable and Political Donations Benefit from Similar Tax Treatments? Evidence from a Survey Experiment
affiliations: , University of Liège and University of Liège - HEC Liège

detail.title: Should Charitable and Political Donations Benefit from Similar Tax Treatments? Evidence from a Survey Experiment
detail.abstract: In many countries, both charitable and political donations benefit from generous – and often similar – tax incentives. While a large literature has studied the tax-price elasticity of charitable giving, little is known about political donations. Using a large-scale survey experiment (N = 12,600), we investigate the relative efficiency of different tax schemes in fostering political and charitable donations. We document that repealing the existing non-refundable income-tax credit decreases charitable donations but not political donations, pointing toward greater fiscal incentives behind charitable giving. We next show that, conditional on giving, matching – where the government matches individual donations at a fixed rate – increases both political and charitable giving, but that it decreases the probability of giving to charities at the extensive margin. Finally, using a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and generic machine learning, we document important dimensions of heterogeneity, and discuss the policy implications of our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模调查实验（N=12,600）比较了不同税收方案对政治捐款和慈善捐款的相对效率，发现取消现有不可退还的所得税抵免会减少慈善捐款但不影响政治捐款，匹配机制能增加两类捐款但会降低慈善捐款的参与率，并通过PCA和机器学习识别了异质性维度。
AI.research_question: 不同税收方案在促进政治捐款和慈善捐款方面的相对效率如何？
AI.motivation: 许多国家对慈善和政治捐款都提供慷慨且相似的税收激励，但现有文献主要研究慈善捐款的税收价格弹性，对政治捐款知之甚少，需要比较不同税收方案对两类捐款的相对效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收激励对捐款行为的影响理论，包括价格弹性理论、行为经济学中的匹配机制效应，以及政治捐款与慈善捐款动机差异的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用大规模调查实验（N=12,600），比较不同税收方案（包括取消现有税收抵免和匹配机制）的效果，并使用主成分分析（PCA）和通用机器学习方法分析异质性。
AI.findings: 1. 取消现有不可退还的所得税抵免会减少慈善捐款但不影响政治捐款；2. 匹配机制能增加政治和慈善捐款，但会降低慈善捐款的参与率；3. 通过PCA和机器学习识别了重要的异质性维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了政治捐款税收激励研究的空白，比较了政治捐款与慈善捐款对税收激励的不同反应，扩展了税收激励理论在政治捐款领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的税收激励方案提供实证依据，帮助优化政治和慈善捐款的税收政策，提高公共资金使用效率。

title: State Dependence of Monetary Policy During Global Supply Chain Disruptions
affiliations: Tsinghua University, University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics, University of International Business and Economics and University of Oxford

detail.title: State Dependence of Monetary Policy During Global Supply Chain Disruptions
detail.abstract: We study how global supply chain disruptions affect monetary policy transmission. Post-pandemic evidence indicates surging transportation costs, goods-market imbalances, and rising prices. We develop a model in which logistical bottlenecks (upstream slack coexisting with downstream shortages) steepen the aggregate supply curve. This convexity amplifies price responses to monetary policy while dampening output effects. Threshold VAR and Local Projection estimates are consistent with this mechanism: during disruptions, contractionary policy reduces prices more at smaller output cost, easing the stabilization trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨全球供应链中断如何影响货币政策传导。疫情后证据显示运输成本飙升、商品市场失衡和价格上涨。作者开发了一个模型，其中物流瓶颈（上游松弛与下游短缺共存）使总供给曲线更加陡峭。这种凸性放大了货币政策对价格的影响，同时减弱了对产出的影响。阈值VAR和局部投影估计支持这一机制：在中断期间，紧缩性政策以较小的产出成本更有效地降低价格，缓解了稳定政策的权衡。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链中断如何影响货币政策传导机制？
AI.motivation: 疫情后全球供应链出现严重中断，表现为运输成本飙升、商品市场失衡和价格上涨，这些现象对货币政策传导产生了新的影响，需要研究供应链中断如何改变货币政策的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个理论模型，其中物流瓶颈（上游松弛与下游短缺共存）使总供给曲线更加陡峭（凸性），这种供给曲线的变化改变了货币政策传导机制。
AI.method: 采用理论建模与实证分析相结合的方法：1）开发理论模型分析供应链中断对供给曲线的影响；2）使用阈值VAR和局部投影方法进行实证估计。
AI.findings: 供应链中断期间，总供给曲线变得更加陡峭，这导致：1）货币政策对价格的影响被放大；2）货币政策对产出的影响被减弱；3）紧缩性政策能以较小的产出成本更有效地降低价格，缓解了稳定政策的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将供应链中断纳入货币政策传导分析框架；2）提出了物流瓶颈导致供给曲线凸性的理论机制；3）解释了供应链中断如何改变货币政策的价格与产出效应权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为央行在供应链中断时期制定货币政策提供理论指导；2）表明在供应链中断期间，紧缩政策可能以较小的产出成本实现价格稳定；3）帮助政策制定者更好地理解不同经济环境下的政策传导机制。

title: An Empirical Analysis Of Bank’s Specific And Macroeconomic Factors Affecting On Profitability Of Banks In Sri Lanka

detail.title: An Empirical Analysis Of Bank’s Specific And Macroeconomic Factors Affecting On Profitability Of Banks In Sri Lanka

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on secondary data obtained from publicly available sources. It did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. As such, formal ethics approval and informed consent were not required.

detail.abstract:
The banking sector plays a one of the major roles in Sri Lankan economy. Therefore, this sector can turn as one of the life bloods of our economy. Due to the economic importance of the banking sector the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) stringently regulated the banking policies and regulations. The main objective of this research problem is “to identify the affect of Bank’s Internal and Macroeconomic Factors on profitability of Commercial Banks in Sri Lanka.”

The key objective of the study is to analyze which Bank’s Specific and Macroeconomic Factors impacts on profitability of Sri Lankan Domestic Commercial Banks (SLDCB) and to study how profitability change over time. Finally, to make recommendations how profitability can be further improved. A comprehensive literature review has been carried out studies of bank profitability across many countries. Studies have broadly found that Bank Specific Factors and Macro Variables have impacted on commercial bank profitability in these countries. This study selected eight factors which influence the profitability of SLDCB. Capital Adequacy, Liquidity, Loan Portfolio, Non-Interest Income and Asset Quality have been used as Bank’s Specific factors and GDP Growth, Inflation and Interest rate used as Macroeconomic Factors. Regression analysis has been done by using panel data of eleven domestic commercial banks over the period of 2006 to 2018 to assess the impact of these factors on profitability as measured by Return on Assets (ROA) and Return on Equity (ROE).

The results reveal that Capital Adequacy, Liquidity, Asset Quality, Non-Interest Income and Loan Portfolio are the key Bank’s Specific Factors which have impact on profitability of SLDCB and as macroeconomic variable, only Interest rate has statistically significant relationship with Bank’s profitability. Bankers can use the analysis and conclusions of this study to improve the profitability of their institutions and also this study included some suggestions for further research.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨斯里兰卡商业银行盈利能力的影响因素，发现资本充足率、流动性、资产质量、非利息收入和贷款组合等银行特定因素以及利率这一宏观经济变量对盈利能力有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 银行内部因素和宏观经济因素如何影响斯里兰卡商业银行的盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 银行业在斯里兰卡经济中扮演重要角色，是经济的命脉之一。由于银行业的经济重要性，斯里兰卡中央银行严格监管银行政策和法规。需要了解影响银行盈利能力的因素以提升银行绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行盈利能力影响因素的理论框架，包括银行特定因素（微观因素）和宏观经济因素（宏观因素）对银行绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用面板数据回归分析，选取11家国内商业银行2006-2018年的数据，以ROA和ROE作为盈利指标，分析资本充足率、流动性、贷款组合、非利息收入、资产质量等银行特定因素以及GDP增长、通货膨胀、利率等宏观经济因素的影响。
AI.findings: 资本充足率、流动性、资产质量、非利息收入和贷款组合是影响斯里兰卡商业银行盈利能力的关键银行特定因素；在宏观经济变量中，只有利率与银行盈利能力存在统计显著关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为银行盈利能力影响因素理论提供了斯里兰卡背景的实证支持，验证了银行特定因素和宏观经济因素对银行绩效的影响机制在发展中国家环境中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为斯里兰卡银行管理者提供了改善盈利能力的具体方向，包括优化资本结构、管理流动性、控制资产质量、发展非利息业务和调整贷款组合；同时为监管机构制定政策提供参考。

title: Who’s on Fire? Household Characteristics and the Formation of Inflation Expectations
affiliations: , De Nederlandsche Bank, Heidelberg University and De Nederlandsche Bank

detail.title: Who’s on Fire? Household Characteristics and the Formation of Inflation Expectations
detail.abstract: We study how consumers form and revise inflation expectations using a unique, highly balanced monthly panel of Dutch households. We develop a Bayesian framework that nests Full-Information Rational Expectations (FIRE) alongside common forecasting heuristics and test it by recovering person-specific belief-updating rules from individual time-series regressions. Our novel individual-level design reveals substantial heterogeneity in how households process information over time. On average, consumers systematically overreact to current inflation, echoing patterns found for professional forecasters. Only 2.5 percent, predominantly wealthier, more educated men, behave consistently with FIRE. Most consumers rely on simple heuristics, especially adaptive expectations. Our results show that heuristic learning, not FIRE, characterizes expectation formation for the vast majority of households. Crucially, heterogeneity in belief updating is both large and systematic.

AI.tldr: 研究荷兰家庭通胀预期的形成与修正机制，发现绝大多数家庭依赖简单启发式（特别是适应性预期），而非完全信息理性预期（FIRE）。只有2.5%的富裕、高学历男性符合FIRE行为。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何形成和修正通胀预期？是否存在系统性异质性？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭通胀预期的形成机制对货币政策传导至关重要，但现有研究对个体层面的异质性了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯框架，嵌套完全信息理性预期（FIRE）与常见预测启发式（如适应性预期）。
AI.method: 使用荷兰家庭月度面板数据，通过个体时间序列回归恢复个人特定的信念更新规则。
AI.findings: 1. 消费者平均对当前通胀反应过度；2. 仅2.5%（主要为富裕、高学历男性）符合FIRE；3. 大多数依赖简单启发式，特别是适应性预期；4. 信念更新的异质性既大又系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出个体层面的贝叶斯框架；2. 证明启发式学习而非FIRE主导家庭预期形成；3. 揭示信念更新的系统性异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策设计提供微观基础；2. 帮助理解通胀预期的异质性对经济稳定的影响；3. 识别不同人群的预期形成模式。

detail.title: Dispute Prevention through Community Engagement in Infrastructure Development in the Asia Pacific

publicationDetails.detailsText: (2026). Dispute Prevention through Community Engagement in Infrastructure Development in the Asia Pacific, Cambridge University Press.

detail.abstract: The key questions posed by this books Introduction is: how do the ways in which communities are engaged in infrastructure project design increase or reduce prospects for future disputes?  How does the presence of transparent information disclosure and grievance mechanism increase or decrease the likelihood of sustainable outcomes? Drawing on case studies, project statistics and survey data, this book explores the achievements, challenges and lessons learned in community-investor dispute prevention and resolution in infrastructure projects in 12 states in the Asia Pacific region. Given the widescale impact of such projects, the books suggests that understanding how to advance consultation and due diligence practices in partnership with local communities is necessary to realize the benefits of sustainable growth. The key finding of the book is that localized decision-making channels, information disclosure and grievance mechanisms, far from aggregating disputes, conversely provide a conduit to incorporate joint aspirations into project design such that disputes are avoided.  After providing an overview of the research approach, key findings of the study and structure of the book, future directions and policy recommendations follow.

AI.tldr: 本书通过亚太地区12个国家的案例研究，探讨社区参与基础设施项目设计如何影响未来争议，发现透明的信息披露和申诉机制能促进可持续成果，避免争议。
AI.research_question: 社区参与基础设施项目设计的方式如何增加或减少未来争议的可能性？透明的信息披露和申诉机制的存在如何增加或减少可持续成果的可能性？
AI.motivation: 基础设施项目具有广泛影响，理解如何与当地社区合作推进咨询和尽职调查实践对于实现可持续增长效益是必要的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社区参与、争议预防与解决、可持续基础设施发展的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用案例研究、项目统计数据和调查数据，分析亚太地区12个国家的基础设施项目。
AI.findings: 本地化决策渠道、信息披露和申诉机制不仅不会加剧争议，反而为将共同愿望纳入项目设计提供了渠道，从而避免争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对社区参与机制如何影响基础设施项目争议动态的理解，挑战了"更多参与导致更多争议"的传统观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和项目开发者提供了具体的实践建议，包括如何建立有效的本地化决策渠道、信息披露和申诉机制来预防争议。

title: Household Effects of Electrification Through Mini-Grids: Evidence from Tanzania
affiliations: Universidad Austral and University of Navarra - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Household Effects of Electrification Through Mini-Grids: Evidence from Tanzania
detail.abstract: Mini-grids are emerging as a key solution to electrify access-deficit communities, yet their effectiveness in improving energy access and household welfare remains underexplored. This paper provides novel evidence from Tanzania, where a policy reform doubled the number of mini-grids since 2008. Exploiting spatial and temporal variation created by the distance to the households in proximity to mini-grids and the timing of their deployment, and using data from two different nationally representative surveys, we find that mini-grids increase local electrification rates by 10-23 percentage points — a result corroborated by a surge in nighttime light intensity near newly deployed projects. We also show that mini-grids reduce reliance on polluting fuel-based lighting and drive the uptake of electric-powered devices. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest the surplus generated by renewable-based mini-grids nearly offsets their costs.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用坦桑尼亚政策改革带来的空间和时间变异，发现小型电网能将当地电气化率提高10-23个百分点，减少污染燃料照明使用，促进电器设备普及，且其产生的剩余价值几乎能抵消成本。
AI.research_question: 小型电网在改善能源获取和家庭福利方面的效果如何？具体来说，小型电网对当地电气化率、家庭能源使用模式以及经济福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 小型电网被认为是解决能源获取不足社区电气化问题的关键方案，但其在改善能源获取和家庭福利方面的实际效果尚未得到充分探索。坦桑尼亚2008年政策改革使小型电网数量翻倍，为研究这一问题提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源获取与发展经济学理论，研究探讨小型电网作为分散式能源解决方案对社区电气化、家庭能源消费模式和经济福利的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用坦桑尼亚政策改革创造的空间和时间变异，采用双重差分法，分析家庭与小型电网距离以及部署时间的影响。使用两个全国代表性调查数据，并通过夜间灯光强度数据验证电气化效果。
AI.findings: 1) 小型电网使当地电气化率提高10-23个百分点；2) 夜间灯光强度在新部署项目附近显著增加；3) 减少对污染燃料照明的依赖；4) 促进电动设备的使用；5) 粗略计算显示可再生能源小型电网产生的剩余价值几乎能抵消其成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为小型电网作为分散式能源解决方案的有效性提供了实证证据；2) 丰富了能源获取与发展经济学的理论框架；3) 展示了政策干预在促进能源转型中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供小型电网投资的经济合理性证据；2) 为发展中国家能源规划提供实证参考；3) 展示了可再生能源小型电网在改善能源获取和家庭福利方面的双重效益。
