title: Old Alliances, New Calculations: North Korea's Strategic Return to China

detail.title: Old Alliances, New Calculations: North Korea's Strategic Return to China

publicationDetails.detailsText: Published in ICWA website on 25 September 2025

detail.abstract: Kim Jong-un’s presence at Beijing’s 80th-Anniversary commemoration of the end of the Second World War, marked a turning point in North Korea’s diplomatic visibility. This was Kim Jong-un’s first multilateral Summit since assuming power in 2011. His alignment with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin underscored Pyongyang’s significance in the North Korea-China-Russia framework, which is emerging as a counterweight to the US-led security architecture in the region.

AI.tldr: 金正恩出席北京二战结束80周年纪念活动标志着朝鲜外交可见度的转折点，这是金正恩2011年执政以来的首次多边峰会，其与习近平和普京的结盟突显了平壤在朝中俄框架中的重要性，该框架正成为对抗美国主导的地区安全架构的制衡力量。
AI.research_question: 金正恩出席北京二战结束80周年纪念活动如何影响朝鲜的外交可见度和地区安全架构？
AI.motivation: 分析金正恩首次多边峰会参与的意义，以及朝中俄框架作为对抗美国主导安全架构的制衡力量的形成过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治理论、多边外交理论、联盟形成理论、权力平衡理论。
AI.method: 基于事件分析、历史比较、地缘政治分析的方法，结合外交行为观察和框架分析。
AI.findings: 1. 金正恩的参与标志着朝鲜外交政策的重大转变；2. 朝中俄框架正在形成对抗美国主导安全架构的制衡力量；3. 朝鲜在该框架中的战略地位得到提升；4. 这一事件改变了东北亚地区的力量平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了多边外交在威权国家外交策略中的作用理解；2. 丰富了联盟形成理论在非传统安全框架中的应用；3. 提供了权力平衡理论在当代亚洲地缘政治中的新案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解朝鲜外交转向提供参考；2. 帮助分析东北亚地区安全架构的变化趋势；3. 为国际关系学者研究新兴联盟框架提供实证基础；4. 为地区安全风险评估提供新的视角。

title: Catch-Up and the Curse of Oil
affiliations: University of Iceland - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration and University of Iceland

detail.title: Catch-Up and the Curse of Oil
detail.abstract: Because of convergence, initial income is an important explanatory variable in many growth regressions. Its omission can lead to misspecification bias that may seem to – but still does not – contradict the common albeit somewhat controversial empirical finding that natural resources, if not well managed, tend to depress incomes and growth. We illustrate the bias using simple algebra and cross-country regression analysis with two different data sets: old and new. We distinguish between natural resource abundance and dependence and propose a method for identifying the level of national income at which the net effects of natural resources shift from adverse to advantageous.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了初始收入在增长回归中的重要性，指出忽略初始收入会导致模型设定偏误，这种偏误可能看似但不真正反驳"自然资源管理不善会抑制收入和增长"的常见实证发现。作者使用简单代数和跨国回归分析，区分自然资源丰裕度和依赖度，并提出识别自然资源净效应从负面转为正面的国民收入水平的方法。
AI.research_question: 初始收入在增长回归中的重要性如何影响对自然资源与经济增长关系的理解？如何准确识别自然资源对经济增长的影响从负面转为正面的临界收入水平？
AI.motivation: 许多增长回归中忽略了初始收入这一重要解释变量，可能导致模型设定偏误，从而影响对自然资源与经济增长关系的准确评估。需要澄清这种偏误是否真正反驳了"自然资源管理不善会抑制增长"的常见实证发现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收敛理论（初始收入作为增长的重要决定因素），自然资源诅咒理论，经济增长理论中关于自然资源丰裕度与依赖度的区分。
AI.method: 使用简单代数分析模型设定偏误，进行跨国回归分析，采用新旧两个不同数据集进行比较，区分自然资源丰裕度和依赖度，提出识别临界收入水平的方法。
AI.findings: 忽略初始收入会导致模型设定偏误，这种偏误可能看似但不真正反驳自然资源管理不善会抑制增长的实证发现。通过区分自然资源丰裕度和依赖度，能够更准确地识别自然资源净效应从负面转为正面的国民收入临界水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了初始收入在增长回归中的关键作用，完善了自然资源与经济增长关系的理论框架，提出了区分自然资源丰裕度和依赖度的分析框架，发展了识别自然资源效应转折点的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确评估自然资源对经济增长影响的方法，帮助识别不同收入水平下自然资源政策的优化方向，为资源管理决策提供实证依据。

title: The Hidden Cost of Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards
affiliations: University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne) and ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards
detail.abstract: Minimum standard regulations for energy-using durables have long been suspected of having hidden costs: quality improvements in the regulated dimension reduce quality in other dimensions. We substantiate this claim for the U.S. clothes washer market, which has become a notorious example of the hidden cost phenomenon. We find that overall quality increased from 2001 to 2011, and these gains were primarily driven by improvements in energy efficiency. Quality in the non-energy dimensions declined or remained constant after the major standard change. These hidden costs, however, were quickly offset by energy-efficiency improvements in the new models.

AI.tldr: 美国洗衣机市场能源效率标准存在隐性成本：能效提升导致其他非能源维度质量下降，但能效改进迅速抵消了这些成本
AI.research_question: 能源使用耐用品的能效标准是否会导致其他非能源维度的质量下降？这些隐性成本有多大？
AI.motivation: 长期以来怀疑能效标准存在隐性成本：在受监管维度（能效）的质量改进会降低其他维度的质量。美国洗衣机市场已成为这种现象的典型例子。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐性成本理论、质量权衡理论、监管经济学
AI.method: 对美国洗衣机市场2001-2011年的实证分析，比较能效标准变化前后不同维度的质量变化
AI.findings: 2001-2011年整体质量提升主要由能效改进驱动；主要标准变化后，非能源维度的质量下降或保持不变；但能效改进迅速抵消了这些隐性成本
AI.theory_contributions: 为能效标准的隐性成本现象提供了实证证据，验证了质量权衡理论在监管环境下的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于能效标准实际影响的实证依据，帮助平衡能效目标与其他质量维度

title: Using Transformers and Reinforcement Learning as Narrative Filters in Macroeconomics
affiliations: BI Norwegian Business School, Department of Data Science and Analytics and Centre for Applied Macroeconomics and Commodity Prices (CAMP), BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Using Transformers and Reinforcement Learning as Narrative Filters in Macroeconomics
detail.abstract: Building on recent advances in Natural Language Processing and modeling of sequences, we study how a multimodal Transformer-based deep learning architecture can be used for measurement and structural narrative attribution in macroeconomics. The framework we propose combines (news) text and (macroeconomic) time series information using cross-attention mechanisms, easily incorporates differences in data frequencies and reporting delays, and can be used together with Reinforcement Learning to produce structurally coherent summaries of high-frequency news flows. Applied and tested on both simulated and real-world data out-of-sample, the results we obtain are encouraging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的多模态深度学习架构，用于宏观经济中的测量和结构性叙事归因，结合新闻文本和宏观经济时间序列数据，通过交叉注意力机制处理不同数据频率和报告延迟，并可与强化学习结合生成结构连贯的高频新闻摘要。
AI.research_question: 如何利用多模态Transformer架构进行宏观经济的测量和结构性叙事归因？
AI.motivation: 随着自然语言处理和序列建模的最新进展，需要开发能够有效结合文本和时间序列数据的框架来理解宏观经济叙事，传统方法难以处理不同频率的数据和报告延迟问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer的深度学习架构，特别是交叉注意力机制，用于融合多模态数据（文本和时间序列），结合强化学习生成结构连贯的叙事摘要。
AI.method: 提出多模态Transformer架构，使用交叉注意力机制结合新闻文本和宏观经济时间序列数据，处理不同数据频率和报告延迟，并与强化学习结合生成新闻摘要。在模拟和真实世界数据上进行样本外测试。
AI.findings: 在模拟和真实世界数据的样本外测试中，所提出的方法取得了令人鼓舞的结果，表明该框架能够有效进行宏观经济测量和叙事归因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合文本和时间序列的多模态Transformer框架；2. 开发了处理不同数据频率和报告延迟的机制；3. 将强化学习与叙事生成相结合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为宏观经济分析提供实用的测量工具；2. 能够生成结构连贯的高频新闻摘要；3. 为政策制定者和分析师提供数据驱动的叙事分析工具。

title: Systemic Risk and Macroprudential Regulation
affiliations: University of St. Gallen (HSG) and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Systemic Risk and Macroprudential Regulation
detail.abstract: This article, part of a symposium on comparative financial regulation, compares the United States's and European Union's approaches to systemic risk and macroprudential regulation since the 2008 global financial crisis. It reveals that both jurisdictions have established new macroprudential bodies and given regulators new macroprudential tools, including macroprudential buffer requirements and borrower-based macroprudential measures. However, significant differences exist in how the U.S. and EU have implemented macroprudential regulation, reflecting their distinct regulatory traditions, institutional structures, and political constraints. These differences have important implications for the effectiveness of systemic risk regulation and suggest potential avenues for mutual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了2008年金融危机后美国和欧盟在系统性风险与宏观审慎监管方面的异同，揭示了两者在监管机构设置、工具运用上的差异及其对监管有效性的影响。
AI.research_question: 2008年全球金融危机后，美国和欧盟在系统性风险与宏观审慎监管方面采取了哪些不同的方法？这些差异如何影响监管有效性？
AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机暴露了传统微观审慎监管的不足，需要建立宏观审慎监管框架来防范系统性风险。比较美欧两种不同的监管模式有助于理解不同制度背景下的监管实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎监管理论、系统性风险理论、比较金融监管制度理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，通过对比美国和欧盟在2008年金融危机后的监管改革措施、机构设置和工具运用，分析其异同及影响因素。
AI.findings: 1. 美欧都建立了新的宏观审慎监管机构并提供了新工具（如宏观审慎缓冲要求、基于借款人的宏观审慎措施）；2. 但两者在实施方式上存在显著差异，反映了不同的监管传统、制度结构和政治约束；3. 这些差异对系统性风险监管的有效性有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了比较金融监管理论，展示了不同制度背景下宏观审慎监管的实践差异；2. 深化了对监管传统、制度结构和政治约束如何影响监管实施的理解；3. 为系统性风险监管的制度设计提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了美欧监管模式的比较分析；2. 指出了不同监管方法的优缺点；3. 提出了美欧相互学习的潜在途径，有助于改进各自的监管框架。

title: How Socially Comparing Emerging Research Institutions to Established Research Institutions Informs Proposed Amendments to the Bayh Dole Act
affiliations: Kelley School of Business

detail.title: How Socially Comparing Emerging Research Institutions to Established Research Institutions Informs Proposed Amendments to the Bayh Dole Act

declarations.funderStatement: Indiana University EMPOWER grant and Indiana University Office of Research, Research Methods grant

detail.abstract: Emerging research institutions have a problem with their lack of tech transfer, including start-up business formations. This study investigates that issue using social comparison theory as the framework for a novel experimental design. A group of 245 respondents, comprised of STEM faculty members and STEM administrators at emerging research institutions, completed a stated-choice survey based on the social comparison theory. The respondents were assessed on the level and extent that they compare their emerging research institution to well established research institutions with respect to research, technology commercialization, and academic entrepreneurship. Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) in America were used as a case study. The median survey response was that technology transfer and academic entrepreneurship was not a priority. Respondents also indicated the belief that their HBCUs are not measuring up to majority schools. Based on this comparison, social comparison theory indicates that the HBCUs may be motivated to improve. An amendment to the Bayh Dole Act is recommended, given that HBCUs are woefully behind majority schools in university technology transfer. Specifically, the 37 CFR 401.16 requirements for federal agency reporting should change to require that emerging research institutions report their licensing activities. Further, all national organizations that receive federal funding and report on university patent licensing revenues should be required to provide annual reports on emerging research institutions’ technology transfer and academic entrepreneurship activities. This will likely increase awareness and monitoring of this issue.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了新兴研究机构（以美国HBCUs为例）技术转移和学术创业不足的问题。基于社会比较理论，通过245名STEM教师和管理人员的调查发现，HBCUs在技术转移方面落后于主流大学，且这不是优先事项。研究建议修订Bayh Dole法案，要求新兴研究机构报告许可活动，以增加对该问题的关注和监督。
AI.research_question: 新兴研究机构（特别是美国历史上的黑人学院和大学）为何在技术转移和学术创业方面表现不佳？如何通过社会比较理论解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 新兴研究机构在技术转移和创业公司形成方面存在问题，这限制了它们的创新影响力和资源获取。以HBCUs为例，它们与主流大学在技术商业化方面存在显著差距，需要研究其原因和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会比较理论：该理论认为个体会通过与他人比较来评估自己的能力和表现。研究应用该理论分析HBCUs教师和管理人员如何将自己机构的技术转移表现与主流研究机构进行比较。
AI.method: 实验设计：对245名HBCUs的STEM教师和管理人员进行陈述选择调查。调查基于社会比较理论，评估受访者将自身机构与成熟研究机构在研究、技术商业化和学术创业方面的比较程度。
AI.findings: 1. 技术转移和学术创业不是HBCUs的优先事项；2. 受访者认为HBCUs在技术转移方面不如主流大学；3. 基于社会比较，HBCUs可能有改进的动力；4. HBCUs在大学技术转移方面严重落后于主流学校。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会比较理论应用于高等教育机构的技术转移研究，扩展了该理论在组织层面的应用。展示了社会比较如何影响机构对技术商业化的态度和行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议修订Bayh Dole法案的37 CFR 401.16条款，要求新兴研究机构报告许可活动。要求所有接受联邦资助的国家组织提供新兴研究机构技术转移和学术创业活动的年度报告，以增加透明度和监督。

reference: YEARBOOK OF ANTITRUST AND REGULATORY STUDIES, volume 16, issue 27, 2023[10.7172/1689-9024.YARS.2023.16.27.1]
title: More Than a Decade of the Slovak Settlement Regime in Antitrust Matters: From European Inspirations to National Inventions

detail.title: More Than a Decade of the Slovak Settlement Regime in Antitrust Matters: From European Inspirations to National Inventions

declarations.funderStatement: The paper was prepared within the project supported by the grant VEGA 2/0167/19 ‘Real Convergence in the European Union: Empirical Evidence of Application’ as well as follow up of the project APVV-17-0641 ‘Improvement of effectiveness of legal regulation of public procurement and its application within EU law context’.

publicationDetails.detailsText: YEARBOOK OF ANTITRUST AND REGULATORY STUDIES, volume 16, issue 27, 2023[10.7172/1689-9024.YARS.2023.16.27.1]

detail.abstract: The settlement procedure in Slovakia stems from three sources of inspiration: top-to-bottom (European Union law), bottom-up (incentive of an undertaking’s lawyer) and horizontal sources (Czechia). After more than ten years of application of this feature of Slovak competition law, there are several cases which were settled. These cases show a certain variety from the point of view of the legal basis, the stage of procedure as well as the character or relevance of the case. This makes it possible to assess their features, practice, effects, and consequences of settlements from the empirical point of view. The present paper analyses the legal framework and practice from a historical point of view. It provides a qualitative overview with evaluation of the settlement procedure in the context of European law and the Slovak legal order as well as a quantitative overview based on data extracted from the decisions of the Slovak NCA (PMÚ) and court rulings. In its conclusions it brings forward fresh suggestions de lege ferenda.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了斯洛伐克竞争法中的和解程序，探讨了其法律框架、实践应用及效果，基于欧盟法、斯洛伐克法律秩序以及捷克经验，提出了立法改革建议。
AI.research_question: 斯洛伐克竞争法中的和解程序在十余年实践中的法律基础、程序阶段、案件特征及实际效果如何？
AI.motivation: 斯洛伐克和解程序受欧盟法、企业律师激励和捷克经验三重影响，经过十余年实践积累了多个案例，有必要从实证角度评估其特征、实践、效果和后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法执行理论、和解程序理论、欧盟竞争法框架、比较法分析（捷克经验）、法律移植理论
AI.method: 历史分析法、定性分析（法律框架评估）、定量分析（基于斯洛伐克竞争管理局PMÚ决定和法院裁决的数据提取）
AI.findings: 斯洛伐克和解程序案例在法律基础、程序阶段和案件相关性方面呈现多样性；从实证角度评估了这些案例的特征、实践、效果和后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了斯洛伐克和解程序的历史发展分析框架；建立了欧盟法与国内法互动的理论视角；丰富了竞争法执行中替代性争端解决机制的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为斯洛伐克竞争管理局提供了实践参考；为企业律师提供了和解策略指导；提出了具体的立法改革建议（de lege ferenda）。

title: Impact of Personal Characteristics of Farmers on Cocoa Yields: Case of Centre Region, Mbangassina Municipality, Cameroon
affiliations: Institute of Agricultural Research for Development (IRAD), Institute of Agricultural Research for Development (IRAD) and The University of Bamenda

detail.title: Impact of Personal Characteristics of Farmers on Cocoa Yields: Case of Centre Region, Mbangassina Municipality, Cameroon
detail.abstract: Cameroon is the fifth largest cocoa producer in the world with approximately 220,000 tons of cocoa produced annually. Many factors account for this productivity, amongst which are ageing farms and personal characteristics of farmers. The study follows a hypothetico-deductive methodology through which a random sampling technique was adopted and relevant primary data was gathered with the aid of a structured questionnaire administered to 150 cocoa farmers from 5 villages; Talba, Biakoa, Goura II, Mbangassina, and Bilomo. Correlation analysis and ordinary least squares regression were used to examine the relationship and effects between socioeconomic variables and cocoa yields. Findings showed a positive correlation between the socioeconomic variables and cocoa yields, socioeconomic factors such as experience in cocoa farming, number of farms, source of labour, farm size, income were statistically significant at p = 1%, 5%, and 10%. Personal characteristics such as farm size, farming experience, percentage of income from cocoa farming, source of labour, number of farms per cocoa farmer, and cocoa price had a significant impact on cocoa yields. However, personal characteristics such as age, sex, marital status and household size did not show any significant impact on cocoa yields. Thus, professionalizing cocoa farmers and training of farmers in good cocoa business practices can go a long way to improve cocoa productivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用假设演绎法，通过问卷调查150名喀麦隆可可种植户，发现社会经济因素（如种植经验、农场数量、劳动力来源、农场规模、收入）与可可产量呈正相关，而年龄、性别、婚姻状况等个人特征对产量无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 社会经济因素和个人特征如何影响喀麦隆可可种植户的生产力？
AI.motivation: 喀麦隆是全球第五大可生产国，年产量约22万吨。农场老龄化和农民个人特征是影响生产力的重要因素，需要研究这些因素如何具体影响可可产量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业经济学和发展经济学的理论框架，关注社会经济变量与农业生产力的关系，特别是小农经济中的生产要素配置。
AI.method: 采用假设演绎法，随机抽样150名可可种植户（来自5个村庄），使用结构化问卷收集数据，通过相关性分析和普通最小二乘回归分析社会经济变量与可可产量的关系。
AI.findings: 社会经济变量与可可产量呈正相关；农场规模、种植经验、可可收入占比、劳动力来源、农场数量、可可价格对产量有显著影响；年龄、性别、婚姻状况、家庭规模无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了在喀麦隆可可种植背景下，哪些社会经济因素真正影响生产力，为农业经济学提供了实证证据，区分了有效和无效的生产力影响因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议通过专业化和培训提升可可种植户的商业实践能力，从而提高生产力；政策应关注农场管理、劳动力获取和市场定价等实际因素。

title: Standing in Prisoners’ Shoes: A Randomized Trial on How Incarceration Shapes Criminal Justice Preferences
affiliations: , , affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Zurich - Department of Economics

detail.title: Standing in Prisoners’ Shoes: A Randomized Trial on How Incarceration Shapes Criminal Justice Preferences
detail.abstract: We study how incarceration experience shapes preferences for criminal justice policies. In collaboration with a newly opened prison, we conducted a randomized field experiment that offered citizens the opportunity to experience up to two days of incarceration, closely replicating the real-life journey of inmates. Providing citizens with a chance to gain firsthand incarceration leads to a significant shift in punitive attitudes, with participants becoming less supportive of harsh criminal justice policies and donating more money to organizations advocating more moderate justice policies. Although individuals overestimated the wellbeing of actual prisoners, the intervention did not alter these beliefs. This suggests that the observed changes in policy preferences are driven more by personal experience than by revised beliefs about the burden of confinement. By randomizing institutional exposure outside the laboratory, our study highlights the causal role of personal experience in the formation of policy preferences.

AI.tldr: 通过监狱实地实验发现，公民亲身体验监禁会显著降低其对严厉刑事政策的支持，并增加对温和司法政策组织的捐款，这种态度转变主要源于个人经历而非对囚犯状况认知的改变。

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBA Section on Business Law Quarterly Bulletin

detail.abstract: Small and medium enterprises are globally acknowledged as important contributors to job creation and global economic development.[1] Likewise in Nigeria, the National Bureau of Statistics recorded that micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) contribute 46.31% of the national GDP, accounting for 96.9% of employment and 6.21% of gross exports.[2] Notwithstanding, MSMEs in Nigeria are constantly challenged with inaccessible and unaffordable finance given the unattractive conventional financing options. Recently, crowdfunding has emerged as a viable alternative financing option for businesses in Nigeria with its ability to connect entrepreneurs with a diverse pool of investors. This paper seeks to interrogate the regulatory framework of crowdfunding and examine its suitability as an alternative financing option for MSMEs in Nigeria. Micro enterprises: less than 10 employees and less than 10 million Naira assets. Small enterprises: within 10 to 49 employees and within 10 to 99 million Naira assets. Medium enterprises: within 50 to 199 employees and less than 1 billion Naira assets.

title: Emergency Liquidity Support and Business Payment Performance: Evidence from the U.S. Paycheck Protection Program
affiliations: University of La Verne, Department of Applied Economics, Oregon State University and University of Idaho

detail.title: Emergency Liquidity Support and Business Payment Performance: Evidence from the U.S. Paycheck Protection Program
detail.abstract: We examine how the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), a major liquidity support during COVID-19, affected business payment behavior. Linking establishment data from the National Establishment Time Series with PPP loan records, we find that PPP loans increased payment timeliness by about one day, mainly for businesses that received loans in 2020. The effect was stronger in industries dependent on trade credit and face-to-face consumer service. Although designed to support payroll, PPP also eased short-term payment difficulties during liquidity shortages.

title: A Physical Store of Value for Digital Money as an Integral Stabilizing Part of the Digital Payment Network
affiliations: Noll Historical Consulting, LLC

detail.title: A Physical Store of Value for Digital Money as an Integral Stabilizing Part of the Digital Payment Network

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author wishes to thank Franklin Noll, Lead Payment Specialist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and former President of Noll Historical Consulting, for his assistance in developing the ideas around cryptobanknotes.

detail.abstract:
Today, there is nothing more important for any central bank digital payment network (central bank digital currencies, tokenized deposits, stablecoins, etc.) than ensuring the quantum stability of encryption algorithms and the creation of an infinitely autonomous payment instrument — a physical store of value for the digital money of this payment network.

While efforts to develop post-quantum cryptography (PQC) are already inspiring cautious optimism, unfortunately, central banks are not yet even considering creating a physical store of value for their own digital currency.

Instead of creating a physical store of value that can address the physical challenges of implementing digital CBDCs, central banks are attempting to negate these challenges through overly restrictive cash policies.

Even more shocking is that central banks are willing not only to discredit the image of their future digital currencies, but also to significantly reduce their future potential by initially introducing draconian restrictions on their use, such as banning interest accrual or limiting the size of CBDC accounts – thereby seriously undermining public confidence in the new digital generation of central bank money.

The problem of instant liquidity outflow can be solved without daunting restrictions by introducing a "braking" mechanism for withdrawing funds from deposits exclusively through CBDC Cash. Cryptobanknotes will significantly slow down the outflow process itself, thanks to their inherent inertia.

Similarly, the inertia of trading operations carried out simultaneously by a large number of users of cryptobanknotes significantly affects the volatility of cryptocurrencies/stablecoins, as it reduces the likelihood of simultaneous sale/purchase of significant volumes of digital currency.

And if digital currencies achieve such a significant stabilizing effect simply due to the inherent inertia of cryptobanknotes, then what a fantastic impact will the many innovative features emerging from the symbiosis of CBDC Cash and digital CBDC have on digital currency and the financial system as a whole?

title: Is Newness Necessary for Patenting?
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco

detail.title: Is Newness Necessary for Patenting?
detail.abstract:
Since its inception, the Patent Act has followed a two-part structure, with the first part serving as a threshold gateway. Loosely akin to a standing requirement, the threshold asks whether the patent applicant's claim falls anywhere within the type of subject matter protected by patents. For 233 years, the word "new" and the corresponding concept of newness have graced every Patent Act, without exception, as part of the threshold inquiry. Today, however, a major legislative effort is underway that would remove the word "new" from the Patent Act's opening language, replacing newness with later, technical considerations. As modern thinkers clamor to support a new chapter in patent history, this article examines historic, theoretic, and practical doctrinal perspectives, and argues that newness cannot be jettisoned from the threshold frame.

Every great edifice bears an inscription. Arguably, it is the inscription that makes the edifice great. Would Harvard's law library loom as large in legal culture if its walls did not call laws the "wise restraints that make men free"? What would the U.S. Post Office be without the precept, "Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays these couriers from the swift completion of their appointed rounds"? So too the Patent Act-like any other monumental enactment-bears an inscription on what is effectively its gateway provision. By lapidary words, the structure informs the world of its guiding spirit, its sacred principle. Altering those words would be an act of physical and intellectual vandalism.

AI.tldr: 本文反对将"新颖性"从专利法门槛条款中移除的立法改革，认为新颖性作为专利制度的核心原则具有历史、理论和实践上的必要性。

AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 历史分析法：追溯专利法233年来"新颖性"原则的连续性；2. 制度象征理论：法律文本的"铭文"功能及其象征意义；3. 专利法哲学：新颖性作为专利保护的基本门槛和正当性基础。
AI.method: 采用历史分析、理论分析和教义分析相结合的方法，从历史演变、理论依据和实践影响三个维度考察新颖性在专利法中的地位。
AI.findings: 1. 新颖性在专利法中具有233年的历史连续性；2. 新颖性是专利制度的"铭文"式核心原则；3. 移除新颖性将破坏专利法的精神内核和制度完整性；4. 技术性考量不能替代新颖性作为基本门槛的功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了专利法"铭文"理论，强调法律文本的象征意义；2. 系统论证了新颖性作为专利制度哲学基础的重要性；3. 为专利法基本原则的稳定性提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为反对移除新颖性的立法改革提供了有力论据；2. 警示立法者慎重对待专利法核心原则的修改；3. 为专利实务界维护传统专利标准提供了理论武器。

title: What Does Econometrics Measure? Economic Measurement, Marginal Relationships, and Causal Essence
affiliations: Nguyen Tat Thanh University

detail.title: What Does Econometrics Measure? Economic Measurement, Marginal Relationships, and Causal Essence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Econometric methods are widely used to estimate and interpret relationships among economic variables, yet the measurement content of these methods is often left implicit. This paper argues that econometrics primarily measures marginal relationships in deviation space, rather than economic quantities defined at the level of system-wide states or constraints. Building on a state-deviation decomposition, the paper shows that regression analysis estimates conditional responses around an economic state, while accounting identities and feasibility conditions govern the state itself. Intercepts and residuals are reinterpreted as endogenous equilibrium residues and adjustment mechanisms. Within this framework, Granger causality, vector autoregressions, and cointegration are shown to capture interactional adjustment and long-run consistency, but not economic causal essence. The paper contributes a measurement-based perspective on econometrics that clarifies the meaning, scope, and limits of marginal inference, with implications for empirical interpretation and causal claims.

AI.tldr: 计量经济学方法主要测量偏离空间中的边际关系，而非系统层面的经济量；回归分析估计经济状态附近的响应，而截距和残差被重新解释为内生均衡残差和调整机制

title: Policing and the Perils of Duty: Understanding the Causes of Careless Deaths among Police Officers
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Nnamdi Azikiwe University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Policing and the Perils of Duty: Understanding the Causes of Careless Deaths among Police Officers
detail.abstract:
This book provides an in-depth analysis of the occupational risks faced by law enforcement personnel, with a specific focus on preventable fatalities. It explores the multifaceted factors contributing to police deaths, including poor situational awareness, inadequate training, lack of proper equipment, officer fatigue, psychological stress, and leadership failures. Drawing from both global and local case studies, the text aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the conditions that lead to careless deaths among officers in the line of duty.
It emphasizes the significance of improved safety protocols and introduces strategies for reducing police casualties. These strategies include enhancing training and tactical preparedness, strengthening inter-agency cooperation, leveraging technological advancements like drones and surveillance, and addressing mental health concerns through counselling and psychological support. Legislative and policy interventions are discussed as essential components of a framework to ensure continuous improvements in officer safety.
With practical recommendations for law enforcement agencies, policymakers, and training institutions, this book serves as a vital resource for improving police safety standards globally. It is an invaluable tool for police officers, researchers, security personnel, and anyone involved in the broader conversation of public safety and law enforcement welfare. Through a combination of theory, empirical research, case studies, and practical solutions, this work underscores the urgency of prioritizing the safety and well-being of police officers in an increasingly dangerous world.

AI.method: 案例研究法（全球与本地案例）、文献综述、实证研究、理论分析、政策分析
AI.findings: 警察死亡的主要因素包括：情境意识不足、培训不足、装备不当、疲劳、心理压力、领导失误。通过改进安全协议、加强培训、机构合作、技术应用和心理支持，可显著降低伤亡率。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了警察职业安全的多因素分析框架，整合了组织、个人、技术和环境因素；发展了警察安全管理的系统性理论；为执法机构风险管理提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为执法机构提供具体的安全改进策略；为政策制定者提供立法和政策建议；为培训机构提供课程设计指导；为警察提供实用的安全操作指南；促进全球警察安全标准的提升。

title: Activism, Stock Selection, and Indexing in Equilibrium
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, McIntire School, University of Virginia and University of Virginia (UVA) - McIntire School of Commerce

detail.title: Activism, Stock Selection, and Indexing in Equilibrium
detail.abstract: We construct a dynamic general equilibrium production economy intermediated by two types of actively managed funds and a passive index. "Activists" and "stock selectors" are both socially valuable, albeit in different ways. Households allocate their wealth across the different funds, determining the endogenous composition of the intermediation sector. We characterize the equilibrium impact of changes in search costs, productive efficiency, and index fees on the composition of the fund industry. Our general equilibrium perspective adds new insights in the debate about active versus passive management. While a decrease in the passive index fee benefits households through cheaper diversification, it also impacts the composition of the managed fund industry, which can raise or lower investor welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个由两类主动管理基金和被动指数基金中介的动态一般均衡生产经济模型。研究发现，尽管方式不同，"积极行动者"和"股票选择者"都具有社会价值。家庭在不同基金间分配财富，决定了中介部门的内生构成。研究分析了搜索成本、生产效率和指数费用的变化对基金行业构成的均衡影响，为主动与被动管理之争提供了新的见解。
AI.research_question: 在动态一般均衡框架下，主动管理基金和被动指数基金的相对价值是什么？搜索成本、生产效率和指数费用如何影响基金行业的构成和投资者福利？
AI.motivation: 主动与被动管理之争是金融经济学中的重要议题，但现有研究缺乏从一般均衡角度分析不同类型基金的社会价值及其对行业构成的影响。本文旨在填补这一空白，理解基金行业结构的内生决定因素及其福利含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡生产经济模型，包含两类主动管理基金（"积极行动者"和"股票选择者"）和被动指数基金。模型考虑了家庭资产配置决策、基金中介作用以及生产部门的相互作用。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建动态一般均衡模型，通过数学推导分析均衡条件，研究外生参数变化（搜索成本、生产效率、指数费用）对内生变量（基金行业构成、投资者福利）的影响。
AI.findings: 1. "积极行动者"和"股票选择者"都具有社会价值，但方式不同；2. 家庭财富分配决定基金行业的内生构成；3. 被动指数费用下降通过更便宜的多样化使家庭受益，但也会影响主动管理基金行业的构成，这可能提高或降低投资者福利；4. 搜索成本、生产效率和指数费用的变化对基金行业构成有显著均衡影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为主动与被动管理之争提供了新的理论视角；2. 建立了基金行业构成内生决定的一般均衡模型；3. 揭示了不同类型基金的社会价值差异；4. 阐明了金融中介结构变化的一般均衡效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者理解不同类型基金的价值提供理论依据；2. 为监管者评估基金行业政策（如费用监管）提供分析框架；3. 为基金管理者理解行业竞争动态提供见解；4. 帮助政策制定者预测金融中介结构变化对投资者福利的影响。

title: Labor Market Trajectories Before and After Initiating Gender-Affirming Care
affiliations: University of Liverpool, Uppsala University, Swedish Institute for Social Research (SOFI)  and Stockholm University - Swedish Institute for Social Research (SOFI)

detail.title: Labor Market Trajectories Before and After Initiating Gender-Affirming Care

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study received ethical approval from the Swedish Ethical Review Authority (case numbers 2021-03229 and 2022-03462-02).
declarations.funderStatement: The study received financial support from FORTE, the Swedish Research Council, and the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. Tilley also acknowledges financial support from the Jan Wallander and Tom Hedelius Foundation at Handelsbanken.

detail.abstract: Using administrative data from Sweden, this paper examines labor market trajectories following the initiation of gender-affirming care. We track employment, earnings, and economic self-sufficiency for transgender men and women before and after the first diagnosis of gender incongruence, using an event-study design to measure the changes in labor market outcomes relative to a matched cisgender sample. Prior to initiating gender-affirming care, transgender individuals already showed lower employment and earnings, and after treatment begins, the gaps widen significantly. Relative employment declines in the two years after initiating care and remains stable in subsequent years. Relative earnings decline as well, following the same pattern as employment. The decline is larger for transgender women than for transgender men. The widening of the gaps in labor market outcomes reflects two factors: i) declines in employment and earnings among transgender individuals who were employed when they initiated gender-affirming care, and ii) slow employment and earnings growth among transgender individuals who enter the labor market after initiating gender-affirming care. Obtaining gender-affirming hormones or surgeries and legal gender recognition is not correlated with outcomes for transgender women, but obtaining gender-affirming hormones or surgeries and legal gender recognition is correlated with smaller declines in relative employment and earnings for trans men. Mechanism tests suggest a limited role for occupational sorting and firm characteristics, and changes in health explain only a small fraction of the observed declines in relative outcomes. The results highlight the economic vulnerability transgender individuals face during medical transitions.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用瑞典行政数据发现，跨性别者在开始性别肯定治疗后，就业和收入差距显著扩大，经济脆弱性增加，其中跨性别女性的下降幅度更大。
AI.research_question: 性别肯定治疗如何影响跨性别者的劳动力市场轨迹（就业、收入和自给自足）？
AI.motivation: 了解跨性别者在医疗过渡期间面临的经济脆弱性，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场歧视理论、健康经济学、性别认同理论
AI.method: 使用瑞典行政数据，采用事件研究设计，比较跨性别者与匹配的顺性别样本在性别肯定治疗前后的劳动力市场结果。
AI.findings: 1. 治疗前跨性别者就业和收入已较低；2. 治疗后差距显著扩大；3. 跨性别女性下降幅度更大；4. 激素治疗/手术和法律性别承认对跨性别男性有积极影响；5. 职业选择和健康变化解释有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了医疗过渡期间的经济成本；2. 揭示了性别肯定治疗对不同性别群体的差异化影响；3. 挑战了单纯用健康或职业选择解释劳动力市场结果的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为支持跨性别者就业政策提供证据；2. 提示需要针对性别的干预措施；3. 强调医疗过渡期间经济支持的重要性。

reference: UC Irvine School of Law Research Paper No. 2026-02
title: Understanding and Justifying Tort Law’s Intent Doctrines
affiliations: University of California, Irvine School of Law

detail.title: Understanding and Justifying Tort Law’s Intent Doctrines

publicationDetails.detailsText: UC Irvine School of Law Research Paper No. 2026-02
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Irvine School of Law & Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper carefully and thoroughly explores tort law’s intent doctrines and considers the extent to which moral principles can help explain and justify them.  By “intent,” I mean doctrinal requirements of purpose or knowledge, either as to a result of the actor’s conduct or as to a circumstance element of a tort.  The paper concentrates on three fundamental questions.  How do intentional torts differ from torts of negligence?  Why do courts treat them differently?  Are they justified in doing so?

The paper also discusses intentional torts (such as trespass) that have strict liability elements.  The existence of such elements undermines the conventional, simple tripartite classification of torts into three simple categories—intent, negligence, and strict liability—under which intentional torts involve the most serious fault, negligence less serious, and strict liability no fault at all.  Instead, it is sometimes more accurate to identify intentional torts as merely the residual category for torts other than those based on negligently causing harm or based on strict liability for causing harm.  We will see that the Simple Fault Hierarchy view explains some aspects of intentional tort doctrine, while the Residual View explains others.  And there is a third problem that complicates the task of defining the intentional tort category: many torts have multiple fault or culpability elements.  An “intentional” tort may require negligence or no fault at all (i.e. it may impose strict liability) as to some elements.

Section 2 of the paper explains some key characteristics of intent doctrines as an interpretive matter, identifying different types of intent (purpose, knowledge to a substantial certainty, motive), and different objects of intent (results and circumstances).  It then notes some problems with the Simple Fault Hierarchy.  And it addresses multiple doctrinal functions and implications of a finding of intent.

Section 3 departs the realm of legal doctrine and explores intent in ordinary morality and moral philosophy, from both deontological and consequentialist perspectives.  This Section first examines how intent is relevant to wrongdoing (or impermissibility) and culpability, which in turn are relevant to whether the conduct in question deserves moral criticism or blame.  Pertinent here is the moral philosophy literature concerning the doctrine of double effect and whether an improper intention makes otherwise permissible conduct impermissible.  The Section then considers a different question: what ordinary morality or moral principles say about whether and how intent is relevant to whether an actor should compensate the victim of his conduct.

Section 4 turns to the internal perspective of judges who create and revise tort doctrine and considers how they invoke moral arguments when deciding whether, when, and how to require intent as an element of a tort.  Section 5 identifies four doctrines at the borderline of intent and negligence, to reveal in more detail how courts understand the domains of intentional tort and negligence.  The doctrines are: fault concerning non-intent elements; intentional tort claims preempting negligence when facts support either claim; statistical rather than individualized knowledge; and transferred intent.

AI.tldr: 本文深入探讨侵权法中的意图原则，分析道德原则如何解释和证明这些原则。论文挑战了传统的侵权三分法（意图、过失、严格责任），提出"简单过错等级观"和"剩余观"两种解释框架，并探讨意图在道德哲学中的意义及其在司法实践中的应用。
AI.research_question: 1. 故意侵权与过失侵权有何区别？2. 法院为何区别对待它们？3. 这种区别对待是否合理？
AI.motivation: 传统侵权法将侵权简单分为意图、过失和严格责任三类，但这种分类存在缺陷。许多"故意"侵权实际上包含过失或无过错（严格责任）要素，需要更精细的理论框架来解释意图原则。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 简单过错等级观：故意侵权涉及最严重的过错，过失次之，严格责任无过错
2. 剩余观：故意侵权只是非过失侵权和非严格责任侵权的剩余类别
3. 道德哲学框架：从义务论和后果主义角度分析意图的道德意义
AI.method:
法律教义分析：解析意图的不同类型（目的、实质确定性知识、动机）和对象（结果和情境）
比较分析：对比故意侵权与过失侵权的边界案例
道德哲学分析：探讨双重效应学说和意图在道德评价中的作用
司法实践分析：考察法官如何运用道德论证来制定和修改侵权原则
AI.findings:
1. 简单过错等级观能解释故意侵权原则的某些方面，剩余观能解释其他方面
2. 许多侵权具有多重过错或可责性要素，使故意侵权的定义复杂化
3. 意图在道德评价中具有重要性，但意图与补偿义务的关系需要更细致的分析
4. 法院在界定故意侵权与过失侵权边界时面临四个关键问题
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 挑战了传统的侵权三分法，提出更复杂的分类框架
2. 将道德哲学分析引入侵权法意图原则的研究
3. 识别了故意侵权定义中的三个核心问题
4. 为理解意图在侵权法中的作用提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为法官制定和修改侵权原则提供理论指导
2. 帮助法律从业者更好地理解故意侵权与过失侵权的边界
3. 为侵权法教学提供更精细的分析框架
4. 识别了司法实践中需要特别注意的四个边界问题

title: The Pedagogical Price: On the Three Layers of Learning in Empirical Asset Pricing

detail.title: The Pedagogical Price: On the Three Layers of Learning in Empirical Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: I develop a framework for asset valuation that partitions the information mechanism of markets into three layers: Semantics, Syntax, and Structure, in order to to survey and classify the recent literature on learning and information in asset pricing. The Semantic layer involves the economic theory underlying model creation; the Syntax layer involves the parameter uncertainty and learning of a given model mathematically; and the structural layer involves the actual data (including the growing application of "big data" and machine learning techniques to empirical asset pricing) used to devise valuations. Each of these somewhat separate strains, while distinct, are ultimately inseparable from each other, and can combine to help explain many asset pricing "puzzles", tame the "Factor Zoo", and improve out-of-sample prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个资产估值的三层框架（语义层、句法层、结构层），用于分类和整合近期关于学习和信息在资产定价中的文献，旨在解释资产定价难题、管理"因子动物园"并改进样本外预测。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的框架来整合和分类资产定价中关于学习和信息的各种研究方法，以更好地理解市场信息机制并解决资产定价难题？
AI.motivation: 资产定价文献中存在多种关于学习和信息的研究方法，但这些方法往往相互分离，缺乏统一的整合框架。作者希望通过建立一个三层框架来系统性地分类和整合这些文献，以更全面地理解市场信息机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层信息机制框架：1) 语义层：涉及模型创建的经济理论基础；2) 句法层：涉及给定模型的参数不确定性和数学学习过程；3) 结构层：涉及用于估值的实际数据（包括大数据和机器学习技术在实证资产定价中的应用）。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论框架构建方法。作者通过分析近期资产定价文献，提出了一个概念性框架来分类和整合不同研究路径。
AI.findings: 虽然语义层、句法层和结构层的研究路径各有侧重，但它们本质上是不可分割的。将这三个层面结合起来可以帮助解释许多资产定价"难题"，管理"因子动物园"，并改进样本外预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的三层框架来整合资产定价中关于学习和信息的文献，为理解市场信息机制提供了统一的理论视角，有助于弥合不同研究传统之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架为研究人员和实践者提供了系统性的方法来理解和应用资产定价模型，有助于更好地解释市场现象、管理投资因子风险，并提高预测模型的样本外表现。

title: Political Alignment and Corporate Environmental Policies
affiliations: The University of Technology Sydney, University of Miami - Miami Herbert Business School and University of Technology Sydney (UTS)

detail.title: Political Alignment and Corporate Environmental Policies
detail.abstract: We examine how political partisanship affects corporate environmental policies and firm performance. Publicly traded U.S. firms generate more toxic pollution when their CEOs are politically aligned with the president. The effect is amplified by greater political exposure and attenuated by stronger external monitoring. CEO-president political alignment influences the environmental policies of firms through heightened managerial optimism and relaxed regulatory constraints. Politically aligned firms reallocate resources away from environmental mitigation efforts toward expansion and innovation, where both the quantity and quality of innovation increase. Consequently, those firms have higher operating efficiency, higher market valuations, and higher future returns.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：当美国上市公司CEO与总统政治立场一致时，公司会产生更多有毒污染，但运营效率、市场估值和未来回报更高。这种效应通过管理乐观情绪增强和监管约束放松实现，资源从环保措施转向扩张和创新。
AI.research_question: 政治党派关系如何影响企业环境政策和公司绩效？具体来说，CEO与总统的政治立场一致如何影响企业的环境政策和财务表现？
AI.motivation: 政治因素对企业决策的影响日益重要，但政治党派关系如何具体影响企业环境政策和绩效的机制尚不清楚。理解CEO政治立场与企业环境行为之间的关系对政策制定和公司治理有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学理论、代理理论和行为金融学理论，探讨政治关联如何通过管理乐观情绪和监管约束影响企业决策。
AI.method: 使用美国上市公司数据，分析CEO与总统政治立场一致性与企业污染排放、创新活动、运营效率和市场表现之间的关系，采用计量经济学方法控制相关变量。
AI.findings:
1. CEO与总统政治立场一致的企业产生更多有毒污染
2. 政治暴露度增强效应，外部监督减弱效应
3. 资源从环保措施转向扩张和创新（创新数量和质量均提高）
4. 这些企业运营效率更高、市场估值更高、未来回报更高
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了政治党派关系影响企业环境政策的双重机制：管理乐观情绪和监管约束
2. 扩展了政治经济学在企业决策中的应用
3. 为行为金融学提供了政治因素影响管理决策的新证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者识别政治关联企业的投资机会提供参考
2. 为监管机构设计环境政策提供依据
3. 为企业董事会考虑CEO政治立场的影响提供决策支持
4. 为环境组织监督政治关联企业的污染行为提供方向

title: Police Operational Strategy and Tactical Leadership for Enhanced Professionalism and Economic Impact
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Nnamdi Azikiwe University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Police Operational Strategy and Tactical Leadership for Enhanced Professionalism and Economic Impact
detail.abstract: Policing in the modern era is evolving at an unprecedented pace, driven by complex security challenges, advancements in technology, and the increasing need for professionalism among law enforcement personnel. A nation's economic development and stability are directly tied to the efficiency and effectiveness of its security forces. Without strategic leadership, disciplined policing, and operational excellence, law enforcement agencies cannot foster the safety and security necessary for economic development. The ever-changing landscape of crime, coupled with emerging threats such as cybercrime, terrorism, and organized criminal networks, demands a proactive and adaptive approach from police forces. Officers must be equipped with the necessary tools, knowledge, and leadership qualities to navigate these evolving challenges effectively.This book is designed to equip law enforcement officers, commanders, and policymakers with the essential knowledge, skills, and strategies required for modern policing. It provides a structured approach to understanding operational planning, crisis management, leadership in high-stress environments, and the integration of intelligence and technology in policing. By addressing these critical aspects, the book serves as a comprehensive guide for those who seek to enhance law enforcement efficiency, build public trust, and foster a secure environment that promotes economic and social stability.

AI.tldr: 本书旨在为执法人员、指挥官和政策制定者提供现代警务所需的知识、技能和策略，涵盖行动规划、危机管理、高压环境下的领导力以及情报与技术整合等关键方面，以提升执法效率、建立公众信任并促进经济社会稳定。
AI.research_question: 如何通过战略领导、专业培训和现代技术整合来提升警务效率，以应对复杂安全挑战并促进经济社会发展？
AI.motivation: 现代警务面临前所未有的变革压力，包括复杂安全挑战、技术进步需求以及执法专业化的要求。国家的经济发展和稳定直接依赖于安全部队的效率和效能，而缺乏战略领导、纪律严明的警务和卓越运营将无法为经济发展创造必要的安全环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代警务理论、战略领导理论、危机管理理论、技术整合理论、专业发展理论
AI.method: 本书采用结构化方法，通过理论阐述、案例分析和实践指南相结合的方式，系统性地介绍现代警务的关键要素。
AI.findings: 本书提供了全面的现代警务框架，强调战略领导、行动规划、危机管理、高压环境领导力以及情报与技术整合的重要性，为提升执法效率、建立公众信任和促进安全环境提供了具体指导。

title: Calibrating Behavioral Parameters with Large Language Models
affiliations: and

detail.title: Calibrating Behavioral Parameters with Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Behavioral parameters such as loss aversion, herding, and extrapolation are central to asset pricing models but remain difficult to measure reliably. We develop a framework that treats large language models (LLMs) as calibrated measurement instruments for behavioral parameters. Using four models and 24,000 agent--scenario pairs, we document systematic rationality bias in baseline LLM behavior, including attenuated loss aversion, weak herding, and near-zero disposition effects relative to human benchmarks. Profile-based calibration induces large, stable, and theoretically coherent shifts in several parameters, with calibrated loss aversion, herding, extrapolation, and anchoring reaching or exceeding benchmark magnitudes. To assess external validity, we embed calibrated parameters in an agent-based asset pricing model, where calibrated extrapolation generates short-horizon momentum and long-horizon reversal patterns consistent with empirical evidence. Our results establish measurement ranges, calibration functions, and explicit boundaries for eight canonical behavioral biases.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个将大型语言模型作为行为参数校准测量工具的新框架，通过校准使LLM能够可靠地测量损失厌恶、羊群效应等八种经典行为偏差，并在基于代理的资产定价模型中验证了其外部有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大型语言模型作为校准测量工具来可靠地测量资产定价模型中的行为参数（如损失厌恶、羊群效应、外推等）？
AI.motivation: 行为参数（如损失厌恶、羊群效应、外推）对资产定价模型至关重要，但传统方法难以可靠测量。需要开发新的测量框架来解决这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学理论，特别是损失厌恶、羊群效应、处置效应、外推偏差、锚定效应等经典行为偏差理论框架。
AI.method: 使用四个大型语言模型和24,000个代理-场景配对，开发LLM作为校准测量工具的框架。通过基于配置文件的校准方法调整行为参数，并在基于代理的资产定价模型中验证外部有效性。
AI.findings: 1. 基线LLM行为存在系统性理性偏差：损失厌恶减弱、羊群效应弱、处置效应接近零；2. 基于配置文件的校准能显著稳定地调整多个参数，使校准后的损失厌恶、羊群效应、外推和锚定效应达到或超过基准水平；3. 在基于代理的资产定价模型中，校准后的外推参数能产生与实证证据一致的短期动量效应和长期反转模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了将LLM作为行为参数校准测量工具的理论框架；2. 为八种经典行为偏差确定了测量范围、校准函数和明确边界；3. 提供了行为参数测量的新方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究人员和从业者提供了可靠测量行为参数的工具；2. 校准后的LLM可用于资产定价模型的参数估计；3. 为行为金融实证研究提供了新的测量方法。

title: Filling the void digitally: Compensatory expectations and social support in compulsive food ordering within super-app ecosystems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Filling the void digitally: Compensatory expectations and social support in compulsive food ordering within super-app ecosystems
detail.abstract: Compulsive food ordering represents an emerging digital risk, yet the cognitive mechanisms bridging psychosocial deficits and behavioral enactment remain underspecified. Integrating the I-PACE model with Compensatory Consumption Theory, this study validates a causal–predictive architecture using PLS-SEM and rigorous out-of-sample prediction within a high-velocity super-app ecosystem. Results identify "compensatory expectation" as the dominant proximal driver, fully mediating the impact of loneliness and self-control on compulsive food ordering. This establishes that compulsive ordering is driven by specific compensation-seeking beliefs rather than mere stimulus-driven cue-reactivity. Furthermore, perceived social support functions as a critical "root resource," significantly mitigating upstream risks by alleviating loneliness and replenishing self-regulatory capacity. Importance-performance map analysis prioritizes targeting cognitive restructuring over restriction, offering a robust data-driven framework for corporate digital responsibility and platform well-being design.

AI.tldr: 该研究验证了补偿期望作为孤独感和自我控制对强迫性订餐行为影响的中介机制，并发现感知社会支持作为关键资源能够缓解上游风险
AI.research_question: 补偿期望是否中介了孤独感和自我控制对强迫性订餐行为的影响？感知社会支持如何调节这一路径？
AI.motivation: 强迫性订餐作为一种新兴的数字风险，其心理机制尚不明确，需要理解连接心理社会缺陷和行为实施的认知机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合I-PACE模型和补偿消费理论，构建因果预测架构
AI.method: 使用PLS-SEM（偏最小二乘结构方程模型）和严格的样本外预测，在高速度超级应用生态系统中进行验证
AI.findings: 1. 补偿期望是主要近端驱动因素，完全中介了孤独感和自我控制对强迫性订餐的影响；2. 强迫性订餐由特定的补偿寻求信念驱动，而非单纯的刺激驱动线索反应；3. 感知社会支持作为关键"根源资源"，通过缓解孤独感和补充自我调节能力显著减轻上游风险
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了补偿期望在强迫性订餐行为中的中介作用；2. 将补偿消费理论与数字行为研究相结合；3. 识别了感知社会支持作为调节机制的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 重要性-绩效图分析优先考虑认知重构而非限制，为企业数字责任提供数据驱动框架；2. 为平台健康设计提供实证依据；3. 为干预强迫性订餐行为提供具体策略方向

title: The Unpriced Risk in Momentum Strategies
affiliations: Soochow University and Hong Kong Baptist University

detail.title: The Unpriced Risk in Momentum Strategies
detail.abstract: Standard momentum strategies bear substantial unpriced risk arising from time-varying exposures to common risk factors. We isolate this risk ex ante crosssectionally and show that it drives momentum crashes. Volatility management succeeds precisely by mitigating this unpriced exposure. We demonstrate that ignoring these dynamics induces a severe spanning bias in unconditional tests. Once we control for unpriced risk, momentum delivers a more significant alpha and remains unexplained by factor momentum or other leading pricing models. Unpriced risk is therefore central to understanding the economic sources of momentum profits.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现动量策略的未定价风险是导致动量崩溃的关键因素，波动率管理通过缓解这种风险暴露而成功，控制未定价风险后动量策略能产生更显著的alpha收益
AI.research_question: 动量策略的未定价风险如何影响其收益表现？波动率管理为何能有效改善动量策略？
AI.motivation: 传统动量策略存在显著的未定价风险，这些风险源于对共同风险因子的时变暴露，导致动量崩溃现象，需要深入理解这些风险的经济来源
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、风险因子暴露理论、动量策略理论、未定价风险理论
AI.method: 横截面分析、风险暴露隔离、波动率管理技术、条件测试与无条件测试对比、因子动量控制
AI.findings: 1. 动量策略的未定价风险驱动动量崩溃；2. 波动率管理通过缓解未定价风险暴露而成功；3. 忽略这些动态会导致无条件测试中的严重跨越偏差；4. 控制未定价风险后，动量策略产生更显著的alpha且无法被因子动量或其他定价模型解释
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别动量策略未定价风险的经济来源；2. 建立未定价风险与动量崩溃的理论联系；3. 为波动率管理的有效性提供理论解释；4. 修正传统无条件测试中的偏差问题
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供改进动量策略风险管理的实用方法；2. 指导投资者如何通过波动率管理避免动量崩溃；3. 为资产配置提供更准确的动量策略评估框架；4. 帮助识别真正的alpha来源而非风险暴露

title: Comparative Transcriptomic Analysis of Starch Biosynthesis and Carbon Partitioning Gene Networks Under Simulated and Actual Spaceflight Conditions

detail.title: Comparative Transcriptomic Analysis of Starch Biosynthesis and Carbon Partitioning Gene Networks Under Simulated and Actual Spaceflight Conditions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Secondary data use only. No human subject data.
declarations.funderStatement: ICL Institute, New Jersey, USA

detail.abstract:
Long-duration human space exploration missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond will require bioregenerative life support systems (BLSS) capable of producing food crops in situ. Understanding how spaceflight conditions affect plant carbon metabolism and starch biosynthesis is critical for developing high-yielding crop varieties optimized for the space environment. This dissertation presents a comparative transcriptomic analysis investigating the molecular responses of starch biosynthesis and carbon partitioning gene networks to spaceflight and simulated microgravity conditions across multiple plant species relevant to BLSS applications. Analysis of 11 NASA GeneLab spaceflight datasets encompassing Arabidopsis thaliana, Oryza sativa (rice), and Triticum aestivum (wheat) revealed consistent patterns of transcriptional reprogramming affecting carbon metabolism. Starch biosynthesis genes, including those encoding ADP-glucose pyrophosphorylase (AGPase), starch synthases (SS), and starch branching enzymes (SBE), exhibited coordinated downregulation across species, with mean log₂ fold changes ranging from -0.95 to -1.13. Concurrently, sugar transporters from the SWEET and SUT families showed significant upregulation, indicating enhanced capacity for carbon export and a shift in partitioning away from storage. Stress-responsive transcription factors from the bZIP, NAC, and WRKY families were consistently activated, providing mechanistic insight into the regulatory cascade connecting stress perception to metabolic reprogramming. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis identified hub genes—SS4, SPS3F, and APS2 in Arabidopsis; OsAGPL1, SS2, and OsSUS2 in rice—that represent central regulatory nodes and promising targets for genetic improvement strategies. These findings demonstrate that spaceflight induces a conserved transcriptional response that redirects carbon from storage to stress response, with direct implications for achieving optimal harvest index in space-grown crops. The identification of specific hub genes and regulatory mechanisms provides actionable targets for developing spaceflight-adapted crop varieties through precision breeding and genetic engineering approaches.

Keywords: spaceflight transcriptomics, starch biosynthesis, carbon partitioning, bioregenerative life support systems, comparative genomics, gene co-expression networks, space agriculture

AI.tldr: 该论文通过比较转录组分析，研究了太空飞行和模拟微重力条件下多种植物淀粉生物合成和碳分配基因网络的分子响应。研究发现太空飞行诱导了保守的转录反应，将碳从储存重新分配到应激响应，为太空农业作物改良提供了具体靶点。
AI.research_question: 太空飞行条件如何影响植物碳代谢和淀粉生物合成的分子机制？不同植物物种在太空环境中是否表现出保守的转录响应模式？
AI.motivation: 长期太空探索任务需要能够在太空环境中生产粮食作物的生物再生生命支持系统。了解太空飞行条件如何影响植物碳代谢和淀粉生物合成对于开发适应太空环境的高产作物品种至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于转录组学、比较基因组学和基因共表达网络分析的理论框架，研究太空环境对植物碳代谢通路（淀粉生物合成、碳分配）的分子调控机制。
AI.method: 比较转录组分析：分析11个NASA GeneLab太空飞行数据集，涵盖拟南芥、水稻和小麦；加权基因共表达网络分析识别枢纽基因；log₂倍数变化分析基因表达差异。
AI.findings: 1. 淀粉生物合成基因（AGPase、淀粉合成酶、淀粉分支酶）在不同物种中协调下调；2. 糖转运蛋白（SWEET和SUT家族）显著上调；3. 应激响应转录因子（bZIP、NAC、WRKY家族）持续激活；4. 识别了枢纽基因（拟南芥中的SS4、SPS3F、APS2；水稻中的OsAGPL1、SS2、OsSUS2）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了太空飞行诱导的保守转录响应模式；2. 阐明了应激感知与代谢重编程之间的调控级联机制；3. 建立了太空环境对植物碳分配策略影响的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为开发太空飞行适应型作物品种提供了具体的遗传改良靶点；2. 为优化太空种植作物的收获指数提供了分子基础；3. 支持通过精准育种和基因工程方法改进生物再生生命支持系统。

title: Productisation as an Ontological Discipline Surplus, Mediation, and the Structural Survival of Human Value in Machine-Mediated Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Productisation as an Ontological Discipline Surplus, Mediation, and the Structural Survival of Human Value in Machine-Mediated Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could be perceived to influence this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human or animal subjects; ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The term productisation is widely used across business, consulting, and technology literature to describe the packaging of services or expertise into standardized, scalable offerings. However, these prevailing definitions are insufficient for explaining how human value survives in increasingly mediated, machine-driven environments. This paper proposes a foundational re-classification of productisation as an ontological discipline rather than a commercial tactic. Drawing from historical analysis of surplus formation, systems theory, and contemporary AI mediation, the paper argues that productisation is the structural conversion of surplus into a bounded, attributable, and persistent form capable of surviving mediation. Artificial intelligence does not create this problem; it exposes it. By reframing productisation around survivability, attribution, and induced state rather than market packaging, this work establishes the conceptual groundwork for Productisation Studies as a cross-domain discipline relevant to research, education, governance, and civilization-scale value continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"产品化"重新定义为一种本体论学科而非商业策略，认为产品化是将剩余价值转化为有界、可归属、可持久的形式以在机器中介环境中生存的结构性转换。
AI.research_question: 在日益中介化、机器驱动的环境中，人类价值如何通过产品化过程得以生存？
AI.motivation: 现有关于产品化的商业和技术定义无法解释人类价值在机器中介环境中的生存问题，需要建立更基础的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 剩余价值形成的历史分析、系统理论、当代AI中介理论，以及产品化作为本体论学科的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析、历史分析、跨学科理论整合，以及概念框架构建。
AI.findings: 产品化是剩余价值转化为有界、可归属、可持久形式的结构性转换；AI不创造这个问题，而是暴露了它；产品化研究的核心是生存性、归属性和诱导状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了产品化研究作为跨领域学科的理论基础，重新定义了产品化的核心概念，为价值连续性研究提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究、教育、治理和文明规模的价值连续性提供了概念基础，有助于理解和管理AI时代的人类价值生存问题。

title: Interest Rate Disparities in Bangladesh: Comparing Tractor Loans for Farmers and Car Loans for Urban Borrowers and Their Socioeconomic Consequences
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Interest Rate Disparities in Bangladesh: Comparing Tractor Loans for Farmers and Car Loans for Urban Borrowers and Their Socioeconomic Consequences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest in the preparation, writing, and submission of this manuscript. The research has been conducted independently and objectively, without any financial or personal relationships that could influence the results or interpretations presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved surveys and interviews with human participants (farmers and urban borrowers). Informed consent was obtained from all participants. Data were anonymized, and no personal identifying information was collected. This study was conducted in accordance with ethical research standards. Institutional ethics approval was not required for this survey based study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding. No grants or financial support were received from government, private, or institutional sources. The author conducted and financed the study independently.

detail.abstract: In Bangladesh, small farmers often suffer disproportionately high interest rates when borrowing for productive assets, such as tractors, compared to urban borrowers who take loans for consumption or business assets like cars. This paper explores the interest rate differences between farm machinery loans and consumer/business loans, identifies the underlying causes, and evaluates the economic and social ramifications of this phenomena. Using a combination of primary data from farmer and urban borrower surveys and secondary data from bank-declared interest rate schedules and policy reports, the study reveals that risk perception, limited collateral, and rural banking costs are the primary drivers of higher interest rates for farmers. The findings imply that elevated borrowing costs inhibit mechanization, reduce agricultural production, and perpetuate rural financial exclusion, while urban borrowers benefit from lower rates despite borrowing for non-productive purposes. The paper closes with policy recommendations to boost financial inclusion, eliminate interest rate disparities, and promote sustainable agricultural development in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨孟加拉国小农户为拖拉机等生产性资产贷款时面临的高利率问题，相比城市借款人消费或商业资产贷款的低利率，分析差异原因及社会经济影响，提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国农户机械贷款与城市消费/商业贷款之间的利率差异是什么？造成这种差异的根本原因是什么？这种利率差异对经济和社会有什么影响？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国小农户为拖拉机等生产性资产贷款时面临不成比例的高利率，而城市借款人消费或商业资产贷款却享受较低利率，这种不公平现象阻碍农业机械化、影响农业生产，需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融排斥理论、风险定价理论、农村金融理论、农业机械化经济学
AI.method: 混合方法研究：使用农户和城市借款人调查的一手数据，结合银行公布利率表和政策报告的二手数据进行分析
AI.findings: 风险感知、有限抵押品和农村银行业务成本是农户高利率的主要驱动因素；高借贷成本抑制机械化、减少农业生产、加剧农村金融排斥；城市借款人即使为非生产性目的借款也享受低利率
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对发展中国家农村金融排斥机制的理解，扩展风险定价理论在农村金融中的应用，为农业机械化融资障碍提供理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 提出促进金融包容、消除利率差异、支持可持续农业发展的政策建议；为孟加拉国和其他类似发展中国家制定农村金融政策提供实证依据

title: Keys to Business Success
affiliations: Nnamdi Azikiwe University - Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Keys to Business Success
detail.abstract: Business is a risky venture and only the courageous subscribeto its rigor. Besides, life naturally is full of ups and down.While some are going up, others are going down. Events of lifeare unpredictable. Hence, entrepreneurship and businesses are surrounded with predictable and unpredictable circumstancesand forecasts. These vicissitudes in business account for the success and non-success of many endeavors. Covid-19pandemic impact is one of such eventual mishaps that couldbefall businesses. Hence, business gladiators all over the worldhave been greatly shocked consequent upon the Covid-19pandemic that affected many bubbling grooves and business hubs. Very challenging was the fact that the pandemic was unforeseen yet absolutely disarming, repealing almost every well thought out policy from experts and has plunged many economies into recession.Experience has shown that some businesses fail at theirinception because they have faulty foundations, others fail fewyears later while others endure during the life time of the originator. Before we launch you properly into this book wewill bring you the failure and success stories of two respective business ventures as a lesson to underscore your businesssuccess and as a strategy to mitigate against business collapse.‗Chinedu Hair Saloon‘ and ‗Kentz Hair Solutions‘ at the wakeof the covid-19 pandemic. Before the pandemic, the Managing Director (name withheld) of Chinedu Hair Saloon procured a startup loan of two million naira (N2m) from one of the firstgeneration banks with the intention of establishing a unisexhair salon. He saw the pandemic as obstacle for his progress inthe hair salon business, in that many persons will be lockeddown indoors and will not see the need to come out for thehair dressing. With the two million naira fixed in his account,the prices of machines such as clippers, driers, powergenerating sets, etc., started to rise. This further casts doubt on the need for him to get these machines despite having the purchasing power for them.Indeed, after two months of having idle fund, the real value ofthe money depreciated to one million and six hundredthousand naira (N1.6m). This was only enough for him toacquire some low-cost machines except for a power generatingmachine which later became out of reach for the manager.During operations, he relied heavily on power supply from thenational grid which proved ineffective and inefficient. Chinedudreaded the pandemic and had to cut off home service delivery even on request. As a result, Chinedu Hair Salon was labelledincompetent, unproductive and incapable of efective servicedelivery since most customers patronized him during power outage to have their haircut and design without fruition. This lingered on and the manager could not cover the minimum of his average variable cost, he simply folded up the business twomonths later to continue paying his debts.On the other hand, Kentz Hair Solutions saw the Covid-19lockdown as an opportunity to reach a wide range ofcustomers which would not have been possible outside of thepandemic. He simply procured a smaller loan of four hundredand twenty thousand from a microfinance bank using his plotof land in the village as collateral. After making purchases ofafordable equipment including the power generating machine,he employed an assistant who helped in the rendering of homeservices to many customers in the locality with Covid-19safety measures intact. This busted the revenue for Kentz HairSolutions and led to the employment of more hair stylists whowere specialized in modern hair styles. The loan obtained was paid in due course and five new branches were opened fromthe increased proceeds from the firm.Reading in-between lines of the book one will discover that thetwo stories and their lessons punctuate the entire book. Hence,the book as a matter of fact, encompasses a number of eventsand activities that can ruin your business or provoke loss of enthusiasm or loss of support of positive initiative and whatcan make it flourish or dwindle. Therefore, this book is a guide to young entrepreneurs who wish to start a business of theirchoice, those who are already in the business, those who aretaking over a business from the initiator or the founder andthose voracious readers who love knowledge and wish to understand business success amidst unforeseen circumstances, appreciation or depreciation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比两家美发沙龙在新冠疫情中的不同应对策略，揭示了企业成功与失败的关键因素：心态、适应性和战略规划。Chinedu Hair Saloon因恐惧疫情、资金闲置贬值而倒闭，而Kentz Hair Solutions则抓住机遇，提供上门服务并扩张业务。
AI.research_question: 在新冠疫情等不可预见的外部冲击下，是什么因素决定了企业的成功与失败？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情作为不可预见的重大冲击，对全球企业造成了严重影响。作者希望通过对比两家美发沙龙的不同应对策略，揭示企业在危机中成功与失败的关键因素，为创业者提供实用指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于危机管理理论、创业适应性和战略灵活性理论，探讨企业在不可预见外部冲击下的应对能力。
AI.method: 采用对比案例研究方法，分析Chinedu Hair Saloon和Kentz Hair Solutions两家美发沙龙在新冠疫情中的不同应对策略和结果。
AI.findings:
1. 心态决定成败：Chinedu将疫情视为障碍而失败，Kentz将疫情视为机遇而成功
2. 资金管理：Chinedu资金闲置导致贬值，Kentz有效利用小额贷款
3. 服务创新：Kentz提供上门服务满足疫情期间需求，Chinedu拒绝上门服务
4. 适应性：Kentz快速调整商业模式，Chinedu固守传统模式
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"危机心态框架"，区分了障碍导向和机遇导向的危机应对模式
2. 强调了在不可预见冲击下战略灵活性的重要性
3. 丰富了创业适应性的理论内涵
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为创业者提供了危机应对的实用指南
2. 强调了小额贷款和灵活资金管理的重要性
3. 展示了服务创新和商业模式调整的具体策略
4. 为企业在不可预见冲击下的生存和发展提供了可操作建议

title: Binary Choice Paths and Random Utility
affiliations: McGill University,  and Princeton University - Princeton University

detail.title: Binary Choice Paths and Random Utility
detail.abstract: A decision maker proceeds through a list, making binary choices between each new alternative and the current provisional choice. We study such binary choice path data, aggregated across a population with heterogeneous preference, as in the random utility model. Complete data rationalizable by the model is characterized by two simple local axioms; limited data requires an appropriately defined game to have a non-empty core. Complete rationalizable data point-identifies the preference distribution trivially, but so does some limited data. We obtain a necessary condition for the set (and number) of lists required for such point-identification. Using an indirect approach that follows the implications of two operations defined on the space of lists, we obtain a sufficient condition for point-identification. For up to 7 alternatives the lower bound can be attained. Our method applies more generally to obtain partial identification results for any set of lists.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了基于二元选择路径数据的偏好分布识别问题。通过分析决策者在列表中逐项进行二元选择的数据，研究在随机效用模型框架下，如何从有限的选择数据中识别出异质性偏好分布。
AI.research_question: 在随机效用模型下，从二元选择路径数据中识别异质性偏好分布需要多少以及什么样的列表数据？
AI.motivation: 决策者在列表中逐项进行二元选择是常见的决策过程（如招聘、产品比较）。理解从这种路径数据中能识别出多少偏好信息对实证研究和实际应用都很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机效用模型（RUM），二元选择理论，博弈论核心概念，偏好分布识别理论。
AI.method: 理论分析方法：1）建立二元选择路径数据的可理性化公理；2）使用博弈论核心概念处理有限数据；3）通过列表空间上的操作推导点识别的必要和充分条件。
AI.findings: 1）完全可理性化数据可由两个简单局部公理刻画；2）有限数据需要博弈核心非空；3）获得点识别的必要条件和充分条件；4）对于最多7个备选方案，下界可达。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了二元选择路径数据的可理性化理论；2）提出了偏好分布点识别的必要和充分条件；3）发展了列表空间操作的分析方法；4）为有限数据下的识别问题提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为实证研究者提供了从二元选择数据中识别偏好的方法论；2）指导数据收集策略（需要多少列表）；3）适用于招聘、产品推荐等实际决策场景。

title: A Trustworthy AI Explainability Metric for Machine Learning Volatility Models: Evidence from the EU ETS
affiliations: University of Pavia and

detail.title: A Trustworthy AI Explainability Metric for Machine Learning Volatility Models: Evidence from the EU ETS
detail.abstract: In this paper, we propose an innovative statistical approach for decoding volatility in complex financial environments. Volatility is a key element of the European Allowances (EUA) price behavior, shaping both market stability and policy credibility. Our contribution consists of a new metric, the Rank Graduation Volatility (RGV), which plays a threefold role: linking realized and implied volatility through expected volatility, which acts as an intermediate and unobservable bridge between ex-post market fluctuations and forwardlooking expectations; assessing a model's ability to explain implied volatility within a Gini-based framework; and integrating accuracy and interpretability by quantifying the share of implied volatility explained by model-based expectations. We validate our proposal through an empirical application to EUA return, using a rolling-window forecasting framework and a set of Machine and Deep Learning models. The results show that RGV effectively captures differences in explanatory power across models, with Random Forest and Support Vector Machine generally exhibiting the most stable and consistent performance. Overall, the approach provides a transparent and interpretable way to assess the share of implied volatility explained by predictive models, offering new insights into volatility dynamics and risk assessment in the EU Emission Trading System. In addition, our proposal introduces a model-agnostic explainability framework for volatility analysis, grounded in a general statistical structure and designed to be applicable across different market environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的统计方法——Rank Graduation Volatility (RGV)，用于解码复杂金融环境中的波动率。RGV通过预期波动率连接已实现波动率和隐含波动率，在Gini框架下评估模型解释隐含波动率的能力，并量化模型预测解释隐含波动率的份额。在欧盟碳排放配额(EUA)回报的实证应用中，随机森林和支持向量机表现出最稳定和一致的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种透明且可解释的方法来评估预测模型解释隐含波动率的份额，特别是在欧盟碳排放交易系统(EU ETS)的复杂金融环境中？
AI.motivation: 波动率是欧盟碳排放配额(EUA)价格行为的关键要素，影响市场稳定性和政策可信度。现有方法在连接已实现波动率和隐含波动率、评估模型解释能力以及提供可解释性方面存在不足，需要一种新的统计框架来更好地理解波动率动态和风险评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gini系数的统计框架，通过预期波动率作为已实现波动率（事后市场波动）和隐含波动率（前瞻性预期）之间的不可观测桥梁。该框架整合了准确性和可解释性，并建立了一个模型无关的可解释性框架。
AI.method: 提出Rank Graduation Volatility (RGV)新指标，采用滚动窗口预测框架，应用多种机器学习和深度学习模型（包括随机森林、支持向量机等）进行实证验证，使用欧盟碳排放配额(EUA)回报数据。
AI.findings: RGV能有效捕捉不同模型解释能力的差异，随机森林和支持向量机通常表现出最稳定和一致的性能。该方法提供了透明且可解释的方式来评估预测模型解释隐含波动率的份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出RGV新指标，通过预期波动率连接已实现和隐含波动率；2) 在Gini框架下建立模型解释隐含波动率能力的评估方法；3) 开发模型无关的可解释性框架，适用于不同市场环境。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为EU ETS参与者提供更好的波动率动态理解和风险评估工具；2) 帮助政策制定者评估市场稳定性和政策可信度；3) 为金融从业者提供透明且可解释的模型评估框架；4) 方法可扩展到其他复杂金融环境。

title: Achievement as Property: Race, Rights, and the Fiscal Governance of Educational Value

detail.title: Achievement as Property: Race, Rights, and the Fiscal Governance of Educational Value
detail.abstract:
This paper makes a single, bounded analytic move: it re-articulates educational achievement through a common-law property grammar and situates that articulation within an institutional tension analysis frame. Drawing on Critical Race Theory in education, achievement is treated not as a neutral learning outcome but as an entitlement regime organized around practical rights—most notably the authority to define what counts as achievement, the capacity to benefit from institutional recognition, and the ability to transfer value through credentials and routed pathways. The paper then shows how this rights-structured regime becomes operational through assessment infrastructures that function as an execution layer, translating definitional authority into legible, comparable, and portable outputs. Because assessment is not self-grounding, the analysis specifies its fiscal grounding: the resourcing, measurement capacity, and accountability conditions that determine what can be rendered as valid performance and what becomes administratively mandatory. Under contemporary governance conditions, AI- and metrics-mediated systems intensify this execution dynamic by embedding definitional and classificatory choices into thresholds, labels, rankings, and risk flags that can be applied at scale.

The paper anchors its linkage in Ontario’s Bill 33 (Supporting Children and Students Act, 2025), used as a concrete example of how definitional authority over achievement can be consolidated through governance interfaces. Read structurally, such reforms clarify a dual obligation frame within which achievement becomes governable: upward public accountability operationalized through auditability and oversight, and a parallel institutional duty of care toward students as dependent service recipients (without translating that duty into liability claims or outcome guarantees). The contribution is methodological rather than programmatic: it renders the core mechanism of achievement governance legible in property terms while maintaining a clear linkage to the Institutional Tension Index architecture, with the Educational Performance Tension Index referenced as an institution-side surface readout of policy–assessment–governance friction.

AI.tldr: 本文通过普通法财产语法重新阐述教育成就，将其视为围绕实践权利组织的权利制度，并分析评估基础设施如何作为执行层运作。论文以安大略省法案为例，揭示成就治理的核心机制。
AI.research_question: 如何通过普通法财产语法和制度张力分析框架来重新阐述教育成就，并理解评估基础设施在成就治理中的作用？
AI.motivation: 传统上将教育成就视为中立学习结果的观点忽视了其作为权利制度的本质，以及评估基础设施在塑造成就定义和分配中的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判种族理论（教育领域）、普通法财产语法、制度张力分析框架、权利制度理论
AI.method: 概念分析、制度张力分析、以安大略省Bill 33法案为具体案例的结构性解读
AI.findings: 教育成就是一种围绕实践权利组织的权利制度，包括定义权、制度认可受益权和价值转移权。评估基础设施作为执行层，将这些权利转化为可识别、可比较、可转移的输出。AI和指标系统强化了这种执行动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将教育成就重新概念化为财产权利制度；2) 建立成就治理的核心机制分析框架；3) 将制度张力指数架构与成就治理联系起来
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供分析教育政策改革的方法论工具；2) 揭示评估基础设施在成就治理中的关键作用；3) 为理解AI和指标系统对教育的影响提供分析框架

title: Group All-Pay Auctions: An Experimental Study
affiliations: , Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT) University

detail.title: Group All-Pay Auctions: An Experimental Study
detail.abstract: We conduct the first experimental study of group all-pay auctions, a contest format in which teams compete for a prize by exerting costly, irreversible effort, and the prize is awarded to the team with the highest aggregated output. This setting captures strategic environments such as R&D races, lobbying, and team-based sales competitions. Our experimental design varies: (i) group production technology (perfect substitutes vs. perfect complements), (ii) timing of effort choices (simultaneous vs. sequential), and (iii) matching protocol (fixed vs. random rematching). Theory predicts free riding with substitutes, zero expected profits under complements, and coordination advantages from sequential play. In contrast, we observe no free riding and substantial overbidding under substitutes, and persistent coordination failures leading to lower-than-predicted output under complements. Sequential play reduces, but does not eliminate, coordination problems, and we find limited evidence that exogenous "leading by example" enhances performance. Our findings challenge equilibrium predictions and highlight behavioral dynamics in team contests, including overbidding, miscoordination, and the nuanced role of leadership.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实验研究了群体全支付拍卖，发现实验结果与理论预测存在显著差异：在替代品情境下未出现搭便车反而有过度竞标，在互补品情境下存在协调失败导致产出低于预期，顺序博弈仅部分缓解协调问题，领导示范作用有限。
AI.research_question: 群体全支付拍卖中，不同生产函数（完全替代vs完全互补）、努力选择时机（同时vs顺序）和匹配协议（固定vs随机重匹配）如何影响团队竞标行为和绩效？
AI.motivation: 群体全支付拍卖在研发竞赛、游说活动和团队销售竞赛等战略环境中普遍存在，但缺乏实验证据检验理论预测，需要了解实际团队行为与均衡预测的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体全支付拍卖理论、团队生产函数理论（完全替代与完全互补）、博弈论中的均衡预测（搭便车、零期望利润、顺序博弈协调优势）
AI.method: 实验研究方法，通过3×2×2设计操纵：生产函数（替代/互补）、努力选择时机（同时/顺序）、匹配协议（固定/随机），观察团队竞标行为
AI.findings: 1) 替代情境下未出现理论预测的搭便车，反而有显著过度竞标；2) 互补情境下存在持续协调失败，产出低于理论预测；3) 顺序博弈减少但未消除协调问题；4) 外生"榜样领导"对绩效提升作用有限
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了群体全支付拍卖的均衡预测，揭示了行为动态（过度竞标、协调失败）在团队竞赛中的重要性，为理论模型提供了行为修正方向
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计团队竞赛（如研发竞赛、销售竞赛）提供实践启示：需考虑行为偏差，设计适当的激励机制和协调机制，领导示范作用有限需配合其他管理措施

title: Embedding Children's Rights by Design: Legal Safeguards for AI-Driven Child Justice System in Ireland and the EU

detail.title: Embedding Children's Rights by Design: Legal Safeguards for AI-Driven Child Justice System in Ireland and the EU

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, institutional, or financial relationships that could influence this research. The researcher conducted the study independently, maintaining academic integrity, transparency, and adherence to recognised ethical and scholarly standards.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data requiring consent or ethical approval. The research relied solely on doctrinal legal analysis and publicly available sources, complying with recognised academic ethical standards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no financial support or funding from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona or any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body. The study was conducted as an independent academic scholarly contribution.

detail.abstract: AI-driven tools are increasingly embedded in child justice systems across Europe, informing policing, risk assessment, diversion, probation, and child protection decisions. While these technologies are promoted to enhance efficiency and consistency, their deployment in child justice contexts generates heightened risks to children's rights, including privacy, due process, non-discrimination, transparency, and meaningful participation. Children's distinctive legal status, developmental vulnerability, and limited capacity to contest algorithmic decisions render existing safeguards particularly fragile. Yet current Irish and EU legal frameworks, spanning child justice law, data protection, and emerging AI regulation, remain fragmented, predominantly adult-centred, and oriented towards ex post remedies rather than ex ante structural protection. This article examines how children's rights can be embedded by design into AI-driven child justice systems in Ireland and the European Union. It adopts a normative doctrinal methodology, complemented by comparative EU-Ireland analysis and a child-centred interpretive framework grounded in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, EU fundamental rights law, and EU digital regulation. Through systematic analysis of legislation, policy instruments, and case law, the article identifies structural deficiencies in existing safeguards, particularly in relation to algorithmic accountability, explainability, and oversight. The article's central contribution is the development of a children's rights by design model, translating substantive and procedural child rights into concrete legal, technical, and governance obligations for AI in child justice. It offers a replicable framework for rights-centred AI governance in Europe.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何在爱尔兰和欧盟的AI驱动儿童司法系统中通过设计嵌入儿童权利，指出现有法律框架碎片化且以成人为中心，提出"儿童权利设计"模型将儿童权利转化为具体的法律、技术和治理义务。
AI.research_question: 如何在爱尔兰和欧盟的AI驱动儿童司法系统中通过设计嵌入儿童权利？
AI.motivation: AI工具在欧洲儿童司法系统中的广泛应用带来了儿童权利风险，包括隐私、正当程序、非歧视、透明度和有效参与等方面。现有爱尔兰和欧盟法律框架碎片化、以成人为中心，主要依赖事后补救而非事前结构性保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合国《儿童权利公约》、欧盟基本权利法和欧盟数字监管的儿童中心解释框架，结合规范教义学方法论和欧盟-爱尔兰比较分析。
AI.method: 采用规范教义学方法论，辅以欧盟-爱尔兰比较分析和儿童中心解释框架，系统分析立法、政策文件和判例法。
AI.findings: 识别出现有保障措施的结构性缺陷，特别是在算法问责、可解释性和监督方面。现有法律框架碎片化、以成人为中心，主要依赖事后补救而非事前保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了"儿童权利设计"模型，将实质性和程序性儿童权利转化为AI在儿童司法中的具体法律、技术和治理义务，为欧洲权利中心的AI治理提供了可复制的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、技术开发者和司法从业者提供了具体的实施指南，帮助在AI驱动的儿童司法系统中更好地保护儿童权利，促进算法问责和透明度。

title: A "Local Markets Lab": Are our Merger Screens Doing what we Think they're Doing?
affiliations: Berkeley Research Group, LLC and Berkeley Research Group, LLC

detail.title: A "Local Markets Lab": Are our Merger Screens Doing what we Think they're Doing?

The information provided in the publication is not intended to and does not render legal, accounting, tax, or other professional advice or services, and no client relationship is established with BRG by making any information available in this publication, or from you transmitting an email or other message to us.
