detail.abstract: Local merger screens play a central role in the assessment of horizontal mergers with local competition, where agencies and parties must decide which local areas warrant closer scrutiny. Despite their practical importance, evidence on their reliability remains limited. This paper develops a "Local Markets Lab", a stylised model economy in which purchase patterns, catchments, and merger-induced price effects are observed, allowing screening methods and rules to be evaluated under controlled variation in demand and market structure. We show that the merger-induced delta share within a local market is highly informative of price effects within a fixed environment but does not translate robustly across environments, undermining one-size-fits-all threshold rules. We also find that overlap-based methods better approximate true local shares, yet presence-based methods can perform better under current rules by reducing systematic over-flagging from small peripheral overlaps. Overall, screen performance depends on the combined design of catchments, metrics, and thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了"本地市场实验室"模型，评估横向并购审查中本地市场筛选方法的可靠性。研究发现，并购引起的本地市场份额变化在固定环境下能有效预测价格效应，但无法在不同环境间稳健推广，因此一刀切的阈值规则存在问题。基于重叠区域的方法能更好近似真实本地份额，但在现有规则下基于存在性的方法表现更佳，能减少小范围边缘重叠导致的系统性过度标记。
AI.research_question: 本地并购筛选方法在横向并购审查中的可靠性如何？不同筛选方法（基于重叠区域vs基于存在性）在预测并购引起的价格效应方面表现如何？
AI.motivation: 本地并购筛选在评估具有本地竞争的横向并购中起着核心作用，监管机构和相关方需要确定哪些本地区域需要更仔细审查。尽管实践重要性很高，但关于这些筛选方法可靠性的证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用"本地市场实验室"框架，这是一个风格化的模型经济，可以观察购买模式、市场范围和并购引起的价格效应，允许在需求和市场结构受控变化下评估筛选方法和规则。
AI.method: 开发并应用"本地市场实验室"模型，在受控环境中模拟不同需求和市场结构变化，评估各种本地并购筛选方法（包括基于重叠区域和基于存在性的方法）的性能。
AI.findings: 1. 并购引起的本地市场份额变化在固定环境下能高度预测价格效应，但无法在不同环境间稳健推广，削弱了一刀切阈值规则的适用性；2. 基于重叠区域的方法能更好近似真实本地份额；3. 但在现有规则下，基于存在性的方法表现更好，能减少小范围边缘重叠导致的系统性过度标记。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了评估本地并购筛选方法的新理论框架（本地市场实验室）；2. 揭示了并购引起的市场份额变化预测价格效应的局限性；3. 证明了筛选性能取决于市场范围定义、指标和阈值的综合设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构和并购方提供了评估本地并购筛选方法可靠性的实用工具；2. 指出一刀切阈值规则的局限性，建议更灵活的方法；3. 提供了选择筛选方法的指导：基于重叠区域的方法更适合近似真实份额，而基于存在性的方法在当前规则下能减少过度标记。

title: The Anatomy of the DMA Process: An Example of Responsive Regulation
affiliations: University of Namur, Independent and Tilburg Law and Economics Center (TILEC)

detail.title: The Anatomy of the DMA Process: An Example of Responsive Regulation
detail.abstract: This paper studies the DMA implementation process based on evidence obtained from 21 semi-structured interviews with DMA stakeholders. In the first section, we present the responses of these stakeholders on the way they have interacted with the Commission and each other. We characterise this as a series of ongoing dialogues or repeated interactions with various feedback loops between the participants in order to arrive at a view of what compliance means. These dialogues may also be a way in which the Commission can exercise ‘soft power’ by guiding or influencing the actions of gatekeepers without or before resorting to more formal legal measures. The second section considers the more formal legal measures and the various tools that were included in the DMA to allow the Commission to ensure effective implementation or sanction non-compliance. These include the compliance reports which gatekeepers are required to produce and publish, the compliance officer which gatekeepers are required to appoint, the process for obtaining or providing further guidance by way of specification decisions and the non-compliance decisions and fines. We examine stakeholder responses to these measures and integrate these with a discussion of the emerging decisional practice.The last section concludes with key messages to improve the DMA implementation process and trust among stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对21位DMA利益相关者的半结构化访谈，研究了DMA实施过程。研究发现，欧盟委员会通过持续对话和反馈循环行使"软权力"引导守门人合规，同时利用正式法律工具确保有效实施。最后提出改进DMA实施过程和利益相关者信任的关键建议。
AI.research_question: 欧盟数字市场法案(DMA)的实施过程是如何运作的？欧盟委员会如何通过对话和正式法律措施确保守门人合规？
AI.motivation: 随着数字市场法案(DMA)的实施，了解欧盟委员会如何通过对话和正式法律工具确保大型数字平台（守门人）合规，对于评估监管有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软权力理论、监管对话理论、合规管理理论、制度实施理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法：对21位DMA利益相关者进行半结构化访谈，包括欧盟委员会官员、守门人代表、行业专家等。
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟委员会通过持续对话和反馈循环行使"软权力"，引导守门人理解合规要求；2. 正式法律工具包括合规报告、合规官任命、规范决定程序、不合规决定和罚款等；3. 利益相关者对实施措施的反应存在差异；4. 需要改进实施过程以增强信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了软权力理论在数字监管中的应用；2. 深化了对监管对话和反馈循环机制的理解；3. 为数字市场监管的实施过程提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟委员会改进DMA实施提供具体建议；2. 帮助守门人更好地理解合规要求；3. 增强利益相关者之间的信任；4. 为其他数字监管政策提供实施参考。

title: Welfare-Improving Price Controls in Incomplete Markets
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business, Marshall School of Business - University of Southern California and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Welfare-Improving Price Controls in Incomplete Markets
detail.abstract: Spot markets facilitate allocative efficiency, reallocating goods to maximize society's money-equivalent wealth. Financial markets facilitate risk-sharing, redistributing optimized wealth according to consumers’ risk preferences. When financial markets are incomplete, the wealth generated by efficient spot markets is not optimally shared across agents. Market incompleteness implies that commodity price controls can be Pareto-improving, if they sufficiently improve risk sharing across agents.

AI.tldr: 当金融市场不完全时，商品价格管制可以通过改善风险分担实现帕累托改进，即使这会降低现货市场的配置效率

AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论、不完全金融市场理论、帕累托效率、风险分担理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建包含现货市场和金融市场的经济模型，分析市场不完全条件下的均衡性质
AI.findings: 当金融市场不完全时，商品价格管制可以通过改善代理人之间的风险分担实现帕累托改进，即使这会降低现货市场的配置效率
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 阐明了不完全金融市场中现货市场效率与风险分担之间的权衡关系；2. 证明了在某些条件下价格管制可以作为改善福利的政策工具；3. 扩展了不完全市场理论的政策应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在不完全金融市场条件下使用价格管制改善社会福利的理论依据，特别是在金融市场发展不完善的经济体中

title: FBAR Penalty: Appropriating Retirement Savings of the Elderly?
affiliations: Association of Americans Resident Overseas (AARO), Citizenship Solutions and University of Queensland - Business School

detail.title: FBAR Penalty: Appropriating Retirement Savings of the Elderly?
detail.abstract:
On November 7, 2025 the U.S. Justice Department, acting on the request of the secretary of the Treasury, brought an action against an elderly couple living in Christchurch, New Zealand.  The Action alleges that the couple willfully failed to report their interest in foreign financial accounts from tax years 2005 to 2012 and claims penalties of more than US $3.6 million, plus amounts for interest and late-payment.

This article: (I) summarizes the most salient facts contained in the Action; (II) identifies additional salient facts and circumstances that, while not expressly stated in the Action, can be inferred from it; and (III) provides background information that is important for understanding the Action. Ulitmately, (IV) the authors explain why the Action  is an unconscionable attempt by the United States to appropriate the retirement savings of an elderly couple living outside the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美国司法部起诉一对新西兰老年夫妇未申报海外金融账户的案件，认为这是美国不当征收海外居民退休储蓄的不合理行为。
AI.research_question: 美国司法部对居住在新西兰的老年夫妇提起的未申报海外金融账户诉讼是否合理？该行动是否构成美国不当征收海外居民退休储蓄的不道德行为？
AI.motivation: 美国政府对海外居民采取严厉的税务执法行动，特别是针对老年夫妇的退休储蓄征收巨额罚款，引发了对税收公平性和执法合理性的质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收管辖权理论、国际税收合规原则、纳税人权利保护理论、跨境税务执法合理性分析框架。
AI.method: 1) 总结诉讼文件中的关键事实；2) 推断诉讼中未明确陈述但可推知的重要事实和情况；3) 提供理解该诉讼所需的背景信息；4) 分析论证该诉讼的不合理性。
AI.findings: 该诉讼是美国试图不当征收海外居民退休储蓄的不道德行为，针对老年夫妇追缴2005-2012年间的未申报账户，索赔超过360万美元加利息和滞纳金，缺乏合理性和公平性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨境税务执法中权力滥用和纳税人权利保护的理论分析框架，丰富了国际税收合规与纳税人公平待遇的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海外美国纳税人提供法律风险警示，为税务从业者提供案例分析参考，为政策制定者提供跨境税务执法合理性的评估视角。

detail.abstract: For more than two decades now terrorism has rampage the world, causing diverse damming consequences. These include kidnapping, torture, maiming and killing of innocent people globally by terrorist. The worst victims of terrorism are women and children as it is always the case in situation of unrest. Following the incessant terrorist acts which before now were concentrated mostly in the Middle-East, albeit, now affecting almost every corner of the world, the United Nations and law enforcement agencies of various countries declared that the best way to win the fight against terrorism is through the use of artificial intelligence. In this choice of the use of Al in the fight against terrorism the major concern remains the question of abuse of the use of Al. This concern is especially so considering the antecedent of the government and law enforcement in flagrant abuse of rights of the citizens. Given that security is a duty incumbent on the government- to secure it national borders and be free from threat(s) or actual attack(s) either from within or from without on the one hand, and the protection of the rights of individuals against unwarranted government incursion, this paper thus seeks a balance between these competing interests. It therefore espouses the concept of Al and its use in the in terrorism prevention, investigation and ultimate prosecution. While it observes the advantages of the use of Al in the fight against terrorism, this article also seeks to balance its use against the competing right of privacy of the individual. It begins by the discussion of general concept of Al. Secondly, it delves into the various uses of Al. The subsequent section discusses the challenges of the use of Al in terrorism detection and prevention. Lastly, it concludes with a proposal towards a balance use of Al and the protection of individual privacy right.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在反恐斗争中应用人工智能时，如何在国家安全需求与个人隐私权保护之间寻求平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何在反恐斗争中平衡人工智能的应用与个人隐私权的保护？
AI.motivation: 恐怖主义在全球范围内造成严重危害，特别是对妇女和儿童的伤害。联合国和各国执法机构认为人工智能是反恐的有效工具，但政府滥用AI侵犯公民权利的历史令人担忧，需要在国家安全与个人权利之间找到平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家安全理论、隐私权理论、人工智能伦理框架、政府权力与公民权利平衡理论。
AI.method: 概念分析法和理论探讨法。首先讨论人工智能的一般概念，其次探讨AI的各种用途，接着分析在恐怖主义检测和预防中使用AI的挑战，最后提出平衡方案。
AI.findings: 人工智能在反恐预防、调查和起诉中具有显著优势，但存在被政府滥用以侵犯公民隐私权的风险。需要在技术应用与权利保护之间建立适当的平衡机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在反恐背景下人工智能应用与隐私权保护的平衡理论框架，为数字时代国家安全与个人权利的协调提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和执法机构提供了在反恐工作中合理使用人工智能的指导原则，有助于建立既有效打击恐怖主义又保护公民隐私权的实践框架。

title: Efficiencies Under The Digital Markets Act -Is There Space For The Rule Of Reason?

detail.title: Efficiencies Under The Digital Markets Act -Is There Space For The Rule Of Reason?

declarations.funderStatement: The paper was prepared within project Jean Monnet Network European Union and the Challenges of Modern Society (Legal Issues of Digitalization, Robotization, Cyber Security and Prevention of Hybrid Threats) Project ID: 611293-EPP-1-2019-1-CZ-EPPJMO-NETWORK

detail.abstract: The aim of this paper is to evaluate, if competition-like efficiencies of European-style rule of reason shall apply also in the context of the ex-ante regulation by the DMA. The rationale of such consideration lies in the concept of proportionality of the EU regulation and the assumption that EU law cannot proscribe behaviour with beneficial outcomes and effects that does not have negative consequences on the internal market outweighing the positive effects. The analysis is divided into three parts in this paper: position of the rule of law and the per se prohibition in the legal development of the EU competition law, the relationship between the DMA and competition law, including competition-based efficiencies brought in digital market cases and finally the per se prohibition included in the DMA. The analysis of the development of the case law showed that in the EU competition law the principle of per se prohibitions was never accepted and the CJEU accepted justifications outside the text of the statutory exemptions. Even though the aim of the DMA may be the introduction of a per se prohibition in order to facilitate the Commission's enforcement, it cannot be surprising if the CJ EU will, in some case in the future, follow the path of the EU-style rule of reason in the framework of the DMA as well on the basis of proportionality principle. The lesson learned from application of rule of reason in the context of agreements restricting competition or as a specific form of objective justification in the context of abuse of dominant position does not undermine effectiveness of competition law. The quasi per se concept can satisfy both: it shows that it is not probable that such a behaviour will be allowed and at the same time it dodges proportionality objections because the prohibition is not, at least theoretically, absolutely, per se.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟竞争法中的"合理规则"效率是否应适用于《数字市场法案》的事前监管，认为尽管DMA旨在引入本身违法原则以简化执法，但欧盟法院未来仍可能基于比例原则在DMA框架下适用合理规则分析。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争法中的合理规则效率是否应适用于《数字市场法案》的事前监管框架？
AI.motivation: 欧盟监管的比例原则要求法律不能禁止那些具有积极效果且对内部市场负面影响不超过正面影响的行为，这促使作者思考竞争法中的效率分析是否应延伸至数字市场监管。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法中的合理规则分析、本身违法原则、比例原则、欧盟法院判例法发展、数字市场监管理论。
AI.method: 法律分析方法，分为三部分：1) 欧盟竞争法中本身违法原则的法律发展；2) DMA与竞争法的关系，包括数字市场案例中的竞争效率；3) DMA中的本身违法规定。
AI.findings: 1) 欧盟竞争法从未完全接受本身违法原则，欧盟法院接受法定豁免之外的正当理由；2) 尽管DMA旨在引入本身违法原则以简化执法，但欧盟法院未来可能基于比例原则在DMA框架下适用合理规则分析；3) 准本身违法概念既能表明行为不太可能被允许，又能避免比例原则的反对。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将竞争法中的合理规则分析扩展到数字市场监管领域；2) 提出准本身违法概念作为调和严格执法与比例原则的解决方案；3) 论证比例原则在数字市场监管中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为DMA执法提供灵活性框架；2) 为数字平台企业提供法律确定性；3) 为欧盟法院未来审理DMA案件提供分析思路；4) 平衡监管效率与法律正当性。

title: The Economics of the Data-driven Economy and the Demand for Antitrust

detail.title: The Economics of the Data-driven Economy and the Demand for Antitrust
detail.abstract: Increasing returns to scale in the heyday of industrialization in the late 19th century and early 20th century concentrated wealth and power in a Gilded Age. This triggered demand for antitrust activism. A similar dynamic is visible in today’s second Gilded Age, this time in the context of the data-driven economy based on the nexus of big data, machine learning and artificial intelligence. The scaling up of markets through globalization turned out to be the answer to the social and political issues raised by scale economies in the first Gilded Age. Technological change may yet be the answer to the social and political issues emerging in the second Gilded Age. However, the proliferation of firms developing AI-enabled applications has not translated into a commensurate diffusion of economic or political power. Control over the foundational layers of machine knowledge capital — training data at scale, frontier models, compute infrastructure and algorithmic distribution channels — remains highly concentrated. At the same time, the political economy is evolving in a direction antithetical to antitrust enforcement; antitrust activism as a response to the excesses of the data-driven economy has been subordinated to geopolitics. The concentration of economic power through rent capture has been compounded by the concentration of narrative authority. In short, the gilding on the new Gilded Age is thickening, not eroding. Antitrust is an instrument of the state — and the very nature of the state is now an open question in the face of transformational technological change.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了当前数据驱动经济时代（第二镀金时代）中，尽管AI应用企业数量激增，但经济和政治权力仍高度集中在少数控制机器学习资本基础层的企业手中，反垄断行动被地缘政治所取代，导致财富和权力集中加剧。
AI.research_question: 在数据驱动经济的第二镀金时代，为什么AI应用企业的扩散未能带来相应的经济和政治权力分散？反垄断作为应对经济权力集中的工具面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 当前数据驱动经济（基于大数据、机器学习和人工智能）呈现出与19世纪末20世纪初工业化时期相似的财富和权力集中现象，形成了"第二镀金时代"。尽管AI应用企业数量激增，但经济和政治权力仍然高度集中，反垄断行动被地缘政治所取代，导致权力集中问题加剧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 镀金时代理论、规模经济理论、反垄断理论、数据驱动经济的政治经济学、机器学习资本理论（包括训练数据、前沿模型、计算基础设施和算法分发渠道的控制）
AI.method: 历史比较分析（第一镀金时代与第二镀金时代的对比）、政治经济学分析、制度分析
AI.findings: 1. AI应用企业的扩散并未带来经济或政治权力的相应分散；2. 机器学习资本的基础层（大规模训练数据、前沿模型、计算基础设施、算法分发渠道）控制权高度集中；3. 政治经济环境朝着不利于反垄断执法的方向发展，反垄断行动被地缘政治所取代；4. 经济权力通过租金捕获的集中与叙事权威的集中相互强化；5. 新镀金时代的"镀金"正在加厚而非消褪。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"机器学习资本"的概念框架，强调基础层控制的重要性；2. 发展了第二镀金时代理论，将历史比较分析应用于数据驱动经济；3. 揭示了反垄断工具在技术变革背景下的局限性；4. 分析了经济权力集中与叙事权威集中的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示政策制定者关注AI经济中的基础层控制问题；2. 指出单纯依赖技术变革无法解决社会政治问题；3. 强调需要重新思考国家在技术变革时代的角色；4. 为反垄断政策制定提供新的分析视角。

detail.title: Model Perspectives on Supply and Demand Factors behind a Soft Labor Market

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: U.S. employment growth slowed down notably in the second part of 2025, and a key question is how much of the weakness stems from labor demand and how much from labor supply. In this note, we examine this question from the point of view of two different models: a statistical model that uses an intuitive interpretation of the joint behavior of employment and wage growth to infer the effects of labor supply and demand (VAR), and a structural dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model that uses a much wider array of data.

AI.tldr: 本文通过VAR和DSGE两种模型分析2025年下半年美国就业增长放缓的原因，区分劳动力需求和供给的影响
AI.research_question: 2025年下半年美国就业增长放缓的主要原因是劳动力需求不足还是劳动力供给受限？
AI.motivation: 2025年下半年美国就业增长显著放缓，需要理解这一现象背后的驱动因素，以制定有效的政策应对措施
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 向量自回归模型（VAR）：基于就业和工资增长的联合行为推断劳动力供给和需求影响
2. 动态随机一般均衡模型（DSGE）：结构模型，利用更广泛的数据集进行分析
AI.method: 使用两种互补的计量经济学方法：统计VAR模型和结构DSGE模型，从不同角度分析就业增长放缓的原因
AI.findings: 论文摘要未提供具体结果，但表明通过两种模型的分析可以量化劳动力需求和供给对就业增长放缓的相对贡献
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 比较VAR和DSGE两种方法在分析劳动力市场动态方面的优势和局限性
2. 为理解就业增长放缓的结构性原因提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供区分劳动力需求和供给因素的分析工具
2. 帮助制定更有针对性的劳动力市场政策以应对就业增长放缓

title: Outsourcing and Efficiency in the Management of Rural Water Services
affiliations: Universidad de Granada, University of Granada, University of Jaén and University of Jaén

detail.title: Outsourcing and Efficiency in the Management of Rural Water Services
detail.abstract:
Rural areas are finding it increasingly difficult to manage water services for household
purposes. Local governments cannot afford the high investment andmaintenance costs the
service entails, leading many rural towns in Spain to outsource the service. Doing so enables
local governments to balance their budgets and professionalise management in response to the
more exacting requirements imposed by European water regulations. In Spain it is possible to
outsource the management of the water service to a public, private or public-private company.
This research applies Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to a sample of 80 rural water utilities
in Southern Spain in order to compare the efficiency of these three forms of management.
Despite initially finding that private companies and public-private partnerships are more
efficient than public companies, no differences in efficiency can be observed between the three
forms ofmanagement when environmental variables are taken into consideration. Results show
that public-private partnerships are no less efficient than fully private or fully public companies.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用数据包络分析（DEA）比较了西班牙南部80个农村供水设施的三种管理模式（公有、私有、公私合营）的效率。研究发现，在考虑环境变量后，三种管理模式之间没有效率差异，公私合营模式并不比完全私有或完全公有的公司效率低。
AI.research_question: 西班牙农村供水服务的三种管理模式（公有、私有、公私合营）在效率上是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 农村地区管理家庭用水服务日益困难，地方政府难以承担高昂的投资和维护成本，许多西班牙农村城镇选择外包服务以平衡预算并实现专业化管理，以符合欧盟更严格的水资源法规要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共管理理论、私有化效率理论和公私合作伙伴关系理论，探讨不同所有权结构对公共服务效率的影响。
AI.method: 采用数据包络分析（DEA）方法，对西班牙南部80个农村供水设施进行效率比较分析，考虑了环境变量对效率评估的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 初步分析显示私有公司和公私合营比公有公司更高效；2. 但当考虑环境变量后，三种管理模式之间没有显著效率差异；3. 公私合营模式在效率上并不逊色于完全私有或完全公有的公司。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了私有化必然带来效率提升的传统观点，强调了环境因素在效率评估中的重要性，为公共服务管理模式选择提供了更平衡的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府选择供水服务管理模式提供了实证依据，表明公私合营是可行的替代方案，有助于政策制定者在预算约束和法规要求下做出更明智的决策。

title: Trade Wars and Disruptions in Global Supply Chains in an Era of Growing Uncertainty
affiliations: Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University and Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University (TSU)

detail.title: Trade Wars and Disruptions in Global Supply Chains in an Era of Growing Uncertainty
detail.abstract: This article examines how global supply chains are reshaping themselves in response to the changing world order. The article focuses on conceptual changes in global trade, in particular the paradigm shift from prioritizing efficiency to an emphasis on sustainability, as well as the growing role of technological sovereignty as a key element of national economic strategy. Based on the obtained results, it is concluded that despite the negative impact of factors such as trade conflicts, supply chain disruptions and a high degree of global uncertainty, these challenges simultaneously open up new opportunities for innovative development, increased adaptability, and strategic restructuring. The article highlights the importance of proactive and sustainable management approaches that can transform crisis phenomena into impulses for inclusive and long-term economic growth at both the national and global levels.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨全球供应链如何因应世界秩序变化而重塑，分析从效率优先到可持续性优先的范式转变，以及技术主权作为国家经济战略关键要素的日益重要角色。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链如何因应变化的世界秩序进行重塑？特别是贸易范式从效率优先转向可持续性优先，以及技术主权作为国家经济战略关键要素的角色变化？
AI.motivation: 全球贸易冲突、供应链中断和高度不确定性对全球经济造成负面影响，但同时这些挑战也为创新发展和战略重组提供了新机遇，需要研究如何将危机转化为包容性和长期经济增长的动力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球供应链理论、贸易范式转变理论（从效率到可持续性）、技术主权理论、危机转化理论、适应性战略管理理论。
AI.method: 基于文献分析和概念框架构建的理论研究，可能包括案例分析和趋势分析。
AI.findings: 尽管贸易冲突、供应链中断和全球不确定性带来负面影响，但这些挑战同时为创新发展、适应性增强和战略重组创造了新机会。技术主权已成为国家经济战略的关键要素，可持续性优先的范式正在取代传统的效率优先范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了全球供应链重塑的理论框架，提出了从效率到可持续性的范式转变理论，深化了技术主权在全球化背景下的理论意义，构建了危机转化为经济增长动力的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家和企业提供了前瞻性和可持续的管理方法，帮助将危机现象转化为包容性和长期经济增长的推动力，为政策制定者提供了技术主权战略的实践指导，为企业供应链重组提供了战略方向。

title: The Spillovers of LSAPs on Banks in the Euro Area
affiliations: ,  and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Spillovers of LSAPs on Banks in the Euro Area

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-005, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.005]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study the spillovers of large-scale asset purchases (LSAPs) in the U.S. on financial intermediation in the euro area using bank-level supervisory data and high-frequency identified policy surprises. Our detailed panel data permit us to trace the impact of LSAPs through bank balance sheets. We find that the Federal Reserve affects credit provision in the euro area through a channel that we refer to as the ``international bank capital channel'' of unconventional monetary policy. In response to an LSAP shock that leads to a steepening of the U.S. Treasury yield curve, the Treasury positions of euro area banks shrink, capital ratios worsen, and banks that are less well capitalized contract their lending relative to banks that are better capitalized. Our results are consistent with an important role of revaluation effects, imperfect risk hedging, and credit as an adjustment margin for banks in the proximity of regulatory capital constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用银行层面的监管数据和高频政策冲击识别，分析了美国大规模资产购买（LSAPs）对欧元区金融中介的溢出效应。研究发现美联储通过"国际银行资本渠道"影响欧元区信贷供给，当LSAP冲击导致美国国债收益率曲线陡峭化时，欧元区银行的国债头寸收缩、资本比率恶化，资本状况较差的银行相对于资本状况较好的银行会收缩信贷。
AI.research_question: 美国大规模资产购买（LSAPs）如何通过银行资产负债表渠道影响欧元区的金融中介和信贷供给？
AI.motivation: 随着全球金融一体化的加深，美国非常规货币政策（如LSAPs）可能通过跨境渠道影响其他经济体的金融中介活动，但这一机制尚未得到充分研究。理解这种国际溢出效应对政策制定和金融稳定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际银行资本渠道理论：非常规货币政策通过影响银行的资产负债表，特别是国债头寸的重新估值效应，改变银行的资本状况，进而影响其信贷供给能力。该框架强调不完善的风险对冲和接近监管资本约束时信贷作为调整边际的重要性。
AI.method: 使用银行层面的监管面板数据和高频识别的政策冲击（LSAP意外事件）。通过详细的资产负债表数据追踪LSAPs的影响路径，分析美国国债收益率曲线变化对欧元区银行国债头寸、资本比率和信贷供给的异质性影响。
AI.findings: 1. LSAP冲击导致美国国债收益率曲线陡峭化时，欧元区银行的国债头寸收缩；2. 银行资本比率恶化；3. 资本状况较差的银行相对于资本状况较好的银行会显著收缩信贷；4. 重新估值效应、不完善的风险对冲以及接近监管资本约束时信贷作为调整边际是重要机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"国际银行资本渠道"理论，丰富了非常规货币政策国际溢出效应的理论框架。强调了重新估值效应和银行资本约束在跨境货币政策传导中的核心作用，为理解全球金融一体化下的政策传导提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：1. 美国货币政策对欧元区金融稳定有显著影响；2. 银行资本充足率是抵御跨境政策冲击的关键缓冲；3. 监管机构需要关注全球货币政策协调和跨境风险监测；4. 银行应加强风险管理和资本规划以应对国际政策冲击。

title: Silicon Formalism: Rules, Standards, and Judge AI
affiliations: University of Chicago - Law School and University of Chicago - Law School

detail.title: Silicon Formalism: Rules, Standards, and Judge AI

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper No. 26-02
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper replicates a judicial experiment originally conducted on 61 U.S. federal judges, this time with GPT-5 as the decision-maker. The experiment involves a choice-of-law dispute in a hypothetical automobile accident case, where three variables are manipulated: (1) whether the applicable doctrine is a rule or a standard, (2) whether the plaintiff or defendant is portrayed more sympathetically, and (3) the location of the accident, which affects the legal outcome under different states' choice-of-law rules. Consistent with our prior work, we find that the LLM adheres to the legally correct outcome significantly more often than human judges. In fact, the LLM makes no errors at all.

AI.tldr: GPT-5在模拟法律判决实验中表现优于人类法官，完全遵循法律正确结果
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（GPT-5）在法律判决任务中是否比人类法官更严格遵守法律规则？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现人类法官在判决中容易受到情感因素和认知偏差影响，本研究旨在探索AI在法律决策中的表现，特别是能否比人类更严格地遵循法律规则
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律决策理论、认知偏差理论、人工智能在法律中的应用理论、规则与标准区分理论
AI.method: 复制性实验设计：使用GPT-5作为决策者，重现对美国61名联邦法官的司法实验。实验涉及一个假设的汽车事故案件中的法律选择争议，操纵三个变量：(1)适用原则是规则还是标准，(2)原告或被告是否被描绘得更具同情心，(3)事故发生地点（影响不同州法律选择规则下的法律结果）
AI.findings: GPT-5在遵循法律正确结果方面显著优于人类法官，实际上完全没有犯任何错误。这与先前研究发现一致，表明LLM能够严格遵循法律规则而不受情感因素影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为AI在法律决策中的表现提供了实证证据；2. 验证了LLM在法律规则遵循方面的优势；3. 挑战了人类法官决策优越性的传统假设；4. 为法律决策的认知偏差理论提供了对比参照
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 展示了AI在法律辅助决策中的潜在应用价值；2. 为司法系统改革提供了新视角；3. 可能影响法律教育和法官培训方法；4. 为开发法律决策支持系统提供了实证基础

title: Can Tourism Drive Economic Growth and Development? A Dual Perspective from Portugal's Regions
affiliations: University of Jaén, College of Business & Economics, University of Johannesburg, University of Jaén and University of Jaén

detail.title: Can Tourism Drive Economic Growth and Development? A Dual Perspective from Portugal's Regions
detail.abstract: The impact of tourism from an economic perspective has been widely analyzed in the empirical literature, with many works that have studied the causal relationship between tourism and economic growth and, to a lesser extent, between tourism and economic development. Both analysis streams are characterized by generally using an analysis approach at the country level or in groups of countries. Contextually, the present work offers an innovative approach by analyzing tourism's relationship with these variables with a regional approach, using NUTS-2 data from Portugal from 2001-2022. In fact, this allows us to know if the contribution of tourism to economic growth and development differs within a country. The instantaneous and Granger causality test results offer significant differences when a regional approach is used instead of analyzing the country as a whole. These results will allow the development of regional tourism policies that enable the benefits of tourism to be channeled.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用区域方法分析葡萄牙NUTS-2地区2001-2022年数据，发现旅游对经济增长和发展的贡献在地区间存在显著差异，与全国层面分析结果不同，为制定区域旅游政策提供依据。
AI.research_question: 旅游对经济增长和经济发展的贡献是否在一个国家内部的不同地区存在差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要在国家层面或国家组层面分析旅游与经济增长/发展的因果关系，缺乏对同一国家内部区域差异的研究。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨旅游贡献的地区异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游经济学、区域经济学、经济增长理论、经济发展理论、因果关系分析框架（瞬时因果关系和格兰杰因果关系）
AI.method: 采用区域分析方法，使用葡萄牙NUTS-2地区2001-2022年的面板数据，运用瞬时因果关系检验和格兰杰因果关系检验来识别旅游与经济增长/发展之间的因果关系模式。
AI.findings: 研究结果显示，当采用区域方法而非全国整体分析时，旅游与经济增长/发展之间的因果关系存在显著差异。这表明旅游对经济的影响在不同地区具有异质性，不能简单地从国家层面推断到区域层面。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将旅游经济学分析从国家层面扩展到区域层面，填补了研究空白；2. 验证了旅游经济影响的区域异质性理论；3. 为区域旅游经济分析提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了制定差异化区域旅游政策的实证依据；2. 帮助各地区根据自身旅游经济关系的特征制定针对性发展策略；3. 促进旅游效益在地区间的合理分配和最大化。

title: The Effect of Macroeconomic Shocks on Nonperforming Loans and Credit Risk in the Iranian Banking System using time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregressions
affiliations: Iran University of Science and Technology - Department of Industrial Engineering, Allameh Tabataba'i University, Lucian Blaga University of Sibiu, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Allameh Tabataba'i University - Faculty of Management and Accounting

detail.title: The Effect of Macroeconomic Shocks on Nonperforming Loans and Credit Risk in the Iranian Banking System using time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregressions
detail.abstract: The increase in macroeconomic uncertainty leads to inefficiency in the financial and banking sectors, resulting in a rise in Non-Performing Loans (NPLs). When macroeconomic uncertainty increases, financial institutions experience higher inefficiencies, reflected in increased NPLs, and with proper management solutions, the economy can move toward sustainability. This research analyzes the effect of severe macroeconomic shocks on the NPLs of the Iranian banking system using the Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregressions (TVP-VAR) model and a Panel Data Model. The study utilizes data from 2007 to 2021 on key macroeconomic indicators such as economic growth rate, inflation rate, interest rate, unemployment rate, and exchange rate, along with the ratio of Non-Current Claims to Total Facilities as an index of credit risk and the ratio of loans to total assets as a risk-taking index for banks. Our innovation lies in analyzing these variables dynamically, accounting for their correlation and mutual impact. The findings indicate that a 1% increase in inflation leads to a 0.0061% increase in NPLs, while a 1% rise in the unemployment rate results in a 0.0182% increase in NPLs. Conversely, a 1% increase in GDP growth reduces NPLs by 0.0036%. Furthermore, shocks to interest rates, exchange rates, and economic growth increase credit risk, with a 1% interest rate shock raising the default rate from 7.8% to 9.2% over time.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用TVP-VAR和面板数据模型分析宏观经济不确定性对伊朗银行不良贷款的影响，发现通胀、失业率上升会增加不良贷款，而GDP增长会减少不良贷款。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济不确定性如何影响伊朗银行系统的不良贷款？具体来说，宏观经济冲击（如通胀、失业、利率、汇率变化）对银行信贷风险和不良贷款有什么影响？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济不确定性增加导致金融和银行部门效率低下，不良贷款上升。研究伊朗银行系统在宏观经济冲击下的表现，有助于找到管理解决方案，推动经济可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济不确定性理论、信贷风险理论、银行风险承担理论，分析宏观经济变量与银行不良贷款之间的动态关系。
AI.method: 采用时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR）和面板数据模型，使用2007-2021年伊朗宏观经济指标数据（经济增长率、通胀率、利率、失业率、汇率）以及银行信贷风险指标（不良贷款率、贷款资产比）。
AI.findings: 1. 通胀率每上升1%，不良贷款增加0.0061%；2. 失业率每上升1%，不良贷款增加0.0182%；3. GDP增长每上升1%，不良贷款减少0.0036%；4. 利率、汇率和经济增长冲击会增加信贷风险，利率冲击1%会使违约率从7.8%升至9.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 动态分析宏观经济变量与银行不良贷款的相互关系；2. 验证宏观经济不确定性对银行信贷风险的传导机制；3. 为新兴市场银行风险管理提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为伊朗银行监管机构提供风险管理政策建议；2. 帮助银行在宏观经济波动时调整信贷策略；3. 为政策制定者提供稳定金融系统的参考依据。

title: Ethical Impacts of AI in Energy Transitions
affiliations: Lucian Blaga University of Sibiu and Lucian Blaga University of Sibiu

detail.title: Ethical Impacts of AI in Energy Transitions
detail.abstract: This paper examines the ethical implications of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption in energy transitions, focusing on environmental and social equity outcomes. The analysis investigates the relationship between AI-driven technological progress and environmental effects, measured by CO₂ emissions, alongside social equity impacts, captured through energy consumption per capita. Two panel regression models are estimated using annual data for the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, and the European Union over the period 2014-2022. These economies provide a comparative perspective on how distinct regulatory frameworks, technological maturity, and societal values shape the ethical integration of AI in energy systems. The results indicate that AI-related innovation, via hightechnology exports and R&D investment, can mitigate CO₂ emissions, yet it may simultaneously drive higher emissions through increased energy demand from economic expansion. While AI adoption promotes more equitable energy access in advanced regions, it may reinforce consumption inequalities elsewhere. The findings highlight both the constructive and unintended effects of AI on sustainable energy and ethics. The study underscores the need for adaptive AI governance frameworks that balance innovation with environmental responsibility and social justice in achieving sustainable energy transitions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨AI在能源转型中的伦理影响，发现AI创新能降低碳排放但也可能因经济增长增加能源需求，同时AI在发达地区促进能源公平但在其他地方可能加剧不平等。
AI.research_question: AI在能源转型中的采用如何影响环境结果（CO₂排放）和社会公平结果（人均能源消费）？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在能源系统中的应用日益广泛，需要理解其伦理影响，特别是环境可持续性和社会公平方面的双重影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术创新理论、环境经济学和社会公平理论，探讨AI驱动的技术进步与环境效应、社会公平之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用2014-2022年美国、英国、日本和欧盟的年度数据，建立两个面板回归模型，分析AI相关创新（高技术出口和研发投资）对CO₂排放和人均能源消费的影响。
AI.findings: 1. AI创新通过高技术出口和研发投资能减少CO₂排放，但经济增长带来的能源需求增加可能抵消这种积极效应；2. AI采用在发达地区促进能源公平，但在其他地区可能加剧消费不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了技术创新理论在AI伦理领域的应用；2. 提供了AI在能源转型中双重效应（环境和社会）的理论框架；3. 深化了对不同制度环境下AI伦理影响差异的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供平衡AI创新与环境责任的治理框架建议；2. 强调需要针对不同地区特点制定差异化的AI能源政策；3. 提出促进可持续能源转型的适应性治理策略。

title: The Nexus between Tourism, Economic Growth, and Environmental Pollution at a Regional Level in Spain: A New CS-ARDL Approach
affiliations: University of Jaén, University of Jaén and University of Sassari

detail.title: The Nexus between Tourism, Economic Growth, and Environmental Pollution at a Regional Level in Spain: A New CS-ARDL Approach
detail.abstract: Over recent decades, tourism has undergone rapid growth, contributing to economic growth. Moreover, recent studies have included environmental variables in their analyses, although they tend to use a country-level approach despite the fact that tourism development takes place at a regional level. This study analyzes the relationship between tourism, economic growth, and the environment in Spain during 2004-2021, using an innovative approach that analyzes the data at a regional level. The hypothesis is that tourism affects economic growth and the environment. Using econometric analysis through CS-ARDL and causality analysis, the short-and long-term relationships of the three analyzed variables have been identified, adjusting these estimates according to the presence of cross-dependency between the regions. The results verified the positive effects of tourism on economic growth, and the adverse effects of carbon dioxide emissions on tourism. Theoretical and policy implications are suggested, and limitations are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用区域层面的创新方法，分析了2004-2021年西班牙旅游业、经济增长和环境之间的关系，验证了旅游业对经济增长的积极影响以及二氧化碳排放对旅游业的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 旅游业如何影响经济增长和环境？三者之间在区域层面存在怎样的短期和长期关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在国家层面分析旅游业、经济增长和环境的关系，但旅游业发展实际上发生在区域层面，需要更精细的区域层面分析来理解这些关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游业-经济增长-环境关系理论，可持续发展理论，区域经济发展理论
AI.method: 使用CS-ARDL（横截面自回归分布滞后）模型和因果关系分析，考虑区域间的横截面依赖性，分析2004-2021年西班牙区域层面的数据
AI.findings: 1. 旅游业对经济增长有积极影响；2. 二氧化碳排放对旅游业有负面影响；3. 识别了三个变量之间的短期和长期关系
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将旅游业-经济增长-环境关系分析从国家层面扩展到区域层面；2. 考虑了区域间的横截面依赖性；3. 提供了区域层面旅游业发展的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区域旅游政策制定提供实证依据；2. 强调环境保护对旅游业可持续发展的重要性；3. 为平衡经济增长和环境保护提供政策建议

title: The Relationship between Tourism, Economic Growth and Environmental Sustainability: Empirical Evidence from Major Tourist Destinations
affiliations: University of Jaén, University of Jaén, Independent and University of Jaén

detail.title: The Relationship between Tourism, Economic Growth and Environmental Sustainability: Empirical Evidence from Major Tourist Destinations
detail.abstract: The positive impact of tourism on the economy of countries and their increasing commitment to this practice has led to numerous studies in the literature, from the emergence of the TLGH at the beginning of the century to the present day. However, destinations are no strangers to the negative externalities generated by tourism. These negative externalities respond to a harmful impact on the environment, which, together with the increasing concern of governments for the environment, has also aroused the interest of the research field. Therefore, this study, using a technique that is not widely used, focuses on the analysis of tourism, economic growth and the environment in those countries that have been part of the top 10 tourism countries during the period 1995-2023. The analysis reveals a variety of causality results. Finally, policy recommendations for improvement are made on the basis of these results.

AI.tldr: 本文使用非主流方法分析1995-2023年间全球前10大旅游国家的旅游、经济增长与环境之间的关系，揭示了多样化的因果关系，并基于结果提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 旅游、经济增长与环境之间在主要旅游国家中存在怎样的因果关系？
AI.motivation: 旅游对经济有积极影响，但也产生负面外部性（特别是环境影响）。随着政府对环境问题的日益关注，需要研究这三者之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游导向型增长假说（TLGH）、环境经济学、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 使用非主流技术方法，分析1995-2023年间全球前10大旅游国家的面板数据
AI.findings: 分析揭示了旅游、经济增长与环境之间多样化的因果关系模式
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了TLGH理论，纳入环境维度；为旅游-经济-环境三者的关系提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供基于实证结果的改进建议，促进旅游可持续发展

title: Real Estate Collateral, Lender Screening, and M&A Performance
affiliations: Macquarie University, Macquarie Business School, University of Sydney Business School and The University of Sydney - Discipline of Finance

detail.title: Real Estate Collateral, Lender Screening, and M&A Performance
detail.abstract: We study whether and how the market value of corporate real estate (REMV) shapes acquirer M&A performance. Using hand-collected loan agreements linked to M&A deals, we show that financing secured by real estate embeds tighter acquisition covenants and that, unlike other collateral, real estate collateral is associated with higher announcement returns. Instrumental-variables estimates based on headquarters-state property taxes, crime rates, and local natural-disaster exposure support a causal link from REMV to M&A deal performance. A two-by-two design crossing industry growth opportunities with acquisition covenants shows that both lender screening and financial flexibility mechanisms operate: returns are strongest when growth opportunities are high and covenants are restrictive, remain positive but smaller when only one channel is active, and vanish when both are weak. Consistent with ex-ante screening, acquirers borrowing against real estate are more likely to withdraw deals with negative announcement reactions. Our findings highlight the importance of real estate collateral in shaping corporate investment outcomes and suggest that real estate appreciation enhances firms’ capacity to undertake more disciplined and value-creating acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，企业房地产的市场价值通过贷款契约约束和财务灵活性机制，显著影响收购方并购绩效。房地产抵押贷款具有更严格的收购契约，且能带来更高的公告回报，尤其是在高增长机会和严格契约条件下效果最明显。
AI.research_question: 企业房地产的市场价值（REMV）是否以及如何影响收购方的并购绩效？
AI.motivation: 房地产作为企业重要资产，其价值变化如何通过融资渠道影响并购决策和绩效，这一机制尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贷款人筛选理论和财务灵活性理论，探讨房地产抵押如何通过契约约束和融资能力影响并购价值创造。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的贷款协议与并购交易数据，采用工具变量法（基于总部所在州的财产税、犯罪率和自然灾害暴露），并进行行业增长机会与收购契约的2×2设计分析。
AI.findings: 1）房地产抵押贷款具有更严格的收购契约；2）房地产抵押比其他抵押带来更高的公告回报；3）当增长机会高且契约严格时回报最强；4）使用房地产抵押的收购方更可能撤回负面反应的交易。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了房地产价值通过贷款人筛选和财务灵活性双重机制影响并购绩效的理论路径，丰富了资产抵押与公司投资决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业利用房地产价值进行更审慎、价值创造的并购提供实践指导，为投资者评估并购交易质量提供新视角。

title: From Phase Transitions to Modern Monetary Theory: A Framework for Analyzing the Pandemic of 2020

detail.title: From Phase Transitions to Modern Monetary Theory: A Framework for Analyzing the Pandemic of 2020

declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Analyzing the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020 requires an appreciation that price signals were no longer primary determinants of supply and demand. Economic agents were acting out of health fears, government-mandated shutdown rules, and dealing with financial distress. The economy had entered a state that was far from equilibrium. Orthodox tools, such as comparative equilibrium analysis, can tell one about state "A" and state "B," but provide no guidance as to how to analyze the phase transition. We turn to the physics of phase transitions to help us understand what essentially was a network collapse. The analysis is extended to examine whether the initial policy responses were more likely to cushion the blow or to accelerate the eventual economic recovery, which is extended into an examination of Modern Monetary Theory. Finally, we study the behavioral changes induced by the pandemic that are likely to be long-lasting and impact the pace of the recovery. And we note a variety of data anomalies that are sure to vex empirical researchers as they study the pandemic of 2020.

AI.tldr: 该论文运用物理学相变理论分析COVID-19疫情期间经济系统的网络崩溃现象，评估政策干预效果，并探讨疫情带来的长期行为变化和数据异常问题。
AI.research_question: 如何分析COVID-19疫情期间经济系统的非均衡状态和网络崩溃现象？政策干预是缓解冲击还是加速复苏？疫情将带来哪些长期行为变化？
AI.motivation: 传统均衡分析工具无法解释疫情期间经济系统的相变过程，价格信号不再是供需的主要决定因素，经济主体受健康恐惧、政府封锁和财务困境等多重因素影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理学相变理论、网络崩溃理论、现代货币理论、行为经济学
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，运用物理学相变理论分析经济网络崩溃过程，结合政策分析和行为变化观察
AI.findings: 疫情导致经济系统进入远离均衡的状态，传统分析工具失效；政策干预效果需要重新评估；疫情将引发长期行为变化；疫情期间数据存在多种异常
AI.theory_contributions: 将物理学相变理论引入经济分析，为非均衡状态下的经济系统分析提供新框架，拓展现代货币理论的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供分析疫情期间经济崩溃的新视角，帮助理解政策干预的长期影响，为实证研究者识别数据异常提供指导

title: The Hidden Cost of Remote Work: Digital Fatigue and Employee Performance
affiliations: Jamia Millia Islamia

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Remote Work: Digital Fatigue and Employee Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: The increasing reliance on digital technologies in remote work has raised concerns regarding digital fatigue and its potential impact on employee performance. Drawing on cognitive load theory and the job demands-resources model, this study examines the relationship between digital job demands, digital fatigue, and performance outcomes among remote workers. A quantitative cross-sectional design was employed, using a structured, self-administered questionnaire. Survey data were collected from 120 remote employees across multiple industries. Multiple regression analyses indicate that digital job demands are positively associated with digital fatigue (β = .46, p < .001), which in turn is negatively related to both task performance (β =-.34, p < .01) and contextual performance (β =-.28, p < .05). Furthermore, autonomy and managerial support were found to buffer these negative effects. These findings suggest that while digitally intensive remote work can undermine performance through increased fatigue, organizational resources play a critical role in mitigating these effects. The study contributes by empirically establishing digital fatigue as a key mechanism linking digital work demands to performance decline. Practical implications highlight the importance of managing digital job demands, redesigning work to enhance autonomy, and fostering supportive managerial practices to sustain performance in remote settings.

AI.tldr: 远程工作中数字工作要求通过增加数字疲劳对员工绩效产生负面影响，但自主权和管理支持可以缓冲这种负面效应。
AI.research_question: 数字工作要求如何通过数字疲劳影响远程工作者的绩效？哪些组织资源可以缓冲这种负面影响？
AI.motivation: 随着远程工作中数字技术的日益依赖，数字疲劳及其对员工绩效的潜在影响引起了关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知负荷理论和工作要求-资源模型
AI.method: 定量横断面设计，采用结构化自填问卷，收集了120名跨行业远程员工的调查数据，使用多元回归分析
AI.findings: 数字工作要求与数字疲劳正相关(β=.46)，数字疲劳与任务绩效(β=-.34)和情境绩效(β=-.28)负相关；自主权和管理支持能够缓冲这些负面效应
AI.theory_contributions: 实证确立了数字疲劳作为连接数字工作要求与绩效下降的关键机制
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了管理数字工作要求、重新设计工作以增强自主权、培养支持性管理实践的重要性，以维持远程环境中的绩效

reference: Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice
title: Bank Non-performing Loan Determinants: A comparison of European and African countries
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria and Autonomous University of Madrid (UAM)

detail.title: Bank Non-performing Loan Determinants: A comparison of European and African countries

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice

detail.abstract: The study investigates the determinants of bank non-performing loans (NPL) in European and African countries, focusing on 32 European and African countries from 2010 to 2021. The results based on the two-stage least squares regression methodology show that the number of commercial bank branch, bank liquid reserves to bank assets ratio, inflation rate, exchange rate, real interest rate and the lending rate are significant determinants of bank NPL in the full sample. Size of domestic private credit, bank capital to asset ratio, bank liquid reserve to bank asset ratio, unemployment rate, inflation rate, exchange rate, real interest rate and lending rate are significant determinants of bank NPL in European countries. Bank capital to asset ratio, bank liquid reserve to bank asset ratio and inflation rate in Africa are significant determinants of bank NPL in African countries. The implication of the results is that the determinants of bank NPL in European countries are not necessarily the drivers of bank NPL in African countries.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了欧洲和非洲国家银行不良贷款的决定因素，发现两大洲的影响因素存在显著差异。欧洲受信贷规模、资本充足率、流动性、失业率、通胀率、汇率和利率等多因素影响，而非洲主要受资本充足率、流动性和通胀率影响。
AI.research_question: 欧洲和非洲国家银行不良贷款的决定因素是什么？两大洲的影响因素是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 了解银行不良贷款的决定因素对于金融稳定和风险管理至关重要，但现有研究较少比较不同经济发展水平地区（如欧洲和非洲）的差异，这有助于制定针对性的监管政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险管理理论、宏观经济影响理论，探讨银行内部因素（如资本充足率、流动性）和外部宏观经济因素（如通胀、汇率、利率）对不良贷款的影响。
AI.method: 采用两阶段最小二乘法回归分析，样本涵盖2010-2021年32个欧洲和非洲国家的面板数据。
AI.findings: 1. 全样本中，商业银行分支机构数量、银行流动性储备比率、通胀率、汇率、实际利率和贷款利率是显著决定因素；2. 欧洲国家中，国内私人信贷规模、银行资本资产比、流动性储备比率、失业率、通胀率、汇率、实际利率和贷款利率均显著；3. 非洲国家中，仅银行资本资产比、流动性储备比率和通胀率显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了银行不良贷款决定因素存在区域异质性；2. 丰富了发展中国家与发达国家金融风险比较研究；3. 为跨区域银行风险管理理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧洲和非洲银行监管机构提供差异化的风险管理建议；2. 帮助银行根据所在地区特点调整信贷政策和风险控制措施；3. 为国际金融机构制定区域差异化政策提供参考。

title: Behavioral Corporate Finance – With Special Reference to Globalization, Liberalization and Financial Sector Reforms
affiliations: Dr. Gaur Hari Singhania Institute of Management & Research

detail.title: Behavioral Corporate Finance – With Special Reference to Globalization, Liberalization and Financial Sector Reforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No such interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No funding availed.

detail.abstract:
Behavioral corporate finance examines the effects of managerial and investor psychological biases on a firm’s corporate finance decisions (such as investment appraisal and capital structure). An emerging body of research, behavioral corporate finance focuses on the effect of psychological biases on corporate financing decisions (such as investment appraisal, capital structure, and dividend policy. 
The field of finance, so far, has dealt with certain central paradigms derived from investor rationality, viz., portfolio allocation based on expected return and risk, risk-based asset pricing models, i.e., CAPM and other similar frameworks, the pricing of contingent claims, and the MillerModigliani theorem and its augmentation by the theory of agency. While these approaches revolutionized the study of finance and brought rigor into the field, many lacunae were left outstanding by the theories. Based on the above observations, traditional finance appeared to play a limited role in understanding issues such as (i) why do individual investors trade, (ii) how do they perform, (iii) how do they choose their portfolios, and (iv) why do returns vary across stocks for reasons other than risk. Finance education in general can be more useful if it sheds specific light on active investing by addressing aspects such as (i) what mistakes to avoid while investing, and (ii) what strategies in financial markets are likely to work in terms of earning supernormal returns. Those are the main pedagogical goals of behavioral finance, which allows for explanations of financial phenomena based on non-rational behavior amongst investors. Behavioral finance — that is, finance from a broader social science perspective including psychology and sociology — is now one of the most researched areas in finance.
Behavioral corporate finance deals with various biases, like excessive optimism, overconfidence, Confirmation bias and illusion of Control. It also deals with heuristics, viz. representativeness, availability, anchoring and affect. Much of the analysis in behavioral finance (BF) has focused on the effect of investor biases on the behavior of the financial markets, taking managerial rationality.

AI.tldr: 行为公司金融研究管理者和投资者心理偏差对公司财务决策（如投资评估、资本结构、股利政策）的影响，弥补传统理性金融理论的不足，从心理学和社会学角度解释金融市场现象。
AI.research_question: 心理偏差如何影响公司财务决策？行为金融学如何解释传统理性金融理论无法解释的市场现象？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论基于投资者理性假设，但无法充分解释许多市场现象，如个体投资者交易行为、投资组合选择、股票回报差异等。需要从心理学角度理解非理性行为对金融决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论框架，包括心理偏差（过度乐观、过度自信、确认偏误、控制幻觉）和启发式（代表性、可得性、锚定、情感启发式），结合传统金融理论如CAPM、MM定理、代理理论。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，整合行为心理学与公司金融理论，分析心理偏差对公司财务决策的影响机制。
AI.findings: 心理偏差显著影响公司投资评估、资本结构和股利政策等财务决策；行为金融学能解释传统理性模型无法解释的市场异常现象；从心理学和社会学视角能更全面地理解金融决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将心理学理论融入公司金融分析框架，挑战传统理性假设，提供解释市场异常现象的新理论视角，丰富金融学理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者识别和避免投资中的心理偏差错误，指导管理者制定更理性的财务决策，为金融教育提供行为金融学教学内容，提高投资决策质量。

title: Reconstructing Voice After Exploitation: A Transformative Framework for Post-Trauma Agency in Survivors of Modern Slavery

detail.title: Reconstructing Voice After Exploitation: A Transformative Framework for Post-Trauma Agency in Survivors of Modern Slavery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, professional, or financial relationships with any individuals or organisations that could influence or be perceived to influence this research. The study was conducted independently and in accordance with recognised academic integrity standards.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve direct human participants or identifiable personal data requiring ethical approval or consent. The research was based on theoretical, doctrinal, and secondary analytical sources, complying with recognised academic ethical standards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific financial funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body and was conducted as an independent academic scholarly contribution.

detail.abstract: This article interrogates the ontology of modern slavery within the conflict-fragility nexus of South Sudan, Somalia, Eritrea, the Central African Republic (CAR), and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). It posits that the current international legal architecture, anchored by the Palermo Protocol, suffers from a "protectionist paradox," prioritising criminal prosecution over the restoration of survivor subjectivity. Utilizing an interdisciplinary framework merging International Human Rights Law, Symbolic Interactionism, and Trauma Psychology, the research deconstructs the phenomenology of "silencing" as a structural erasure of the self. It challenges the binary of the "Ideal Victim," arguing that the "Complex Survivor" in conflict zones requires a nuanced conception of agency that transcends the passive recipient model of humanitarian aid. The article proposes a Transformative Framework for Post-Trauma Agency, operationalised through three pillars: Somatic Re-inhabitation (reclaiming the body), Epistemic Restitution (reclaiming the narrative), and Civic Transposition (reclaiming political power). It concludes that sustainable reintegration requires shifting the normative paradigm from a rhetoric of rescue to a praxis of empowerment, recommending specific institutional mechanisms such as "Sovereign Survivors Trust" and "Transnational Agency Protocols" to institutionalise the survivor's voice as a form of governance.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视南苏丹、索马里、厄立特里亚、中非共和国和刚果民主共和国等冲突脆弱性背景下的现代奴隶制本体论，指出当前以《巴勒莫议定书》为基础的国际法律架构存在"保护主义悖论"，过度强调刑事起诉而忽视幸存者主体性的恢复。文章提出一个融合创伤心理学的变革性框架，强调从"救援话语"转向"赋权实践"。
AI.research_question: 在冲突脆弱性背景下，现代奴隶制幸存者的主体性如何被国际法律架构中的"保护主义悖论"所消解？如何构建一个能够恢复幸存者主体性的变革性框架？
AI.motivation: 当前国际反奴隶制法律框架（特别是《巴勒莫议定书》）过度强调刑事起诉，忽视了冲突地区幸存者的主体性恢复需求，形成了"保护主义悖论"，导致幸存者被简化为被动受害者而非具有能动性的主体。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 国际人权法（批判性分析现有法律框架）
2. 符号互动主义（分析主体性建构过程）
3. 创伤心理学（理解幸存者的心理恢复过程）
4. "理想受害者"与"复杂幸存者"的二元对立批判
AI.method: 跨学科理论分析框架，结合法律批判、社会学理论和心理学概念，对冲突脆弱性背景下的现代奴隶制现象进行本体论审视和现象学解构。
AI.findings:
1. 国际法律架构存在"保护主义悖论"，优先刑事起诉而忽视幸存者主体性恢复
2. "沉默"现象是结构性自我消解的表现
3. 冲突地区的幸存者需要超越"理想受害者"二元对立的"复杂幸存者"概念
4. 需要从救援话语转向赋权实践的范式转变
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"保护主义悖论"概念，批判现有国际法律框架
2. 发展"复杂幸存者"理论，挑战"理想受害者"二元对立
3. 构建"创伤后能动性变革框架"，包含身体、叙事和政治三个维度
4. 提出从救援话语到赋权实践的规范性范式转变
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出"创伤后能动性变革框架"的三个支柱：身体再居住、认知恢复、公民置换
2. 建议具体制度机制："主权幸存者信托"和"跨国能动性协议"
3. 为冲突地区幸存者可持续重返社会提供操作性方案
4. 将幸存者声音制度化为治理形式

title: Perceived Risk and Online Shopping Behaviour in Pakistan Evidence from a Post-COVID E-Commerce Context
affiliations: American College, Nicosia

detail.title: Perceived Risk and Online Shopping Behaviour in Pakistan Evidence from a Post-COVID E-Commerce Context
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of e-commerce has transformed consumer purchasing behaviour in developing economies; however, concerns related to perceived risk and trust continue to hinder the widespread adoption of online shopping. This study examines the influence of perceived risk factors on online shopping behaviour in Pakistan within a post-COVID e-commerce context. Drawing on the Theory of Planned Behavior and perceived risk theory, the study investigates the effects of financial risk, product risk, convenience risk, non-delivery risk, and return policy risk on consumers' online shopping behaviour. A quantitative research design was employed using primary survey data collected in 2021 from university students and working professionals in major urban centres of Pakistan. Responses were manually screened for completeness and analysed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, and multiple regression analysis. The findings indicate that financial risk and non-delivery risk exert the strongest negative influence on online shopping behaviour, while product risk and convenience risk also significantly affect consumers' purchasing decisions. Return policy risk demonstrates a weaker but still relevant effect. The study contributes empirical evidence from a developing-country context and highlights the continued importance of perceived risk in shaping online consumer behaviour in post-pandemic digital markets. The findings offer practical implications for e-commerce platforms, logistics providers, and policymakers seeking to strengthen consumer trust and promote sustainable growth in Pakistan's digital economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在巴基斯坦后疫情电子商务背景下，感知风险因素对在线购物行为的影响。研究发现财务风险和非交付风险对在线购物行为有最强的负面影响，而产品风险和便利风险也显著影响消费者的购买决策。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦后疫情电子商务背景下，感知风险因素（财务风险、产品风险、便利风险、非交付风险、退货政策风险）如何影响消费者的在线购物行为？
AI.motivation: 电子商务在发展中国家的快速扩张改变了消费者购买行为，但感知风险和信任问题仍然阻碍在线购物的广泛采用。特别是在后疫情时代，需要了解特定风险因素如何影响巴基斯坦消费者的在线购物决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论和感知风险理论。研究基于这两个理论框架，探讨五种具体风险因素对在线购物行为的影响。
AI.method: 定量研究设计，采用2021年收集的原始调查数据。样本包括巴基斯坦主要城市中心的大学生和职场专业人士。使用描述性统计、卡方检验和多元回归分析进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 财务风险和非交付风险对在线购物行为有最强的负面影响；产品风险和便利风险也显著影响消费者的购买决策；退货政策风险影响较弱但仍相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家背景下的感知风险理论提供了实证证据；强调了后疫情时代数字市场中感知风险在塑造在线消费者行为中的持续重要性；扩展了计划行为理论在电子商务风险情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子商务平台、物流提供商和政策制定者提供实践启示，帮助他们加强消费者信任并促进巴基斯坦数字经济的可持续发展；识别了需要优先解决的关键风险领域。

title: Externally Governed Learning Systems (EGLS): A Structural Governance Standard for Adaptive and Learning Systems
affiliations: Boston University Metropolitan College

detail.title: Externally Governed Learning Systems (EGLS): A Structural Governance Standard for Adaptive and Learning Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or commercial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. This work was developed independently as a normative governance and policy standard proposal. No external organizations, vendors, or institutions influenced the content, conclusions, or framing of the standard.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work does not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or identifiable personal data. As a normative governance and policy standard, it does not require ethics committee approval or informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding. The development of this draft standard was conducted independently by the author.

contentFormat.other: Normative governance standard (policy and technical standard)

detail.abstract: Adaptive and learning enabled systems are increasingly deployed in regulated and safety critical environments including healthcare, finance, public administration, and infrastructure. While technical research has focused on improving accuracy, fairness, and explainability, many real world failures arise instead from governance drift. Learning systems optimize faithfully, but toward latent institutional incentives, proxy objectives, or workflow constraints that diverge from regulatory or policy intent. This paper introduces Externally Governed Learning Systems (EGLS), a normative governance standard that requires a strict structural separation between learning logic and governance authority. In an EGLS, adaptive components are constrained by an external, invariant governance layer that cannot be modified, optimized, or inferred by the learning process itself. EGLS reframes oversight of learning systems from outcome-based auditing to structural accountability. The paper defines core concepts, normative requirements, prohibited behaviors, required artifacts, a certification and attestation model, and a public registry framework. The standard is implementation-agnostic, vendor-neutral, and designed for regulatory, certification, and procurement use, complementing existing risk management frameworks rather than replacing them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"外部治理学习系统"(EGLS)作为规范性治理标准，要求学习逻辑与治理权威严格分离，通过外部不变的治理层约束自适应组件，将学习系统监督从结果审计转向结构问责。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够防止治理漂移、确保学习系统始终符合监管意图的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 自适应和学习系统越来越多地部署在受监管和安全关键环境中，但许多现实世界失败源于治理漂移而非技术问题。学习系统可能优化到符合机构激励、代理目标或工作流约束，却偏离监管或政策意图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部治理学习系统(EGLS)理论框架，强调学习逻辑与治理权威的结构性分离，提出治理层不变性、不可优化性、不可推断性等核心原则。
AI.method: 规范性标准制定方法，包括核心概念定义、规范性要求、禁止行为、必要工件、认证与证明模型、公共注册框架的设计。
AI.findings: EGLS框架能够将学习系统监督从结果审计转向结构问责，提供实施无关、供应商中立的治理标准，补充而非替代现有风险管理框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了外部治理学习系统的理论框架，重新定义了学习系统治理范式，从结果导向转向结构问责，为监管、认证和采购提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接用于监管、认证和采购的治理标准，包括具体实施要求、禁止行为清单、必要文档工件、认证流程和公共注册框架。

title: Myth and Legend as Organizational Technologies: A Comparative Analysis of Legitimacy and Coordination Mechanisms from Alexander, Napoleon to Musk
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Myth and Legend as Organizational Technologies: A Comparative Analysis of Legitimacy and Coordination Mechanisms from Alexander, Napoleon to Musk
detail.abstract: Myth and legend are often treated as cultural byproducts or branding garnish. This paper argues instead that they function as an organizational technology: a high-leverage mechanism for legitimacy production and coordination under conditions of rapid scaling, institutional weakness, and informational overload. Building on bounded attention and mediated visibility, I propose a cross-era mechanism-chain model in which structural pressures are translated—via narrative apparatuses (e.g., rituals and coinage, state bulletins and commemorative media, platform algorithms and virality)—into psychosocial mechanisms of meaning compression, commitment lock-in, attention aggregation, and identity adhesion. These mechanisms generate organizational outcomes such as cohesion, discipline, resource inflow, and bargaining power, while also producing predictable backfire loops (failure amplification, bad-news suppression, strategic overconfidence, and succession fragility). Using a comparative, process-tracing design across Alexander, Napoleon, and Elon Musk, the paper specifies boundary conditions and eight falsifiable propositions, including the “Newton puzzle”: when authority must travel faster than verifiable evidence, narrative governance becomes a rational substitute for slow validation. The analysis highlights a platform-era shift from stability-oriented myth infrastructures to leverage-oriented algorithmic charisma, shortening the narrative half-life and increasing reputational volatility. The framework offers testable predictions for organizational communication and platform governance research, and clarifies when mythic leadership enhances coordination versus when it delays institutionalization and destabilizes succession.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神话传说是一种组织技术，在快速扩张、制度薄弱和信息过载条件下，通过叙事装置将结构压力转化为意义压缩、承诺锁定、注意力聚合和身份粘附等心理社会机制，从而产生组织凝聚力、纪律性、资源流入和议价能力等结果，但也可能引发失败放大、坏消息压制、战略过度自信和继承脆弱性等反噬循环。
AI.research_question: 神话传说如何作为一种组织技术，在快速扩张、制度薄弱和信息过载的条件下，通过叙事机制产生合法性和协调作用？
AI.motivation: 传统上神话传说被视为文化副产品或品牌装饰，但本文认为它们实际上是一种高杠杆的组织技术，特别适用于快速扩张、制度薄弱和信息过载的环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有限注意力和媒介可见性理论，提出跨时代的机制链模型，包括叙事装置（仪式、铸币、国家公报、纪念媒体、平台算法、病毒传播）和心理社会机制（意义压缩、承诺锁定、注意力聚合、身份粘附）。
AI.method: 采用比较性过程追踪设计，分析亚历山大、拿破仑和埃隆·马斯克三个案例，确定边界条件和八个可证伪命题。
AI.findings: 神话叙事产生组织凝聚力、纪律性、资源流入和议价能力等积极结果，但也产生可预测的反噬循环（失败放大、坏消息压制、战略过度自信、继承脆弱性）。平台时代从稳定性导向的神话基础设施转向杠杆导向的算法魅力，缩短了叙事半衰期并增加了声誉波动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"牛顿谜题"：当权威传播速度必须快于可验证证据时，叙事治理成为缓慢验证的理性替代品。为组织传播和平台治理研究提供可测试预测，阐明神话领导何时增强协调性，何时延迟制度化和破坏继承稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织领导者提供理解神话叙事作为治理工具的框架，帮助识别何时使用叙事治理有效，何时可能导致反噬效应。为平台治理者提供管理算法魅力和声誉波动的见解。

title: Hanford Remediation Economics: Cost Escalation Assumptions

detail.title: Hanford Remediation Economics: Cost Escalation Assumptions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research is based on committee work for the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine (NASEM).
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive funding from any source, although travel expenses to NASEM committee meetings were reimbursed.

detail.abstract: The US Department of Energy-Office of Environmental Management’s (DOE-EM’s) cost estimate of Hanford’s Waste Treatment Plant (WTP) has grown from $700 million in 1987 dollars (or $1.9B in 2024 dollars) to a remaining estimated cost of $10.1 to $20.3 billion in 2025, when the Hanford site’s total remaining estimated cleanup costs ranged from $364 billion to $589 billion. The scope has evolved, following the “Tri-Party Agreement” between the US Department of Energy, the US Environmental Protection Agency, and the Washington State Department of Ecology, which was first signed in 1989. It is difficult to identify the sources of cost increases due to the almost continuous changes in scope. This paper examines the hypothesis that the cost escalation in Hanford cost estimates is approximately 2–4% nominal, the rate Hanford remediation cost estimators use. This paper recommends that Hanford cost estimators use a real escalation rate of at least 4 % with Office of Management and Budget real discount rates. If the real escalation rate exceeds the real interest rate on 30-year government bonds, the discount rate could be negative, implying higher present values of program costs than previously estimated.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国能源部汉福德核废料处理厂成本估算大幅增长的原因，发现当前使用的2-4%名义成本增长率过低，建议采用至少4%的实际增长率，并考虑负贴现率对项目成本现值的影响。
AI.research_question: 汉福德核废料处理厂成本估算大幅增长的原因是什么？当前使用的2-4%名义成本增长率是否合理？应如何调整成本估算方法？
AI.motivation: 汉福德核废料处理厂成本从1987年的7亿美元（2024年价值19亿美元）增长到2025年的101-203亿美元，而整个汉福德场地的清理成本估计高达3640-5890亿美元。由于项目范围持续变化，难以确定成本增长的具体原因，需要系统分析成本估算方法的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本估算理论、实际与名义增长率差异、贴现率理论、政府债券利率与项目成本增长率的关系、负贴现率概念在长期公共项目中的应用。
AI.method: 基于历史成本数据的分析，比较名义增长率与实际增长率的差异，结合政府债券利率和项目管理预算办公室的实际贴现率，评估成本估算方法的合理性。
AI.findings: 当前汉福德成本估算使用的2-4%名义增长率过低，实际增长率应至少为4%。如果实际增长率超过30年期政府债券的实际利率，贴现率可能为负，这意味着项目成本的现值将高于之前的估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在长期公共项目中考虑实际增长率与政府债券利率关系的重要性，引入了负贴现率概念在成本估算中的应用，为大型公共基础设施项目的成本估算提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议汉福德成本估算者使用至少4%的实际增长率，并结合管理预算办公室的实际贴现率。如果实际增长率超过30年期政府债券的实际利率，应考虑使用负贴现率，这将导致项目成本现值被重新评估，为决策者提供更准确的成本预测。

title: Entrepreneurial Learning in an Experiential and Competences Training Context: A Business Plan in Bachelor Thesis
affiliations: and Complutense University of Madrid

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Learning in an Experiential and Competences Training Context: A Business Plan in Bachelor Thesis
detail.abstract: The objective of this research consists of analysing the impact of carrying out Bachelor thesis (BT) subject-focused on the creation of a new venture by implementation and elaboration of a business plan-on learning outcomes. Thus, a combination of competences is analysed and evaluated between prior and after to carry out the BT subject-consisting of a business plan-, so as to confirm to what extent the BT contributes to the outcomes obtained in acquisition of and training in competences. The results obtained indicate important and positive improvements in the following competences: interpersonal relations, teamworking, organizational issues, leadership, change management, creativity, and in particular, entrepreneurship and the application of knowledge into practice. The choice of topic for the BT emerges as a critical tool in the orientation of training emphasis towards particular competences, such as those related to entrepreneurship. Thus, a business plan implemented properly is a way of teaching and learning-learning by doing-, and consequently, a valuable tool in the training of competences related to entrepreneurship-providing knowledge, skills, and their articulation. Such BT develops entrepreneurial competence and increases the necessary competences for different entrepreneurship itineraries, as social entrepreneurship, innovative entrepreneurship, and international entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 研究分析以创业计划为内容的学士论文对学习成果的影响，发现该方式能显著提升学生的创业能力、团队合作、领导力等多方面能力。
AI.research_question: 以创业计划为内容的学士论文对学生的学习成果（能力获得）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过学士论文这一教学环节有效培养学生的创业能力，验证"做中学"（learning by doing）方法在创业教育中的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"做中学"（learning by doing）教育理论，创业教育理论，能力培养理论。
AI.method: 采用前后对比研究方法，分析学生在完成创业计划类学士论文前后的能力变化，评估具体能力的提升程度。
AI.findings: 创业计划类学士论文显著提升了学生在人际关系、团队合作、组织能力、领导力、变革管理、创造力等方面的能力，特别是创业能力和知识应用能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了"做中学"在创业教育中的有效性，为创业教育理论提供了实证支持，丰富了能力培养的教学方法理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供了有效的创业能力培养模式，证明创业计划作为学士论文选题是培养创业能力的有效工具，可应用于社会创业、创新创业和国际创业等多种创业路径的培养。

title: Transformative Research Assessment: Integrating Societal Impacts into Evaluation Frameworks
affiliations: Leibniz Centre for Tropical Marine Research (ZMT), Autonomous University of Barcelona, Maastricht University, Independent, , French National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA) - GAEL, Independent, University of Barcelona and Independent

detail.title: Transformative Research Assessment: Integrating Societal Impacts into Evaluation Frameworks
detail.abstract: Global crises and growing public scrutiny are prompting research systems to demonstrate how they contribute to societal well-being, not just academic excellence. This white paper from the CoARA Towards Transformations Societal Impact subgroup argues that societal impact should be a core dimension of research assessment, culture, and funding. Drawing on literature, existing national and institutional frameworks, and the experience of more than twenty members across countries and disciplines, we clarify key terms, map current approaches, and propose practical ways forward. We define societal impacts as the evidenced contributions of research to improvements beyond academia and examine why these impacts are challenging to plan for, document, and evaluate in a fair manner. We review how funders and organisations are designing calls, impact planning tools, and evaluation methods, and how these shape incentives for engagement and co-creation with societal knowledge partners. Building on this analysis, we outline six guiding principles for integrating societal impact into assessment, as well as three system enablers related to capabilities, research ecosystems, and iterative learning. For funders, institutions, evaluators, and researchers, we provide role-specific recommendations that balance accountability with learning, protecting academic freedom, research diversity, and fostering long-term, transformative change. The paper aims to support CoARA members and the wider research community in aligning reforms and building a shared, plural understanding of research value. The paper contributes to the CoARA Commitment No. 1, Recognize the diversity of contributions to, and careers in, research in accordance with the needs and nature of the research, and No. 2, Base research assessment primarily on qualitative evaluation for which peer review is central, supported by responsible use of quantitative indicators.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书主张将社会影响力作为研究评估、文化和资助的核心维度，提出了整合社会影响力评估的六项指导原则和三项系统赋能要素，为研究社群提供了具体的实施建议。
AI.research_question: 如何将社会影响力有效整合到研究评估、文化和资助体系中，以平衡学术卓越与社会贡献？
AI.motivation: 全球危机和公众监督促使研究系统需要证明其对社会的贡献，而不仅仅是学术卓越。当前研究评估体系对社会影响力的考量不足，需要建立更全面的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会影响力评估理论、研究评估改革理论、知识共创理论，以及CoARA（研究评估改革协议）的承诺框架。
AI.method: 文献综述、现有国家和机构框架分析、跨20多个国家和学科成员的经验分析、概念澄清和现状映射。
AI.findings: 社会影响力评估面临规划、记录和公平评估的挑战；资助机构和组织正在设计新的征集方式、影响力规划工具和评估方法；这些方法塑造了与社会知识伙伴合作和共创的激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合社会影响力评估的六项指导原则；识别了能力、研究生态系统和迭代学习三项系统赋能要素；为研究价值提供了多元化的理解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资助者、机构、评估者和研究者提供了角色特定的建议；支持CoARA成员和研究社群进行改革协调；提供了平衡问责与学习、保护学术自由和促进长期变革的具体方法。

title: Productivity of Services in the Countries of Central and Eastern Europe: Analysis Using Malmquist Indices
affiliations: University of Jaén, University of Jaén and University of Jaén

detail.title: Productivity of Services in the Countries of Central and Eastern Europe: Analysis Using Malmquist Indices
detail.abstract: This research aims to study the growth of productivity in the service sector in the former Central and Eastern European Countries (CEECs) and their determinants. For this purpose, nonparametric frontier techniques were used to measure the variations in productivity and determine the explanatory factors of these changes in total factor productivity; the methodology of the Malmquist index with output orientation and its decomposition in technical change, pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency was used for the period 2000-2019. The results obtained indicate that the productivity of services in the most recently incorporated countries grew by 1.3 per 100 on average per year compared to 1.6 per 100 in manufacturing. The most important driver of such growth was found to be improvement in technical change (frontier shift) rather than improvement in efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用非参数前沿技术分析了2000-2019年间中东欧国家服务部门生产率增长及其决定因素，发现服务业生产率年均增长1.3%，低于制造业的1.6%，主要驱动力是技术进步而非效率提升。
AI.research_question: 中东欧国家服务部门生产率增长情况如何？影响这些国家全要素生产率变化的主要因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究服务部门在中东欧国家经济发展中的重要性，了解其生产率增长模式及驱动因素，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产率增长理论，采用非参数前沿分析框架，特别是Malmquist指数分解方法，将生产率变化分解为技术进步、纯技术效率和规模效率三个组成部分。
AI.method: 使用非参数前沿技术，采用产出导向的Malmquist指数方法，将全要素生产率变化分解为技术进步、纯技术效率和规模效率，分析2000-2019年期间中东欧国家服务部门数据。
AI.findings: 1. 中东欧国家服务部门生产率年均增长1.3%，低于制造业的1.6%；2. 生产率增长的主要驱动力是技术进步（前沿移动），而非效率提升；3. 纯技术效率和规模效率对生产率增长的贡献相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将Malmquist指数分解方法应用于中东欧国家服务部门生产率分析；2. 验证了技术进步在服务部门生产率增长中的主导作用；3. 为理解转型经济体服务部门发展模式提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中东欧国家服务部门发展政策提供实证依据；2. 强调技术创新对提升服务部门生产率的重要性；3. 为其他转型经济体服务部门发展提供参考；4. 帮助政策制定者识别生产率增长的关键驱动因素。
