detail.abstract: For more than two decades now terrorism has rampage the world, causing diverse damming consequences. These include kidnapping, torture, maiming and killing of innocent people globally by terrorist. The worst victims of terrorism are women and children as it is always the case in situation of unrest. Following the incessant terrorist acts which before now were concentrated mostly in the Middle-East, albeit, now affecting almost every corner of the world, the United Nations and law enforcement agencies of various countries declared that the best way to win the fight against terrorism is through the use of artificial intelligence. In this choice of the use of Al in the fight against terrorism the major concern remains the question of abuse of the use of Al. This concern is especially so considering the antecedent of the government and law enforcement in flagrant abuse of rights of the citizens. Given that security is a duty incumbent on the government- to secure it national borders and be free from threat(s) or actual attack(s) either from within or from without on the one hand, and the protection of the rights of individuals against unwarranted government incursion, this paper thus seeks a balance between these competing interests. It therefore espouses the concept of Al and its use in the in terrorism prevention, investigation and ultimate prosecution. While it observes the advantages of the use of Al in the fight against terrorism, this article also seeks to balance its use against the competing right of privacy of the individual. It begins by the discussion of general concept of Al. Secondly, it delves into the various uses of Al. The subsequent section discusses the challenges of the use of Al in terrorism detection and prevention. Lastly, it concludes with a proposal towards a balance use of Al and the protection of individual privacy right.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在反恐中使用人工智能的利弊平衡问题，分析AI在反恐中的优势与隐私权保护之间的冲突，并提出平衡使用方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在反恐行动中使用人工智能时，平衡国家安全需求与个人隐私权利保护？
AI.motivation: 恐怖主义全球蔓延造成严重危害，联合国和各国执法机构认为AI是反恐的有效工具，但担心政府和执法机构滥用AI侵犯公民权利，需要在国家安全与个人隐私之间寻求平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家安全理论、隐私权理论、人工智能伦理框架、政府权力与公民权利平衡理论。
AI.method: 概念分析法：首先讨论AI的一般概念，其次分析AI的各种用途，接着探讨AI在恐怖主义检测和预防中的挑战，最后提出平衡使用方案。
AI.findings: AI在反恐中具有显著优势，但存在滥用风险；需要在技术应用与隐私保护之间建立平衡机制；政府有责任同时保障国家安全和公民权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI在国家安全领域应用的伦理框架；发展了政府权力与公民隐私权平衡的理论模型；为反恐技术应用提供了规范性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和执法机构提供了AI在反恐中使用的指导原则；提出了保护个人隐私的具体措施；为政策制定者提供了平衡国家安全与个人权利的操作建议。

title: Company Law during the Blockchain Revolution: The Rise of “CorpTech”
affiliations: and Luiss Guido Carli University

detail.title: Company Law during the Blockchain Revolution: The Rise of “CorpTech”
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of blockchain and distributed ledger technologies (DLT) on company law, introducing the concept of “CorpTech” as a framework to describe technological solutions applied to corporate governance. The analysis explores whether and to what extent existing legal rules are compatible with the use of blockchain, tokens, and smart contracts in corporate contexts, focusing on the representation and circulation of shares and quotas, the exercise of economic and voting rights, and shareholder participation in corporate decision-making. Particular attention is devoted to equity tokenisation, remote shareholders’ meetings, and the use of DLT for identification purposes, including as a response to the risks posed by deepfake technologies. The paper adopts a functional and regulatory perspective, highlighting both the legal constraints that limit the adoption of CorpTech solutions and the technological limits that still prevent their full implementation. It concludes that, while the “CorpTech myth” is not yet fully realised under current company law, blockchain-based solutions already offer concrete opportunities to enhance transparency, security, and efficiency in corporate governance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨区块链和分布式账本技术（DLT）对公司法的影响，提出"CorpTech"概念作为技术应用于公司治理的框架，分析现有法律规则与区块链、代币、智能合约的兼容性，重点关注股权代币化、远程股东会议和DLT身份验证等应用。
AI.research_question: 现有法律规则在多大程度上与区块链、代币和智能合约在公司环境中的使用兼容？区块链技术如何影响股份和份额的表示与流通、经济权利和投票权的行使以及股东参与公司决策？
AI.motivation: 区块链和分布式账本技术正在改变公司治理实践，但现有法律框架可能无法充分适应这些技术创新。需要评估法律与技术之间的兼容性，以促进透明、安全和高效的公司治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: CorpTech概念框架，将技术解决方案应用于公司治理；功能性和监管视角分析；公司法律理论结合技术创新理论。
AI.method: 采用功能性和监管视角的分析方法，结合法律文本分析和案例研究，评估法律规则与技术应用的兼容性。
AI.findings: 虽然"CorpTech神话"在当前公司法下尚未完全实现，但基于区块链的解决方案已经为增强公司治理的透明度、安全性和效率提供了具体机会。法律限制和技术限制共同影响了CorpTech解决方案的采用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"CorpTech"概念框架，为技术应用于公司治理提供了理论分析工具；发展了法律与技术兼容性的分析框架；为公司法与技术创新的交叉研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了股权代币化、远程股东会议和DLT身份验证等具体应用场景；指出了法律约束和技术限制对CorpTech实施的影响；为政策制定者和企业提供了实施区块链公司治理解决方案的指导。

title: The Nature and Scope of Econometrics: Measurement, Interpretation, and Endogenous Causality
affiliations: Nguyen Tat Thanh University

detail.title: The Nature and Scope of Econometrics: Measurement, Interpretation, and Endogenous Causality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This chapter introduces the nature, methodology, scope, and limitations of econometrics. Econometrics is presented as a discipline concerned with the quantitative measurement of economic relationships, combining economic theory, mathematical formulation, and statistical inference. Emphasis is placed on the interpretation of econometric models as tools for measuring marginal relationships rather than complete descriptions of economic systems. The chapter explains why econometrics is used for estimation, hypothesis testing, and forecasting, while highlighting fundamental limitations arising from economic-state constraints, data structure, measurement error, and probabilistic assumptions. Particular attention is given to the distinction between statistical significance and economic magnitude, the dependence of interpretation on cross-sectional and time-series variation, and the potential inconsistency between econometric forecasts and accounting identities. The chapter also introduces the concept of endogenous causality, arguing that causal necessity in economic systems arises from structural constraints and adjustment mechanisms rather than directly from regression coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本章介绍了计量经济学的本质、方法论、范围和局限性。计量经济学被定义为结合经济理论、数学公式和统计推断来定量测量经济关系的学科。重点强调计量模型是测量边际关系的工具，而非经济系统的完整描述。讨论了计量经济学在估计、假设检验和预测中的应用，同时指出了经济状态约束、数据结构、测量误差和概率假设带来的基本局限性。
AI.research_question: 计量经济学作为一门学科的本质是什么？它如何结合经济理论、数学和统计方法来测量经济关系？计量经济学在应用中有哪些基本局限性和挑战？
AI.motivation: 需要明确计量经济学作为经济分析工具的性质、方法论基础和实际应用范围，帮助研究者理解计量模型的适当使用方式和解释限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计量经济学理论框架：结合经济理论（理论模型）、数学公式（函数形式）和统计推断（估计和检验）。强调边际关系测量而非系统完整描述。引入内生因果关系概念，认为经济系统中的因果必要性源于结构约束和调整机制。
AI.method: 方法论讨论：介绍计量经济学的基本方法论，包括估计方法、假设检验和预测技术。强调横截面和时间序列变异的区别，统计显著性与经济规模的区分，以及计量预测与会计恒等式的一致性考虑。
AI.findings: 计量经济学是测量经济关系的定量工具，但存在重要限制：1）经济状态约束；2）数据结构问题；3）测量误差；4）概率假设限制。回归系数不能直接等同于因果关系，因果必要性源于经济系统的结构约束和调整机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）明确计量经济学作为边际关系测量工具的本质；2）区分统计显著性与经济重要性；3）提出内生因果关系概念，强调结构约束而非回归系数决定因果关系；4）阐明计量预测与会计恒等式的潜在不一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为研究者提供计量方法应用的指导框架；2）强调模型解释的谨慎性；3）指出实际应用中需要注意的数据和测量问题；4）帮助避免常见的计量误用和误解。

title: Digital Services Tax (DST) Effectiveness in Emerging Economies

detail.title: Digital Services Tax (DST) Effectiveness in Emerging Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare the sole authorship of the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare the sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract:
The rapid expansion of the digital economy has intensified long-standing challenges to international taxation, particularly in emerging economies where traditional tax bases are increasingly eroded by highly mobile, intangible-driven business models. Digital firms often generate substantial economic value within jurisdictions without a corresponding physical presence, limiting the effectiveness of conventional corporate income tax rules. This study examines the emergence and application of Digital Services Taxes (DSTs) as interim policy responses to these challenges. Using a qualitative synthesis of existing academic and policy literature, combined with a comparative analysis of DST frameworks across selected jurisdictions and a review of institutional effectiveness, the study evaluates both the fiscal and administrative implications of DST adoption. 
The findings indicate that DSTs can enhance short-term revenue visibility and signal fiscal sovereignty, especially where digital activity is otherwise undertaxed (OECD; Beer, de Mooij, and Liu). However, significant challenges persist, including enforcement difficulties, risks of tax incidence being shifted to consumers, and equity concerns affecting domestic firms (Collier et al.; Devereux et al.). The analysis further demonstrates that administrative capacity, legal clarity, and international coordination strongly influence DST outcomes (OECD Inclusive Framework). The study concludes that DSTs function primarily as transitional instruments rather than sustainable long-term solutions, reinforcing the need for multilateral reforms to the digital taxation architecture (OECD).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数字服务税作为应对数字经济税收挑战的临时政策工具，分析了其财政和行政影响，指出数字服务税主要是过渡性措施而非长期解决方案。
AI.research_question: 数字服务税作为应对数字经济税收挑战的临时政策回应，其出现、应用及财政和行政影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字经济的快速扩张加剧了国际税收的长期挑战，特别是在新兴经济体，传统税基受到高度流动、无形资产驱动的商业模式的侵蚀。数字企业通常在无实体存在的情况下在管辖区内创造大量经济价值，限制了传统企业所得税规则的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际税收理论、数字经济税收政策框架、OECD包容性框架等理论，分析数字服务税作为临时政策工具的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用定性综合方法，结合现有学术和政策文献的综合分析、跨选定司法管辖区的数字服务税框架比较分析，以及制度有效性评估。
AI.findings: 数字服务税可以增强短期收入可见性并体现财政主权，特别是在数字活动征税不足的情况下。但存在执法困难、税负转嫁给消费者的风险、影响国内企业的公平问题等挑战。行政能力、法律明确性和国际协调对数字服务税结果有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字经济税收政策提供了理论框架，分析了数字服务税作为过渡性工具的理论定位，强调了多边改革的理论必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了数字服务税实施的实践指导，指出了行政能力建设、法律明确性和国际协调的重要性，为数字税收架构改革提供了政策建议。

title: The Great Loop -Assessing Systemic Financial Fragility in the AI-Centric Economy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Great Loop -Assessing Systemic Financial Fragility in the AI-Centric Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Disclaimer: The views and opinions expressed herein are solely my own. They do not represent, reflect, or imply endorsement by any organization, institution, or employer with which I am currently or have previously been affiliated. The data has been verified to be correct at the time of writing it.

keywords: Network Contagion Risks AI Bubble -Is it real?

detail.abstract: AI is transforming the real economy, yet the financial system built around it is increasingly fragile. This paper maps the “Great Loop”, which is a reflexive cycle in which hyperscalers, chipmakers, and AI labs reinforce each other’s valuations through equity stakes, cloud contracts, and GPU commitments. I benchmark this structure against six historical bubble indicators, and analyse current market conditions, including elevated P/E ratios and index concentration data as of Dec'25. Using a network contagion model, I review how shocks could propagate across this ecosystem, and how the concentrated exposures and circular capital flows can magnify losses tcreating systemic vulnerabilities.  While AI matches five of six bubble parameters, the strong underlying technological fundamentals and real assets of the companies provide partial insulation. The paper offers a framework for understanding these dynamics and outlines buffers, risks, and investment considerations for the next phase of AI‑driven growth.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了AI产业中的"大循环"现象——超大规模云服务商、芯片制造商和AI实验室通过股权、云合同和GPU承诺相互强化估值，形成了一个反射性循环。作者用六个历史泡沫指标评估这一结构，发现AI符合其中五个，但强大的技术基础和实物资产提供了部分缓冲。通过网络传染模型分析了冲击如何在该生态系统中传播，以及集中暴露和循环资本流动如何放大损失，最后提出了理解这些动态的框架和投资建议。
AI.research_question: AI产业中的"大循环"结构如何影响金融系统的稳定性？这种结构是否符合历史泡沫特征？冲击如何在该生态系统中传播并放大系统性风险？
AI.motivation: AI正在变革实体经济，但围绕其建立的金融系统却日益脆弱。超大规模云服务商、芯片制造商和AI实验室之间通过股权、云合同和GPU承诺形成了相互强化的估值循环，这种"大循环"结构可能隐藏着系统性风险，需要深入分析其泡沫特征和传染机制。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 反射性理论：市场参与者的认知与现实相互影响形成循环强化机制
2. 泡沫理论：基于六个历史泡沫指标评估AI产业的结构特征
3. 网络传染理论：分析冲击在相互关联的生态系统中的传播路径
4. 系统性风险理论：集中暴露和循环资本流动如何放大损失
AI.method:
1. 历史比较分析：用六个历史泡沫指标评估AI产业
2. 市场数据分析：分析截至2025年12月的高市盈率和指数集中度数据
3. 网络传染模型：模拟冲击在超大规模云服务商、芯片制造商和AI实验室生态系统中的传播路径
4. 案例研究：分析股权、云合同和GPU承诺等具体关联机制
AI.findings:
1. AI产业符合六个历史泡沫指标中的五个，显示出明显的泡沫特征
2. 强大的技术基础和实物资产为这些公司提供了部分风险缓冲
3. 集中暴露和循环资本流动会放大冲击损失，增加系统性脆弱性
4. 网络传染模型显示冲击可以在该生态系统中快速传播
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"大循环"概念框架，描述AI产业中相互强化的估值循环机制
2. 将反射性理论应用于AI金融生态系统分析
3. 发展了评估新兴技术产业泡沫特征的分析框架
4. 扩展了网络传染理论在产业生态系统中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供了评估AI产业风险和机会的分析框架
2. 为监管机构识别系统性风险提供了工具和方法
3. 为企业管理者理解产业动态和制定战略提供了参考
4. 为政策制定者设计缓冲机制和风险管理措施提供了依据

title: Integrating AI and Environmental Impact Modeling for Sustainable Industrial Operations

detail.title: Integrating AI and Environmental Impact Modeling for Sustainable Industrial Operations
detail.abstract:
This study integrates artificial intelligence techniques with established environmental impact modeling frameworks to enhance sustainability assessment and decision-making in complex industrial operations (Wu et al. 2022; Suboyin et al. 2023). A mixed-methods modeling approach was adopted, combining machine learning algorithms, digital twin simulations, and geospatial analytics to evaluate environmental risks across Industry 4.0 environments (Bhambri et al. 2024; Nosirov et al. 2024). The framework operationalized AI-driven predictive analytics to forecast emissions, resource consumption, and system failures under varying operational and regulatory scenarios (Wu et al. 2022; Nosirov et al. 2024). Findings demonstrate that digital twins significantly improve real-time environmental impact visualization, enabling proactive mitigation of ecological and operational risks (Bhambri et al. 2024; Suboyin et al. 2023). GIS-enabled monitoring further enhanced spatial risk detection, compliance tracking, and ecosystem sensitivity analysis in high-risk industrial zones (Wu et al. 2022; AI-environmental risk modeling studies). 
Machine vision applications improved environmental surveillance accuracy by automating anomaly detection in waste management, emissions monitoring, and safety systems (Nosirov et al. 2024; Suboyin et al. 2023). Overall results indicate measurable gains in resource efficiency, regulatory compliance, and adaptive risk management through AI-enhanced modeling (Bhambri et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2022). The study concludes that integrating AI with environmental impact modeling offers a scalable, data-driven pathway for sustainable industrial performance (Suboyin et al. 2023; Nosirov et al. 2024).

AI.tldr: 该研究将人工智能技术与环境影响建模框架相结合，通过机器学习、数字孪生和地理空间分析等方法，提升复杂工业运营的可持续性评估和决策能力，实现排放预测、风险监测和资源优化。
AI.research_question: 如何将人工智能技术整合到环境影响建模框架中，以增强复杂工业运营的可持续性评估和决策能力？
AI.motivation: 工业4.0环境下复杂工业运营面临环境风险管理的挑战，需要更高效、精准的可持续性评估和决策支持工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能与环境影响建模的整合框架，包括机器学习算法、数字孪生模拟和地理空间分析等理论。
AI.method: 采用混合方法建模，结合机器学习算法、数字孪生模拟和地理空间分析，评估工业4.0环境下的环境风险。
AI.findings: 数字孪生显著改善实时环境影响可视化，地理信息系统增强空间风险检测，机器视觉提高环境监测准确性，整体提升资源效率、合规性和适应性风险管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI与环境影响建模整合的理论框架，为可持续工业绩效提供了可扩展的数据驱动路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业运营提供了实用的AI增强建模工具，支持排放预测、资源消耗监测、系统故障预警和环境风险主动缓解。

title: Economic Consequences of a US-Initiated Tariff War
affiliations: The University of Western Australia

detail.title: Economic Consequences of a US-Initiated Tariff War

declarations.declarationOfInterest: UNCTAD provided some of the data for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: Unfunded.

detail.abstract: Prior to the 2024 US election, President-Elect Trump proposed a ten per cent tariff on all imports and a 60 per cent tariff on imports from China. After the election, he also proposed a 25 per cent tariff on trading partners Canada and Mexico. Assuming Trump has a chance of implementing these policies, we quantify the potential trade and national income impacts on the United States, China and other countries using a global computable general equilibrium model. Our results suggest that while the trade impacts from imposing these tariffs are large, the United States would experience a real GDP loss of only 0.6 per cent. Countries other than China, Canada and Mexico would gain from the trade diversion away from imports from these countries. This includes Australia, which experiences a loss in exports to China but gains in exports to the United States, India and other countries. If all countries were to respond with equivalent retaliatory tariffs, everyone would be worse off, with little additional harm to the United States, where GDP losses rise to 0.8 per cent. Therefore, the threat of retaliation is less credible.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用全球可计算一般均衡模型量化特朗普提出的关税政策对美国、中国及其他国家的潜在贸易和国民收入影响。结果显示，尽管贸易影响显著，但美国实际GDP仅损失0.6%。非目标国家（如澳大利亚）可从贸易转移中获益。若各国采取对等报复性关税，所有国家都会受损，但美国GDP损失仅增至0.8%，降低了报复威胁的可信度。
AI.research_question: 特朗普提出的关税政策（对所有进口征收10%关税，对中国进口征收60%关税，对加拿大和墨西哥征收25%关税）对美国、中国及其他国家的贸易和国民收入会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 2024年美国大选前，特朗普提出了激进的关税政策，这些政策如果实施可能对全球贸易格局产生重大影响。需要量化评估这些政策的潜在经济后果，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型框架，该模型能够捕捉国际贸易、生产、消费和投资之间的复杂相互依存关系，分析关税变化对各国经济的影响。
AI.method: 使用全球可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型进行量化分析，模拟特朗普提出的关税政策情景，包括单边实施和各国采取报复性关税的情景。
AI.findings: 1. 美国实施关税政策后，实际GDP仅损失0.6%；2. 中国、加拿大、墨西哥等目标国家受损；3. 其他国家（如澳大利亚、印度）可从贸易转移中获益；4. 若各国采取对等报复，所有国家都会受损，但美国GDP损失仅增至0.8%，报复威胁的可信度较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为分析激进关税政策的全球影响提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了贸易转移效应在关税政策评估中的重要性；3. 挑战了报复性关税作为有效威慑工具的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了特朗普关税政策潜在影响的量化评估；2. 揭示了非目标国家可能从贸易转移中获益的机制；3. 表明报复性关税的威胁可能不如预期有效，为贸易谈判策略提供参考。

reference: Review of Development Finance, volume 3, issue 4, 2013[10.1016/j.rdf.2013.09.001]
title: The Impact of Technological Improvements on Developing Financial Markets: The Case of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange
affiliations: Loyola University New Orleans - Joseph A. Butt, S.J. College of Business and

detail.title: The Impact of Technological Improvements on Developing Financial Markets: The Case of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange

publicationDetails.detailsText: Review of Development Finance, volume 3, issue 4, 2013[10.1016/j.rdf.2013.09.001]

detail.abstract: Can a significant technological improvement make an economically justifiable contribution to a financial market's development? The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) incorporated the SETS system from the London Stock Exchange in 2002. It is certain that SETS is a technologically efficient trading system, and it would undoubtedly improve trading in the JSE. We test whether SETS represents a structural break by examining whether there was an increase in the JSE's liquidity, market efficiency and international integration after the introduction of SETS. While SETS is certainly a technological improvement with increased liquidity, it is not a sufficient factor to render it efficient. After the incorporation of SETS, the JSE has become more independent and it now offers better diversification opportunities for international investors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）引入伦敦证券交易所SETS交易系统后，是否显著提升了市场流动性、效率和国际化程度。研究发现SETS虽提高了流动性，但不足以使市场完全有效，反而使JSE更加独立，为国际投资者提供了更好的多元化机会。
AI.research_question: 重大技术改进能否对金融市场发展做出经济上合理的贡献？具体而言，约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）引入伦敦证券交易所的SETS交易系统后，是否显著提升了市场流动性、市场效率和国际化程度？
AI.motivation: 研究技术改进对新兴市场发展的实际影响，特别是SETS系统作为公认的高效交易技术，在JSE这样的新兴市场中是否能够产生预期的积极效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论、市场效率假说和国际市场整合理论，探讨技术改进对市场质量指标（流动性、效率、国际化）的影响。
AI.method: 采用结构断点检验方法，分析SETS引入前后JSE的市场数据，比较流动性指标、市场效率指标和国际整合程度的变化。
AI.findings: 1. SETS确实提高了JSE的市场流动性；2. 但仅凭技术改进不足以使市场完全有效；3. SETS引入后，JSE变得更加独立；4. 为国际投资者提供了更好的多元化投资机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了"技术改进必然提升市场效率"的简单假设；2. 揭示了技术改进可能带来市场独立性的意外后果；3. 为新兴市场技术采纳研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新兴市场交易所的技术升级决策提供参考；2. 帮助国际投资者理解JSE市场结构变化后的投资机会；3. 为监管机构评估技术改革效果提供依据。

title: Access to Finance and Air Quality
affiliations: Belk College of Business, UNC Charlotte, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Center for Internet Economy Research and Renmin University of China - School of Business

detail.title: Access to Finance and Air Quality
detail.abstract: This paper examines how banking deregulation affects environmental quality. Using the staggered relaxation of interstate branching restrictions under the Interstate Banking and Branching Efficiency Act, we find that deregulation improves county-level air quality: median and upper-tail AQI decline, the share of good-air-quality days rises, and the number of unhealthy-air-quality days falls. To investigate mechanisms, we link deregulation to plant-level emissions in the EPA Toxic Release Inventory and show that toxic releases-especially air releases-decline after deregulation, with effects concentrated among private firms. Using Consumer Expenditure Survey data, we find limited changes in household energy use, suggesting the air-quality gains operate primarily through firms' production and abatement decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行放松管制如何影响环境质量。利用《州际银行与分支机构效率法案》下州际分支机构限制的渐进式放松，发现放松管制改善了县级空气质量：中位数和上尾AQI下降，良好空气质量天数比例上升，不健康空气质量天数减少。机制分析表明，放松管制降低了企业层面的有毒物质排放（尤其是空气排放），且效应集中在私营企业。家庭能源使用变化有限，表明空气质量改善主要通过企业的生产和减排决策实现。
AI.research_question: 银行放松管制如何影响环境质量？
AI.motivation: 理解金融监管改革对环境结果的影响，特别是银行放松管制是否以及如何通过影响企业行为来改善环境质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融发展与环境质量的关系理论，银行竞争对企业融资约束和投资决策的影响，企业环境行为的经济学分析。
AI.method: 使用《州际银行与分支机构效率法案》下的州际分支机构限制渐进式放松作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法分析县级空气质量数据（AQI）、EPA有毒物质排放清单的工厂级排放数据，以及消费者支出调查的家庭能源使用数据。
AI.findings: 银行放松管制显著改善了县级空气质量：中位数和上尾AQI下降，良好空气质量天数比例上升，不健康空气质量天数减少。有毒物质排放（尤其是空气排放）在放松管制后下降，效应集中在私营企业。家庭能源使用变化有限，表明空气质量改善主要通过企业的生产和减排决策实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了银行放松管制与环境质量之间的因果关系；2) 揭示了金融监管通过影响企业环境行为改善环境质量的机制；3) 区分了企业和家庭在环境改善中的相对作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了金融监管改革的环境效益证据；2) 表明银行放松管制可以作为改善环境质量的补充政策工具；3) 为企业环境管理提供了金融视角的启示。

title: The Limits of Tariff Coercion: When Does Economic Leverage Work?
affiliations: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos

detail.title: The Limits of Tariff Coercion: When Does Economic Leverage Work?
detail.abstract: When does economic leverage translate into political concessions? Conventional wisdom holds that greater trade dependence yields greater compliance. Using 379 sanction episodes matched with bilateral trade data, I document two patterns that challenge this view. First, trade asymmetry-a measure of relative bilateral dependence-has no effect on whether targets make any concession. Second, conditional on conceding, asymmetry reduces the probability of full compliance: targets facing overwhelming pressure offer strategic partial concessions. To explain these patterns, I develop a dynamic model where a hegemon extracts concessions from trade-dependent targets but faces domestic costs from its own import reliance. The model yields a threshold result: coercion succeeds only when bilateral asymmetry exceeds approximately 0.50. This threshold correctly partitions observed successes-Colombia's rapid capitulation, Mexico's negotiations over fentanyl-from failures against China and the EU. The model also explains Denmark's resistance despite extreme asymmetry: territorial demands carry prohibitive political costs. Domestic political constraints generate "announce-and-retreat" dynamics matching recent tariff episodes.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，通过379个制裁事件分析发现：贸易不对称性并不影响目标国是否让步，但一旦让步，不对称性反而降低完全服从概率。作者建立动态模型，揭示只有当双边不对称性超过0.50阈值时，强制才能成功。
AI.research_question: 经济杠杆何时能转化为政治让步？贸易不对称性如何影响制裁效果？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为贸易依赖度越高，服从度越高，但现实案例（如对中国、欧盟制裁失败）与此不符，需要重新审视经济杠杆与政治让步的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈理论，霸权国从贸易依赖目标国获取让步，但面临自身进口依赖的国内成本；阈值理论（不对称性需超过0.50）。
AI.method: 实证分析：379个制裁事件匹配双边贸易数据；理论建模：动态模型分析不对称性阈值效应。
AI.findings: 1. 贸易不对称性不影响目标国是否让步；2. 一旦让步，不对称性降低完全服从概率；3. 强制成功需双边不对称性超过0.50阈值；4. 国内政治约束导致"宣布-撤退"动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统贸易依赖-服从关系，提出不对称性阈值理论，解释为何极端不对称下仍可能失败（如丹麦案例），整合国内政治约束因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更精准的制裁策略：关注不对称性阈值，理解目标国的战略部分让步行为，预测"宣布-撤退"动态模式。

title: The Age of Local Non-Reform
affiliations: Michigan State University - College of Law

detail.title: The Age of Local Non-Reform
detail.abstract:
In an era of aggressive state actors and often testy relationships between state and local officials, it comes as little surprise when legislatures make targeted incursions into the governance of cities and counties.   Yet a spate of recent laws—arising in Tennessee, Texas, Missouri, and beyond—do not merely disable local regulatory power and squeeze small-scale nodes of democracy.  Rather, these laws act to upend the basic configuration of local institutions: they amend how functions are distributed across the horizontal landscape of local government, both externally (between cities, counties, and authorities) and internally (between mayors, boards, and councils).  In doing so, the laws violate a deeply-held principle of local structural autonomy that arises out of, and would appear to reinforce, a steady withdrawal of state legislatures from matters of local structure over the past thirty-plus years. 

This article confronts the myth and reality of state retreat from local structural reform.  It argues that the modern state approach to local structure—characterized at baseline by a system of non-reform, where states tinker with local structures while also adhering to a baseline principle of passive structural deference—leaves local governments increasingly isolated and voiceless in the federal system.  Non-reform is a vertical governance system defined by negative spaces: those spaces where conversations about local structure do not occur, where structural inertia is assumed rather than questioned, and where path dependency favors yesterday’s structural choices over the value and risks of experimental reform.  Non-reform preserves a precarious veneer of autonomy.  Through its neutral clothing, states can erode local power while preserving a commitment to localism. 

To survive these threats, local governments can draw lessons from an unlikely source: from their international peers, who operate without the same norm of autonomy but have thrived in environments of structural agitation to advocate for local interests in recent years.  Indeed, a curious trend has emerged in countries that experiment with local structural change, as formerly weak municipalities accrue new powers and assert newfound national voice.   On the other side of the coin, equally curious is the continued erosion of local power in the United States, notwithstanding the imagined structural autonomy held by local institutions. 

The article resolves this contradiction by diagnosing the unsung localist values of systemic structural change.  It discovers that a system where upper-tier governments tinker with local structure can promote durable local voice and enhanced local powers.  Drawing on these findings, the article offers guiding principles for local stakeholders operating in a non-reform environment.  It also offers a warning about the false complacency of local autonomy, a thin shield against which structural conversations give way to an increasingly politicized discourse, and where local values can be easily lost and subsumed by top-down policy goals.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"州政府从地方结构改革中撤退"的迷思，揭示了现代州政府对地方结构的"非改革"系统实际上侵蚀了地方权力，同时维持地方自治的表象。文章通过比较国际经验，提出系统性结构改革反而能促进地方声音和权力。
AI.research_question: 州政府从地方结构改革中撤退的迷思与现实是什么？现代州政府对地方结构的"非改革"系统如何影响地方政府的权力和声音？
AI.motivation: 近年来田纳西州、德克萨斯州、密苏里州等地的法律不仅限制地方监管权力，还颠覆地方机构的基本配置，违反了地方结构自治的深层原则。这挑战了过去三十多年来州立法机构从地方结构事务中撤退的普遍认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 地方结构自治原则；2. 非改革系统理论（以被动结构遵从为基准原则）；3. 路径依赖理论；4. 垂直治理系统中的负空间概念；5. 国际比较视角下的地方权力演变
AI.method: 理论分析、比较研究（美国与国际经验对比）、案例分析（田纳西州、德克萨斯州、密苏里州等地的法律变化）、制度分析
AI.findings: 1. 州政府并未真正从地方结构改革中撤退，而是通过"非改革"系统侵蚀地方权力；2. "非改革"系统通过负空间运作，避免结构改革对话，维持结构惯性；3. 国际经验显示，系统性结构改革反而能促进地方声音和权力；4. 美国地方权力持续侵蚀，尽管存在想象中的结构自治
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"非改革"系统理论，解释现代州政府对地方结构的治理方式；2. 挑战地方结构自治的传统迷思；3. 揭示系统性结构改革对地方主义的潜在价值；4. 建立垂直治理中负空间的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为地方利益相关者在非改革环境中运作提供指导原则；2. 警告地方自治的虚假自满；3. 提出从国际经验中学习的建议；4. 帮助地方政府在结构对话政治化背景下保护地方价值

title: Spatial Sorting and Conflict Migration in Peru: Evidence from Peru's Internal War
affiliations: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos

detail.title: Spatial Sorting and Conflict Migration in Peru: Evidence from Peru's Internal War
detail.abstract: Do conflict migrants succeed because of who they are or where they go? Using household survey data from Peru (2004-2024) linked to geocoded conflict fatality records, I decompose migrant outcomes into selection and spatial sorting components. Three findings emerge. First, spatial sorting explains 100% of conflict migrants' economic advantages: the 4.5% income premium disappears entirely with destination fixed effects. Forced displacement pushed individuals toward Lima and major urban centers with stronger labor markets. Second, a dual selection dynamic operates: wealth determines who stays during violence, while education determines who succeeds among migrants. Third, conflict's demographic impact intensifies over time-cohorts born after violence ended show effects eleven times larger than those who experienced it directly, indicating persistent regional decline rather than immediate displacement. Indigenous populations were disproportionately displaced (56% of conflict migrants vs. 30% of other migrants).

AI.tldr: 该研究使用秘鲁2004-2024年家庭调查数据与地理编码的冲突死亡记录，分解了冲突移民的经济成果，发现其优势完全源于空间分选（选择迁往利马等经济发达地区），而非个人特质。研究揭示了双重选择机制：财富决定谁在暴力中留下，教育决定移民中谁成功。冲突的人口影响随时间加剧，后冲突世代受影响程度是直接经历者的11倍，表明区域衰退持续存在。
AI.research_question: 冲突移民的经济成功是由于他们自身的特质（选择效应）还是由于他们迁移的目的地（空间分选效应）？
AI.motivation: 理解冲突移民经济成果的驱动因素，区分个人特质与目的地选择的影响，为冲突后人口流动政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民经济学理论，包括选择效应（基于个人特征的选择性迁移）和空间分选效应（目的地特征对移民成果的影响）。
AI.method: 使用秘鲁2004-2024年家庭调查数据，与地理编码的冲突死亡记录链接，通过固定效应模型分解移民成果的选择和空间分选成分。
AI.findings: 1. 空间分选解释100%冲突移民的经济优势：4.5%的收入溢价在加入目的地固定效应后完全消失；2. 双重选择机制：财富决定谁在暴力中留下，教育决定移民中谁成功；3. 冲突的人口影响随时间加剧：后冲突世代受影响程度是直接经历者的11倍；4. 土著人口被不成比例地流离失所（冲突移民中56% vs 其他移民30%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确区分了冲突移民经济成果的选择效应和空间分选效应；2. 提出了冲突移民的双重选择理论框架；3. 揭示了冲突影响的代际传递和区域衰退的持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冲突后地区发展政策提供依据，强调区域经济振兴的重要性；2. 为移民支持政策提供指导，关注教育在移民成功中的作用；3. 揭示土著人口在冲突中的脆弱性，为保护政策提供证据。

title: Terrorism and Regional Development: Evidence from Peru's Internal War
affiliations: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos

detail.title: Terrorism and Regional Development: Evidence from Peru's Internal War
detail.abstract: How do regions recover from civil conflict? I study Peru's internal armed conflict (1980-2000), which claimed 69,000 lives, using district-level census data spanning 36 years with a pre-conflict baseline. I document three findings. First, conflict districts experienced demographic transformation rather than restoration: populations are 2-3 years younger with 25-35% fewer elderly, reflecting permanent cohort displacement rather than return migration. Second, human capital converged substantially-the literacy gap narrowed by 66%. Third, economic activity shows extensive-margin catch-up, with conflict districts now more likely to have detectable night-time luminosity. I find significant heterogeneity: Sendero Luminoso areas experienced complete demographic restructuring with weak educational recovery, while state-violence areas preserved demographics with strong human capital gains-reflecting Sendero's systematic destruction of local institutions versus reactive counterinsurgency. These findings suggest post-conflict recovery is achievable, but demographic transformation represents a permanent imprint that aggregate statistics obscure.

AI.tldr: 研究秘鲁内战（1980-2000）后地区恢复情况，发现冲突地区经历了人口结构转型而非恢复，人力资本差距显著缩小，经济活动有所追赶，但不同冲突类型地区恢复模式存在异质性。
AI.research_question: 地区如何从内战中恢复？秘鲁内部武装冲突（1980-2000）后，冲突地区的恢复模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解内战后的恢复过程对政策制定至关重要，但现有研究缺乏长期追踪数据。秘鲁冲突造成69000人死亡，提供了一个研究冲突长期影响的典型案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突后恢复理论、人口转型理论、人力资本理论、制度破坏理论，以及不同类型冲突（革命性叛乱vs国家暴力）对恢复路径的影响。
AI.method: 使用秘鲁地区级人口普查数据，涵盖36年时间跨度，包含冲突前基线数据。采用比较分析方法，对比冲突地区与非冲突地区的长期变化。
AI.findings: 1. 冲突地区经历了人口结构转型而非恢复：人口年轻2-3岁，老年人减少25-35%，反映永久性人口置换而非回归迁移。2. 人力资本显著趋同：识字率差距缩小66%。3. 经济活动在广度上追赶：冲突地区现在更可能有可检测的夜间灯光。4. 显著异质性：光辉道路地区经历完全人口重组但教育恢复弱；国家暴力地区保持人口结构但人力资本增长强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了冲突后"恢复"的传统概念，提出"人口转型"框架。2. 揭示了不同类型冲突（制度破坏型vs反应型）对恢复路径的系统性差异。3. 表明人口转型是冲突的永久印记，被总体统计数据掩盖。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冲突后政策制定提供实证依据：需要针对不同类型冲突地区制定差异化恢复策略。2. 强调关注人口结构变化的长期影响。3. 提供评估冲突后恢复的新指标和方法。

detail.title: Unravelling the Roots of Instability: A Critical Study of Military Coups in Sahel Region Since 2020

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Find the paper published at Institute for Strategic Studies Research and Analysis Website
https://issra.pk/pub/insight/2024/Unravelling-the-Roots-of-Instability/Insight.html

detail.abstract: This INSIGHT explores the military coups in the Sahel region, focusing on internal factors like poor governance, insecurity, and terrorism that triggered these events, as well as the role of external powers such as France, the US, Russia, and China. It highlights the involvement of former colonial powers and other international actors in shaping the political landscape, leading to a shift in alliances from Western to Eastern blocs. The insight concludes by examining the region's unstable future due to external interventions and socio-economic pressures.

AI.tldr: 该INSIGHT探讨了萨赫勒地区的军事政变，分析了内部因素（如治理不善、不安全、恐怖主义）和外部大国（法国、美国、俄罗斯、中国）的作用，指出殖民历史和外部干预导致该地区联盟从西方转向东方集团，并展望了该地区因外部干预和社会经济压力而面临的不稳定未来。
AI.research_question: 萨赫勒地区军事政变的驱动因素是什么？内部治理问题与外部大国干预如何相互作用并导致该地区政治联盟的重组？
AI.motivation: 萨赫勒地区近年来频繁发生军事政变，这些事件不仅影响地区稳定，还涉及大国竞争和地缘政治格局变化，需要深入分析内外因素的相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合内部治理理论（治理失败、安全困境）和地缘政治理论（大国竞争、新殖民主义、联盟转移理论），分析萨赫勒地区政变的多层次驱动因素。
AI.method: 采用案例研究法和比较分析法，对萨赫勒地区多个国家的军事政变进行深入分析，结合历史文献、政策文件和专家访谈，探讨内外因素的相互作用。
AI.findings: 1. 内部因素（治理不善、安全威胁、恐怖主义）是政变的直接触发因素；2. 外部大国（特别是前殖民国家法国）的干预加剧了地区不稳定；3. 大国竞争导致萨赫勒地区联盟从西方转向俄罗斯、中国等东方集团；4. 外部干预与社会经济压力共同塑造了该地区的不稳定未来。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了萨赫勒地区政变的多层次分析框架，整合内部治理与外部干预因素；2. 发展了后殖民地区地缘政治竞争的理论视角；3. 丰富了联盟转移理论在非洲地区的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供理解萨赫勒地区不稳定的综合分析框架；2. 揭示大国干预对地区稳定的负面影响；3. 为国际组织和地区国家提供治理和安全合作的政策建议；4. 预警该地区未来可能的地缘政治变化和安全风险。

title: Analysis of Political Advertising from the Perspective of Cultural Studies with an Emphasis on Stuart Hall’s Thought

detail.title: Analysis of Political Advertising from the Perspective of Cultural Studies with an Emphasis on Stuart Hall’s Thought

publicationDetails.detailsText: Mesbah, A. B. (2019). Analysis of political advertising from the perspective of cultural studies with an emphasis on Stuart Hall’s thought. Baghlan University Academic Research Journal

detail.abstract: The present text discusses the concept of political propaganda and subsequently examines the position and objectives of the cultural studies school, particularly focusing on Stuart Hall as one of the most significant and prominent figures of this school. This article, through the analysis of political propaganda in light of reception and representation theories, concludes that although Stuart Hall emphasizes the role of audiences in reception theory and downplays the impact of media and its content on audience decision-making, this perspective is moderated in his representation theory. As a result, Hall regards the role of media in influencing the audience’s psyche through content dissemination as distinguished within a system of representation. The present article finds that, according to Stuart Hall’s representation theory, political propaganda still exerts profound influence on audiences, considering the prevailing system in the world, and reproduces the dominant ideology within society.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析斯图亚特·霍尔的文化研究理论，探讨政治宣传在接收理论和表征理论框架下的作用，认为尽管霍尔在接收理论中强调受众能动性，但在表征理论中承认媒体通过内容传播对受众心理的影响，政治宣传仍能深刻影响受众并再生产社会主导意识形态。
AI.research_question: 斯图亚特·霍尔的文化研究理论（特别是接收理论和表征理论）如何解释政治宣传对受众的影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨政治宣传在当代社会中的作用机制，分析文化研究学派特别是斯图亚特·霍尔的理论如何解释媒体内容对受众的影响，理解政治宣传在意识形态再生产中的功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 斯图亚特·霍尔的接收理论（强调受众解码的能动性）和表征理论（强调媒体通过符号系统构建意义）；文化研究学派的理论框架；意识形态再生产理论。
AI.method: 理论分析：通过文献分析和对斯图亚特·霍尔接收理论与表征理论的比较研究，探讨政治宣传的作用机制。
AI.findings: 1. 霍尔的接收理论强调受众在解码过程中的能动性，弱化了媒体内容对受众决策的直接决定作用；2. 但在表征理论中，霍尔承认媒体通过内容传播在表征系统中对受众心理产生影响；3. 政治宣传在现有世界体系中仍能对受众产生深刻影响；4. 政治宣传在社会中再生产主导意识形态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合了霍尔的接收理论和表征理论，提供了更全面的政治宣传分析框架；2. 阐明了接收理论与表征理论在解释媒体影响时的互补关系；3. 发展了文化研究学派对政治宣传的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解当代政治宣传的作用机制提供了理论工具；2. 有助于媒体从业者和政策制定者更有效地设计和评估宣传策略；3. 为公众提供了批判性分析政治宣传的理论视角。

title: Usage of e-Devices in Banking Sector for Promoting Relationships between Bankers and Customers: A Case Study
affiliations: Asian University of Bangladesh, Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB) and Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET)

detail.title: Usage of e-Devices in Banking Sector for Promoting Relationships between Bankers and Customers: A Case Study
detail.abstract: The objective of this study is to find out the influence of the usage of electronic devices on the relationships between bankers and the customers. This study has been done mainly based on primary and secondary sources of data. Primary data has been collected from respondents through a structured questionnaire. To conduct this research, interviewing approach has been used on clients of Dutch-Bangla Bank Limited (DBBL) Bangladesh, particularly who avail the electronic banking services. The sources of secondary data were collected from different publications and annual reports of DBBL for the year of 2011 to 2017. Simple descriptive statistics were used and two hypotheses were developed and tested by using one sample t-test to evaluate the effectiveness of using electronic devices in improving bank-client relationship. The results show that the usage of e-devices in banking sector has positive impact an improving service quality and client commitment that eventually strengthen lifetime relationships between bank and its clients. Likewise, the findings of the study were as analogous with some other studies where researchers found similar and or different economic characteristics. Hence, it can be beneficial for the policy makers of DBBL as well as other stakeholders of bank.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨电子设备使用对银行与客户关系的影响，发现电子设备使用能提升服务质量、增强客户承诺，从而加强银行与客户的长期关系。
AI.research_question: 电子设备使用如何影响银行与客户之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 随着电子银行服务普及，需要了解电子设备使用对银行-客户关系的影响，为银行政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务质量理论、客户承诺理论、客户关系管理理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：通过结构化问卷收集主要数据（访谈荷兰-孟加拉银行客户），收集2011-2017年次要数据（出版物和年报），使用描述性统计和单样本t检验测试两个假设。
AI.findings: 电子设备在银行业的应用对提升服务质量和增强客户承诺有积极影响，最终加强了银行与客户的终身关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了电子设备使用在银行-客户关系中的作用机制，支持了服务质量与客户承诺理论在数字银行环境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DBBL及其他银行的政策制定者和利益相关者提供决策依据，帮助优化电子银行服务以改善客户关系。

title: Innovation Peer Effects and Institutional Cross-Ownership
affiliations: University of Texas at Arlington and Texas A&M University (TAMU) - San Antonio

detail.title: Innovation Peer Effects and Institutional Cross-Ownership
detail.abstract:
Purpose

We examine whether industry peers influence a firm's innovation output and whether institutional cross-ownership is an important mechanism behind the peer effect.

Design/methodology/approach

We address endogeneity using two complementary identification strategies: (1) peer firms’ lagged idiosyncratic equity returns as an instrument for peer innovation, and (2) staggered changes in state-level corporate income tax rates as a quasi-natural experiment. Innovation output is measured using patent counts. We estimate negative binomial models and implement a two-step control function approach. Heterogeneity analyses examine the moderating roles of institutional cross-ownership, information uncertainty, and industry competition.

Findings

We find evidence of positive peer effects on innovation output. Effects are stronger when peers share institutional blockholders, when uncertainty is higher, and in more competitive industries. Patent citation flows indicate greater knowledge transfer among cross-owned peers.

Originality

We are the first to show that institutional cross-ownership strengthens industry peer effects on innovation output by facilitating information spillovers, offering new evidence on how common owners shape real corporate outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨行业同行是否影响企业创新产出，以及机构交叉持股是否是同行效应的关键机制。研究发现存在积极的同行效应，且当同行共享机构大股东、不确定性较高、行业竞争更激烈时效应更强。
AI.research_question: 行业同行是否影响企业的创新产出？机构交叉持股是否是同行效应的关键机制？
AI.motivation: 理解企业创新决策如何受到同行影响，以及机构投资者在促进同行间信息溢出和创新模仿中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同行效应理论、机构交叉持股理论、信息溢出理论、知识转移理论
AI.method: 使用两种互补的识别策略解决内生性问题：(1) 同行企业滞后特质股票回报作为同行创新的工具变量；(2) 州级企业所得税税率变化作为准自然实验。使用专利数量衡量创新产出，估计负二项模型并实施两步控制函数方法。
AI.findings: 发现创新产出存在积极的同行效应。当同行共享机构大股东、不确定性较高、行业竞争更激烈时效应更强。专利引用流动表明交叉持股同行间有更多知识转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明机构交叉持股通过促进信息溢出加强了行业同行对创新产出的影响，为共同所有者如何塑造实际企业结果提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业理解同行创新影响、投资者识别创新机会、政策制定者设计促进创新的制度环境提供了实践启示。

title: Gender and Taxation in Nigeria: A Critical Analysis of Implicit Biases in Tax Policy and Tax Administration
affiliations: Ahmadu Bello University (ABU)

detail.title: Gender and Taxation in Nigeria: A Critical Analysis of Implicit Biases in Tax Policy and Tax Administration
detail.abstract: This research examines the hidden gender biases in Nigeria’s tax policies and its administration that have disproportionately disadvantaged women, particularly those in informal employment and caregiving roles. It succinctly and strategically reveals how the current tax systems inadequately address women’s unique economic circumstances, resulting in unequal tax burdens and reinforcing broader social inequalities. In this research, the author will highlight these biases' socio-economic and legal consequences and advocate for gender-responsive reforms that do not exclude mainstreaming gender in tax legislation, which is essential to support Nigeria’s goals for inclusive development and gender equality. On this premise, this research will contribute significantly to the discourse on gender and fiscal justice to promote gender equality within Nigeria's tax systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了尼日利亚税收政策及管理中存在的隐性性别偏见，这些偏见不成比例地损害了女性利益，特别是非正规就业和护理工作的女性。研究发现现行税收体系未能充分考虑女性的特殊经济状况，导致税收负担不平等并加剧了社会不平等。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚税收政策及管理中存在哪些隐性性别偏见？这些偏见如何不成比例地影响女性，特别是非正规就业和从事护理工作的女性？
AI.motivation: 现行税收体系未能充分考虑女性的特殊经济状况，导致税收负担不平等，加剧了社会不平等，阻碍了尼日利亚实现包容性发展和性别平等的目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别与财政正义理论、税收公平理论、性别主流化理论、包容性发展理论
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但可能包括政策分析、法律文本分析、实证研究（如访谈、调查）等方法来揭示税收政策中的性别偏见
AI.findings: 尼日利亚税收政策及管理中存在隐性性别偏见，这些偏见不成比例地损害了女性利益；现行税收体系未能充分考虑女性的特殊经济状况；这导致了不平等的税收负担并加剧了更广泛的社会不平等
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了性别与财政正义的理论讨论；为税收公平理论提供了性别视角的补充；推动了性别主流化在税收领域的理论应用
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了税收政策中的性别偏见及其社会经济和法律后果；倡导将性别主流化纳入税收立法的改革；为尼日利亚实现包容性发展和性别平等目标提供政策建议；促进尼日利亚税收体系中的性别平等

title: Practice Theory, Leadership-as-Practice, and Social Action

detail.title: Practice Theory, Leadership-as-Practice, and Social Action

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal for the Theory of Social Behavior, 2026, Vol. 56, No. 1, e70029

detail.abstract:
Although practice theory has significantly contributed to our understanding of the mechanisms underlying social change, it does not take a position or advocate for particular meso-macro changes, such as responsible management, because it is a theory wedded to ontological understanding. How people choose to 'get along' in life and manage their goods is all part of the practices, which fall under the theorist's microscope. On other hand, the applied field of leadership-as-practice is tied to change as its definitive property; in fact, leadership is defined by turning points occurring in the spaces between people, which, in turn, can lead to changes in the trajectory of the flow of practice. After narrowing the definition of social change in this paper as social action and-institutionally-as responsible management, the paper turns to a comparison between how practice theory contributes to our understanding of the evolution of social action and how leadership-as-practice, relying on the former's erstwhile elucidation, attempts to initiate and facilitate such action. The latter discussion of leadership-as-practice includes an accounting of the impetus for change initiation, its diffusion and prefigured processes, and the post-institutional applications afforded through its link with practice theory. The essay concludes by pointing out the principal contribution of the paper that social change need not rely on exclusive individual direction but on the collective capacity of the agents affiliated with the practice deriving the means to produce more just and sustainable lives. 

This is an open access article under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs License, which permits use and distribution in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited, the use is non-commercial and no modifications or adaptations are made.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文比较了实践理论与领导力即实践在理解社会变革机制方面的差异。实践理论关注社会行动的本体论理解，而领导力即实践则积极推动变革。论文将社会变革定义为负责任管理，并探讨两者如何共同促进更公正可持续的社会生活。
AI.research_question: 实践理论与领导力即实践如何分别贡献于我们对社会变革（特别是负责任管理）的理解与推动？
AI.motivation: 实践理论虽能解释社会变革机制，但不倡导具体变革；而领导力即实践以变革为核心属性。需要理清两者在社会变革（特别是负责任管理）中的互补作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实践理论（关注社会行动的本体论理解）和领导力即实践理论（关注人际互动中的转折点引发实践流轨迹变化）。
AI.method: 理论比较分析：通过概念辨析和理论对比，探讨两种理论对社会变革（定义为负责任管理）的不同贡献方式。
AI.findings: 实践理论解释社会行动的演变机制，领导力即实践则主动发起和促进变革。社会变革不依赖个体主导，而源于实践参与者的集体能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确区分实践理论与领导力即实践在社会变革中的不同角色；2. 提出社会变革源于实践参与者集体能力而非个体主导；3. 建立两种理论的互补关系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为负责任管理实践提供理论指导：强调通过集体实践而非个人英雄主义推动社会变革，促进更公正可持续的组织与社会发展。

title: Code Is Not Law
affiliations: Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law, Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law and New York University School of Law

detail.title: Code Is Not Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: SMU Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 721
publicationDetails.journalName: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In 2022, an image of a “bored ape” accessible through a non-fungible token (NFT) was stolen from actor Seth Green. The thief then sold the bored ape to a good faith purchaser. Had this been a physical painting, the outcome would have been clear: a thief cannot convey title they do not have, and the purchaser would acquire nothing. Yet the ensuing debate proceeded as though the NFT's technical features had altered this settled principle, as though blockchain records could bestow property rights on the new purchaser. They cannot. Ownership rights in digital assets stem from law, not from the software systems that create and maintain them.

When Lawrence Lessig famously proclaimed “code is law,” he meant that code functions as behavioral regulation by imposing technical limitations on users, not that it generates enforceable rights. His insight was descriptive: code shapes what people can do within digital environments, just as physical architecture channels movement through physical space. Yet the advent of blockchain networks, cryptocurrencies, and smart contracts has morphed this observation into the flawed conviction that what code makes possible, the law must recognize as legally enforceable.

While legal scholarship has noted this misconception, it has yet to offer a rigorous framework to resolve it. This Article fills this gap by applying H.L.A. Hart’s legal theory to demonstrate that code acquires legal force only to the extent that positive law grants such power. This investiture occurs through two pathways: public empowerment through legislation, and private empowerment through contracts, trusts, and other ordering instruments. Absent such formal investiture, code remains "soft law," a structural constraint lacking normative force. The relevance of our analysis extends beyond the conceptual malaise affecting the blockchain ecosystem, addressing a foundational conflict poised to reappear with every wave of new technology, from large language models to autonomous robots.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析NFT盗窃案例，批判了"代码即法律"的错误理解，运用哈特的法律理论论证代码只有通过正式法律授权才具有法律效力，否则只是缺乏规范力的"软法"。
AI.research_question: 代码（特别是区块链技术）是否能够创造法律上可执行的权利？代码在何种条件下才能获得法律效力？
AI.motivation: NFT盗窃案例引发的争议显示，人们错误地认为区块链技术特征可以改变既定的法律原则，这种误解需要从法律理论上澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: H.L.A. Hart的法律实证主义理论，区分"代码作为行为约束"与"代码作为法律权利来源"。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，通过案例分析和法律理论应用，论证代码获得法律效力的两种途径。
AI.findings: 代码本身不能创造法律权利；代码只有通过立法授权或私人协议（合同、信托等）才能获得法律效力；否则只是缺乏规范约束力的"软法"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了解决"代码即法律"误解的严谨理论框架，将哈特法律理论应用于数字资产领域，澄清了技术特征与法律权利的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NFT、加密货币等数字资产的法律争议提供分析框架，帮助法律从业者和技术开发者理解技术系统的法律边界，为未来新兴技术（如大语言模型、自主机器人）的法律问题提供分析工具。

title: Risk-Aware CI/CD Pipelines Using Machine Learning for Secure FinTech Software Deployment

detail.title: Risk-Aware CI/CD Pipelines Using Machine Learning for Secure FinTech Software Deployment
detail.abstract: This paper looks at what happens when you bolt machine learning (ML) onto CI/CD pipelines, specifically in the FinTech world, where security and risk-awareness aren't optional (Solberg, 2024; Olabowale, 2025). The idea is simple but powerful: use ML-driven risk scores, predictive threat models, and automated deployment monitoring to spot and reduce vulnerabilities both before code ships and while it's running (Mohammed et al., 2025; ResearchGate, 2025). Method-wise, we actually embed ML algorithms into CI/CD workflows so they can inspect code changes, flag likely security threats, and help enforce the org's policy requirements. In practice, that meant feeding code diffs and telemetry into models that rate risk, predict attack vectors, and trigger compliance checks where needed. The results were encouraging. Pipelines augmented with ML showed a clear drop in software vulnerabilities and did a better job of keeping deployments aligned with regulatory and internal security rules while also speeding things up because teams could manage risk proactively instead of reacting later. Predictive threat modelling helped catch anomalous behaviour in real time, and automated monitoring gave continuous oversight without choking the development cadence. So yes, real-time detection and light-touch, always-on monitoring turned out to be a practical combo. Bottom line: when ML is thoughtfully woven into CI/CD, it shifts traditional pipelines into risk-aware systems, scalable, resilient, and better suited for high-stakes FinTech deployments. Integrating ML doesn't just harden security; it improves operational reliability and supports faster, safer, more compliant deliveries (Malik et al., 2025). To be honest, this work contributes to the growing body of intelligent DevSecOps practice and offers concrete, actionable direction for FinTech teams trying to modernise how they deploy software.

AI.tldr: 将机器学习集成到FinTech的CI/CD管道中，通过风险评分、威胁预测和自动化监控，在代码部署前后主动识别和减少安全漏洞，提高安全性和合规性。
AI.research_question: 将机器学习集成到FinTech的CI/CD管道中如何影响软件漏洞、合规性和部署效率？
AI.motivation: FinTech行业对安全和风险意识有严格要求，传统CI/CD管道缺乏主动风险识别能力，需要智能化的安全增强方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能DevSecOps实践，结合机器学习驱动的风险评分、预测性威胁建模和自动化监控理论。
AI.method: 将机器学习算法嵌入CI/CD工作流，分析代码变更、标记安全威胁、执行合规检查，使用代码差异和遥测数据训练风险评分模型。
AI.findings: 集成ML的管道显著减少软件漏洞，提高合规性，加快部署速度，实现实时异常检测和持续监控，将传统管道转变为风险感知系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了智能DevSecOps理论，提出将ML集成到CI/CD中创建风险感知系统的框架，为高风险的FinTech部署提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FinTech团队提供具体的、可操作的指导，通过ML增强CI/CD管道，提高安全性、操作可靠性和合规性，支持更快、更安全的软件交付。

title: Antitrust Treble Damages and Economic Efficiency
affiliations: Criterion Economics, LLC

detail.title: Antitrust Treble Damages and Economic Efficiency
detail.abstract:
In 1977, at the age of 21, I wrote this article concerning the deterrent effect of antitrust treble damages. The paper attracted serious attention at the time, benefiting from comments by economic luminaries John Shoven, Bruce Owen, and Oliver Williamson, and receiving a formal accolade from Stanford University. In the decades that followed, my thinking on antitrust enforcement was further shaped by antitrust scholar Kenneth Elzinga and, most decisively, by Judge Richard Posner, for whom I later served as a law clerk. However, for reasons long forgotten—but surely in part because the internet did not exist until 1983—I did not disseminate this paper more widely. Eventually, I lost my only copy of the paper, which I had typed on an IBM Selectric; and thus I did not read it again until 2025, when librarians at Stanford tracked it down for me in the university’s archives. The paper’s publication in The Criterion Journal on Innovation these 49 years later now reflects a simple but telling fact: the relevant antitrust law on treble damages has not materially changed since 1977, and neither has the economic logic governing the deterrent effect of treble damages. To paraphrase Led Zeppelin, the math remains the same.

Lawyers and economists have long argued that antitrust treble damages overdeter anticompetitive conduct and inefficiently chill lawful behavior. I question that conclusion by distinguishing between the nominal cost and the effective cost of treble damages to an antitrust defendant. When the economic analysis of antitrust deterrence properly considers inflation, interest income earned during litigation delay, the tax deductibility of damage payments, and uncertainty of detection and recovery, the effective cost to the antitrust violator diverges substantially from the 300-percent statutory benchmark in section 4 of the Clayton Act. Treble damages function in practice as an implicit tax on income derived from illegal conduct, but at an effective tax rate that is frequently far lower—and, in some circumstances, even negative. Consequently, the conventional overdeterrence critique advanced by Posner, Elzinga, and others since the 1970s loses force, and the concern that private antitrust enforcement is economically inefficient remains overstated.

I further demonstrate that uncertainty discounts the ex ante deterrent effect of treble damages and might make antitrust violations a rational investment for risk-averse firms. Finally, I propose modest reforms—adjusting damages for inflation, limiting deductibility, and requiring compensation for forgone interest—that would materially increase the efficiency and deterrent value of treble damages without abandoning private enforcement.

AI.tldr: 这篇1977年的论文重新审视了反垄断三倍赔偿的威慑效果。作者认为，当考虑通货膨胀、诉讼延迟期间的利息收入、赔偿金的税收抵扣、以及发现和追偿的不确定性等因素时，三倍赔偿的实际成本远低于300%的法定标准，甚至可能为负。因此，传统上认为三倍赔偿会过度威慑的观点可能被夸大了。
AI.research_question: 反垄断三倍赔偿是否真的会过度威慑竞争行为？当考虑通货膨胀、利息收入、税收抵扣和不确定性等因素时，三倍赔偿的实际威慑效果如何？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，律师和经济学家认为反垄断三倍赔偿会过度威慑反竞争行为，并低效地抑制合法行为。作者质疑这一结论，认为现有分析忽略了名义成本与实际成本之间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法律经济学和威慑理论，特别是考虑时间价值（通货膨胀、利息）、税收效应和不确定性对威慑效果的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过考虑通货膨胀、诉讼延迟期间的利息收入、赔偿金的税收抵扣、以及发现和追偿的不确定性等因素，重新计算三倍赔偿的实际成本。
AI.findings: 1. 三倍赔偿的实际成本远低于300%的法定标准，甚至可能为负；2. 三倍赔偿在实践中相当于对非法所得征收的隐含税，但实际税率通常较低；3. 不确定性会降低三倍赔偿的事前威慑效果，可能使反垄断违规成为风险规避企业的理性投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了Posner、Elzinga等人自1970年代以来提出的过度威慑批评；2. 提出了更全面的三倍赔偿实际成本计算框架；3. 揭示了名义威慑与实际威慑之间的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三项改革建议：1. 根据通货膨胀调整赔偿金额；2. 限制赔偿金的税收抵扣；3. 要求补偿损失的利息。这些改革可以在不放弃私人执法的前提下，显著提高三倍赔偿的效率和威慑价值。

title: The Architecture of Selective Terror: Domestic Designation Asymmetry and The Racialized Architecture of American Law
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Architecture of Selective Terror: Domestic Designation Asymmetry and The Racialized Architecture of American Law
detail.abstract: On September 22, 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order designating Antifa as a domestic terrorist organization—an unprecedented action given that no federal statutory framework exists for such designations. This Article examines the structural asymmetry in American terrorism law that permits designation of foreign terrorist organizations under 8 U.S.C. § 1189 while providing no equivalent mechanism for domestic groups. This absence is not accidental but architectural: a deliberate gap that has historically shielded white supremacist organizations from formal terrorist classification while enabling the surveillance and prosecution of racial justice movements. Through analysis of the Ku Klux Klan's documented history of terrorism, the executive branch's differential treatment of right-wing versus left-wing political violence, and empirical data on domestic terrorism fatalities, this Article argues that the designation gap constitutes a form of structural white supremacy embedded within federal law itself.

AI.tldr: 特朗普总统通过行政命令将Antifa指定为国内恐怖组织，但美国法律存在结构性不对称：有外国恐怖组织指定机制（8 U.S.C. § 1189），却无对应的国内组织指定框架。这种缺失是故意的制度设计，历史上保护了白人至上主义组织，同时使种族正义运动面临监控和起诉。
AI.research_question: 美国恐怖主义法律中的结构性不对称如何体现，以及这种不对称如何构成嵌入联邦法律本身的结构性白人至上主义？
AI.motivation: 特朗普总统2025年9月22日签署行政命令将Antifa指定为国内恐怖组织，这一前所未有的行动凸显了美国法律中缺乏国内恐怖组织指定的联邦法定框架，而外国恐怖组织却有明确的指定机制（8 U.S.C. § 1189）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性白人至上主义理论；法律不对称性分析；历史制度主义；种族化法律执行理论。
AI.method: 1. 法律文本分析：对比8 U.S.C. § 1189（外国恐怖组织指定）与国内恐怖组织指定的法律空白；2. 历史分析：考察三K党的恐怖主义历史记录；3. 比较分析：行政分支对右翼与左翼政治暴力的差异化处理；4. 实证数据分析：国内恐怖主义死亡人数的统计资料。
AI.findings: 1. 美国法律存在结构性不对称：有外国恐怖组织指定机制，但无国内组织指定框架；2. 这种缺失是故意的制度设计，而非偶然；3. 历史上这种不对称保护了白人至上主义组织（如三K党）免于正式恐怖分类；4. 同时使种族正义运动面临监控和起诉；5. 行政分支对右翼与左翼政治暴力存在差异化处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"指定缺口"（designation gap）作为结构性白人至上主义在联邦法律中的具体体现；2. 将恐怖主义法律不对称理论化为种族化法律执行的一种形式；3. 揭示了法律空白如何成为系统性种族歧视的制度化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解特朗普行政命令的法律和政治意义提供分析框架；2. 揭示了美国反恐法律中的种族偏见；3. 为法律改革提供依据，呼吁建立公平的国内恐怖组织指定机制；4. 为司法挑战行政命令提供理论支持。

title: Ibu Bumi Dilarani: How Environmental Law Conflicts with a Relational Approach to Nature in the North Kendeng Highlands, Central Java, Indonesia

detail.title: Ibu Bumi Dilarani: How Environmental Law Conflicts with a Relational Approach to Nature in the North Kendeng Highlands, Central Java, Indonesia

publicationDetails.detailsText: In Religion, Decolonization, and the Planetary Community, edited by Whitney Bauman, Samsul Maarif and Jonathan Davis Smith. Routledge. Chapter 14, pp. 232-54. https://doi.org/10.4324/9781003527398-19

detail.abstract: The struggle to preserve our planet requires an effective legal architecture. Although legal instruments such as Environmental Impact Analysis (EIA) and Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) have been developed, the regulation and implementation of such instruments remain problematic in national legal systems and drive local resource conflicts. This chapter critically analyzes the instrumentalization of environmental law as a pillar of national legal architecture, especially in how Indonesian administrative law remains influenced by colonial-era laws. The chapter focuses on a case study of environmental resistance led by the Sedulur Sikep community against the cement industry in the North Kendang Highlands, Central Java. Significant findings in this chapter suggest that conceptuality and authority in environmental legal instruments remain distant from conceptions of relational autonomy. The colonial state administrative law is still used, facilitating subordination and marginalization, Ngelarani Ibu Bumi (hurting Mother Earth) in Kendeng, and exacerbating planetary damage. The relational approach is essential in decolonizing environmental law by attaching importance to the centrality of the relationship with the core values of life and basing itit on human needs. Through a relational approach, top-down, patriarchal, and capitalistic legal instruments must be changed, which can challenge a despotism that undermines human relationships with nature.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了环境法作为国家法律架构支柱的工具化问题，以印尼北肯登高地水泥产业环境抗争为案例，揭示了殖民时期行政法对当代环境治理的持续影响，提出关系性方法对于环境法去殖民化的重要性。
AI.research_question: 环境法律工具（如EIA和SEA）在国家法律体系中的规制和实施为何仍然存在问题，并导致地方资源冲突？殖民时期的行政法如何持续影响当代环境治理，阻碍关系性自主的实现？
AI.motivation: 尽管已发展出环境影响评估等环境法律工具，但这些工具在国家法律体系中的实施仍存在问题，导致地方资源冲突。需要批判性分析环境法作为国家法律架构支柱的工具化问题，特别是在印尼等后殖民国家中殖民法律遗产的持续影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系性自主理论、去殖民化理论、批判法律研究、环境正义理论、后殖民法律分析。
AI.method: 批判性法律分析、案例研究（印尼中爪哇北肯登高地Sedulur Sikep社区对抗水泥产业的环境抗争）、历史法律分析（殖民时期行政法的持续影响）。
AI.findings: 1. 环境法律工具的概念性和权威性仍远离关系性自主的理念；2. 殖民时期国家行政法仍在使用，助长从属和边缘化，导致"伤害大地母亲"和环境破坏；3. 自上而下、父权制和资本主义的法律工具需要改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了关系性方法作为环境法去殖民化的关键路径；2. 强调了与生命核心价值的关系中心性；3. 挑战了破坏人与自然关系的专制主义法律结构；4. 为后殖民环境法律研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为环境法律改革提供关系性方法指导；2. 揭示殖民法律遗产对当代环境冲突的影响；3. 为地方社区环境抗争提供理论支持；4. 促进环境治理从工具性向关系性转变。

title: Beyond Boundaries: A Conversation with Stelarc on His Vision of Human-Machine Integration”
affiliations: Lomonosov  Moscow State University - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Beyond Boundaries: A Conversation with Stelarc on His Vision of Human-Machine Integration”

publicationDetails.detailsText: Philosophy Journal of the Higher School of Economics, volume 9, issue 4, 2025[10.17323/2587-8719-2025-4-245-264]

detail.abstract: For over fifty years, Stelarc has radically explored the fusion of human biology and technology through his provocative artistic practice. This paper draws on a 2024 interview with the artist and examines how his work challenges our fundamental assumptions about human identity and capability. Through analysis of his pioneering projects-from the iconic Third Hand to the Ear on Arm and his internet-enabled performances-we see how Stelarc's art embodies emerging posthumanist and transhumanist philosophies. His artistic work addresses the idea that humanity has moved beyond natural selection into an era where technological engineering drives our development. The research traces his artistic evolution from early body suspensions to recent explorations of distributed embodiment and AI integration, including insights from our 2024 conversation. By merging art, philosophy, and technological innovation, Stelarc creates not just theoretical frameworks but visceral demonstrations of possible human futures. His bold experiments spark crucial dialogue about consciousness, embodiment and identity in our world, which gets to become more and more technological.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2024年访谈分析艺术家Stelarc五十年来探索生物与技术融合的艺术实践，展示其如何挑战人类身份和能力的基本假设，体现后人类主义和超人类主义哲学。
AI.research_question: Stelarc的艺术实践如何挑战人类身份和能力的基本假设，并体现后人类主义和超人类主义哲学？
AI.motivation: Stelarc五十年来激进探索生物与技术融合的艺术实践，为理解技术时代人类身份、意识和具身化提供了独特的视角，值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后人类主义、超人类主义、具身化理论、技术哲学
AI.method: 定性研究方法：2024年艺术家访谈分析、艺术作品分析（从"第三只手"到"手臂上的耳朵"及互联网表演）、艺术实践演变轨迹研究
AI.findings: Stelarc的艺术实践展示了人类已超越自然选择进入技术工程驱动发展的时代；其作品从早期身体悬吊到分布式具身化和AI整合的演变，创造了具身化的未来人类可能性演示；艺术成为哲学和技术创新的融合平台。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为后人类主义和超人类主义哲学提供了艺术实践验证
2. 拓展了技术时代身份和具身化的理论框架
3. 建立了艺术、哲学和技术创新的跨学科理论连接
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为技术伦理和人类未来发展提供艺术视角
2. 激发关于意识、身份和具身化的公共对话
3. 为跨学科研究和艺术实践提供创新范例
4. 推动技术时代人类自我认知的反思

title: Evaluating Community-Based Early Warning Systems for Natural Disasters

detail.title: Evaluating Community-Based Early Warning Systems for Natural Disasters
detail.abstract: The study looks at community-based early warning systems (CBEWS) in natural disaster mitigation and evaluates effectiveness, challenges, and impact. Given the crucial importance of timely information in the disaster risk reduction process, the researcher uses a mixed-method technique, which includes a detailed literature review, individual comprehensive case studies, and geospatial GIS-based studies. In this way, operational and performance feedback of CBEWS, in addition to the socio-structures and behavioral consequences, can be evaluated. Overall, CBEWS have significant advantages such as fostering bottom-up participation, improving the speed and quality of community responses, and building community resilience. A number of important weaknesses were also found, such as technology, gaps in community participation, and weaknesses in sustained community participation and data quality. Each of these weaknesses highlights the need for customizing and integrating socio-culturally and ecologically specific early warning systems. CBEWS are crucial for effective community-based disaster risk reduction and for building and improving community resilience, but are most effective when there are systems in place for targeted community training, the integration of contemporary technologies, and the reinforcement of traditional knowledge systems. From this, I recommend that policy frameworks and disaster management strategies focus on building adaptable, context-sensitive frameworks that enhance local systems and technology. All in all, this study reiterates the CBEWS's potential for disaster preparedness while noting the importance of sustained innovation, support, and community-centric design frameworks to optimize impact (Pham et al., 2024; Macherera & Chimbari, 2016).

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了基于社区的早期预警系统（CBEWS）在自然灾害缓解中的有效性、挑战和影响，发现CBEWS在促进自下而上参与、提高社区响应速度和质量、增强社区韧性方面具有显著优势，但也存在技术、社区参与持续性、数据质量等方面的弱点，需要定制化、整合社会文化和生态特性的预警系统。
AI.research_question: 基于社区的早期预警系统（CBEWS）在自然灾害缓解中的有效性、挑战和影响是什么？如何优化CBEWS以提升社区灾害风险减少和韧性建设？
AI.motivation: 及时信息在灾害风险减少过程中的重要性，以及需要评估CBEWS的操作性能、社会结构和行为后果，以优化社区灾害准备和韧性建设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区灾害风险管理理论、社区韧性理论、参与式灾害管理理论、社会技术系统理论。
AI.method: 混合方法：详细文献综述、个体综合案例研究、基于地理信息系统（GIS）的地理空间研究。
AI.findings: CBEWS具有显著优势：促进自下而上参与、提高社区响应速度和质量、增强社区韧性。但也存在重要弱点：技术限制、社区参与缺口、持续性参与不足、数据质量问题。这些弱点凸显了需要定制化和整合社会文化和生态特性的预警系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对CBEWS社会技术系统动态的理解；2. 提出了社区灾害预警系统的综合评估框架；3. 强调了社会文化和生态因素在预警系统设计中的重要性；4. 为社区韧性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供优化CBEWS的具体建议；2. 强调需要针对性的社区培训、现代技术整合和传统知识系统强化；3. 建议建立适应性、情境敏感的政策框架；4. 为灾害管理策略提供基于证据的指导，以增强本地系统和技术。

title: An Argument for a Sino-allergic Foreign Policy
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: An Argument for a Sino-allergic Foreign Policy
detail.abstract:
This paper argues that the Philippines’ failure to deter Chinese maritime coercion in the West Philippine Sea is not primarily a consequence of diplomatic weakness, legal ambiguity, or resource constraints, but of sustained strategic abdication rooted in alliance over-dependency and elite unwillingness to impose costs on aggression. Despite a favorable UNCLOS arbitral ruling and repeated incursions into the Philippine exclusive economic zone, Manila’s response has remained largely symbolic, producing protest without enforcement and engagement without deterrence.

The paper introduces the concept of a Sino-allergic foreign policy as a corrective strategic orientation. Sino-allergy does not imply anti-China isolationism or militarized confrontation, but calibrated resistance to coercion combined with resistance to alliance infantilization—the erosion of indigenous strategic capacity caused by excessive reliance on external security patrons. Drawing on defensive realism and balance-of-power theory, the paper advances a doctrine of multi-aligned strategic autonomy and demonstrates, through comparative analysis with Vietnam, that sustained resistance to maritime coercion is feasible for middle powers when diplomacy is backed by capability and political will. It concludes that sovereignty in a contested maritime environment cannot be preserved through diplomacy alone.

AI.tldr: 菲律宾未能有效威慑中国在南海的胁迫行为，主要原因是战略放弃而非外交软弱或资源限制。论文提出"对华过敏"外交政策概念，主张多联盟战略自主，通过比较越南案例证明中等国家可通过能力与政治意志结合来抵抗海上胁迫。
AI.research_question: 为什么菲律宾未能有效威慑中国在西菲律宾海的海上胁迫行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管菲律宾获得了有利的UNCLOS仲裁裁决并面临中国在其专属经济区的反复入侵，但马尼拉的反应仍然主要是象征性的，抗议无执行，接触无威慑，需要解释这种战略失败的根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 防御性现实主义和均势理论，引入"对华过敏"外交政策概念和"联盟幼稚化"概念（过度依赖外部安全保护者导致本土战略能力侵蚀）。
AI.method: 比较分析（菲律宾与越南的对比研究），理论分析结合案例研究。
AI.findings: 菲律宾的战略失败源于持续的战略放弃，根植于联盟过度依赖和精英不愿对侵略施加成本。相比之下，越南展示了中等国家通过能力与政治意志结合可以持续抵抗海上胁迫。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"对华过敏"外交政策概念作为纠正性战略导向；2. 发展"多联盟战略自主"学说；3. 挑战传统认为外交、法律或资源限制是主要制约因素的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为菲律宾提供替代战略框架；2. 证明中等国家在争议海域维护主权需要超越单纯外交的手段；3. 提供越南成功案例作为参考模式。

title: Digital Economy and Transfer Pricing Adjustments
